Location: Brampton, Ontario, Canada | Toronto, Ontario, Canada
Industry: Broadcast Media Production and Distribution, Book and Periodical Publishing, and Telecommunications
Description:
We are committed to connecting Canadians through unique partnerships, our world-class network and content Canadians love—and our innovative team is growing. We are looking for dedicated team members to join our Corporate team who have a genuine passion for making positive impacts on customers and the communities where we live and work. We have a variety of business units with exciting and meaningful work waiting for you, including Communications, HR, Legal and Corporate Affairs, Supply Chain, Finance, and Real Estate. If you are considering your next step, we have exciting opportunities waiting for you. Come build a rewarding career at Rogers and be a driving force behind our success story!
  
  
The
**Delivery Manager**
is accountable to develop, lead, and project manage the service delivery POD model strategy that is required to fulfill the technical solution that has been designed for Rogers customers. Focus on leading a seamless transition of the technical solution from the Sales organization into the Customer Implementation team. Identify and resolve issues that may impede the progress of the delivery process and engage personally with the customer to establish expectations and provide formal updates on progress.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Onboarding new large customer deployments and managing customer expectations from start to finish.
* Focus on improving service delivery and customer experience by assuming overall accountability of the end to end implementation of the customer’s service solution
* Ability to gather order information to perform order entry into the Rogers systems and project managing the components of an order from order receipt to billing
* Take responsibility for the customer experience by ensuring appropriate engagement takes place throughout the process, acting as a central point of contact for the customer – as well as for Sales
* Leads the daily stand up calls with the Customer implementation teams to drive collaboration activities across multiple roles and varying expertise – both early and throughout the provisioning process to proactively address challenges that may impact the timely delivery of service
* Provide coaching and support to the various roles that make up the project delivery team engaged in enabling a customer’s service solution
* Create and manage constructive relationships with team members, subject matter experts, stakeholders and other members of the organization.
* Make critical business decisions to meet customer expectations.
* Understanding senior management’s business strategy and providing project related recommendations for cost effective service delivery
* Understand issues (Technical, process etc) and works to remove roadblocks across all operational areas to ensure an executable order is enabled at each stage of the provisioning process in order to deliver timely service to the customer
* Identify obstacles/conflicts and evaluate, recommend and implement workable solutions. Escalate issues to the appropriate levels within the organization to mitigate risks and keep delivery on track.
* Makes commitments on customer delivery dates and is measured on accuracy
* Active WIP management, Monthly revenue forecasting
* Develops Project Plan, Schedule as required
* Provide Executives and Management with timely reporting on implementation progress, issues, risks and containment /get well plans.
* Develop and conduct presentations to various levels of Management as required.

**Qualifications**

* Understand the fundamentals and be able to implement integrated project/program strategies, PMP an asset.
* University Degree plus professional certification (e.g. Computer Science, Commerce, CA, PEng, CGA, B. Ed., LLB, etc.)
* Post-Secondary degree in Engineering or other related technical discipline or equivalent combination of education or experience
* Knowledge of Ethernet technology and topology, IP technology, SIP, MPLS.
* Solid understanding of telecommunications services and equipment.
* Three – five years’ experience in a telecommunications operation related field or environment
* Knowledge of Rogers Business services, products and procedures
* Post-Secondary education in a related technology or telecommunications field.
* ITIL Certification is an asset.
* Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel.
* Proven ad demonstrated leadership skills.
* Demonstrated excellent communication with technical and management staff, both verbal and written.
* A strong sense of teamwork and willingness to work in an ever-changing environment.
* Excellent presentation and communication skills.
* Entrepreneurial attitude and an ability to work with little supervision in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong organizational skills
* Software skills Microsoft Office, AS400, INSIS, Salesforce
* Must be self-motivated, creative and able to work as part of a team
* Core Competencies Customer Focus; Teamwork; Communication; Accountability; Innovation
* Bilingualism (English & French) is an asset.

Title: Senior Project Manager - Media Technology
Description:
Are you ready to take your career to new heights and be a part of a dynamic team at Rogers Sports & Media? We believe in creativity, innovation, and collaboration in everything we do, and we are looking for people who share this mindset to join us. With a monthly reach of 30 million Canadians, you can help shape the future of sports, news, e-commerce, and entertainment. At Rogers, we value diversity and inclusivity and believe that every voice matters. Join us today and be a part of a team that is redefining the future of media.

  

**Senior Project Manager – Media Technology**

  

**Who we're looking for:**

  

We are looking for a strong leader to join the Broadcast Engineering team within Rogers as a Sr. Project Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for delivering project management excellence on key strategic initiatives through disciplined execution. The breadth and complexity of these projects cannot be understated. The successful candidate should be able to oversee the impacts, interdependencies and timelines between functional teams and work to ensure project initiatives meet the goals and objectives set forth by the senior and executive leadership teams.

  

**What you'll do:**

* Manage infrastructure-related deployments, upgrades, and strategic technology initiatives from planning through execution.
* Manage project funding, including Capital Authorization (CA) requests, budget development, forecasting, financial tracking, and variance reporting.
* Developed business cases, procurement documentation, and financial approvals required to support project delivery.
* Participate in vendor evaluation and selection processes, including RFP development, proposal reviews, and recommendation activities.
* Manage vendor relationships and holding vendors accountable for contractual obligations, milestones, deliverables, schedules, and project outcomes.
* Coordinate and facilitating workshops, discovery sessions, design reviews, and planning meetings with vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Partner with stakeholders to evaluate requirements, scope changes, project impacts, and resource needs.
* Developed and maintaining project plans, schedules, RAID logs, action registers, and project documentation.
* Provide regular project status updates, executive summaries, dashboards, and governance reporting to stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify risks, dependencies, issues, and constraints early, and proactively driving mitigation and resolution plans.
* Lead steering committee, governance, and stakeholder discussions to support informed decision-making and project alignment.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure deliverables are completed on time, dependencies are managed, and project momentum is maintained.
* Conduct analysis and providing recommendations to support operational, financial, and technology decisions.
* Ensure alignment between project delivery, financial objectives, strategic priorities, and operational goals.
* Drive accountability across project teams by tracking commitments, following up on actions, removing roadblocks, and ensuring successful execution of key initiatives.
  

**What you bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Information Technology, Broadcast Technology, or a related field or experience would be an asset.
* PMP certification preferred; Certified Scrum Master (CSM) and SAFe certification considered assets.
* 7+ years of project management experience, preferably leading complex technology, infrastructure, media asset management, broadcast engineering, or digital media transformation projects.
* Experience delivering projects within a broadcast, media, content production, streaming, or digital media environment.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies, including Agile, SAFe, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery approaches.
* Knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and technology deployment lifecycles.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent projects, programs, and cross-functional workstreams.
* Experience with Media Asset Management (MAM), Digital Asset Management (DAM), content workflows, video content management systems, or related broadcast technologies.
* Proven experience managing project budgets, capital funding, forecasting, financial reporting, and cost controls.
* Experience developing business cases, Capital Authorization (CA) submissions, procurement documentation, and vendor statements of work.
* Demonstrated experience participating in vendor selection processes, RFP evaluations, contract negotiations, and vendor governance activities.
* Proven ability to manage vendor performance, track deliverables, facilitate workshops, and ensure contractual commitments are achieved.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with experience presenting project status, risks, financials, and recommendations to senior leadership and steering committees.
* Advanced experience using Microsoft Project, Microsoft 365 applications, and project reporting tools.
* Experience with JIRA, Confluence, and other Atlassian tools considered an asset.
* Strong financial, analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to identify risks, manage dependencies, resolve issues, and drive projects to successful completion.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while balancing changing priorities and competing business objectives.
* A commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, Belonging, and Accessibility, helping create an environment where everyone feels welcomed, valued, and supported.

Title: Principal Technical Program Manager - FDE
Description:
**Overview**
In the Microsoft Frontier Company Engineering team, you won’t just build software; you’ll deliver real outcomes for some of the world’s most complex organizations.
  
  
We are a global team of world-class engineers who have been working in a Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) model for more than a decade, embedding directly within customer teams to solve their toughest challenges, side-by-side, and shipping production-ready solutions in days, not months.
  
  
As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you will embed with strategic customers to lead complex technical programs, owning the full customer journey from problem definition through delivery and driving measurable business outcomes. You’ll work in small, multidisciplinary crews alongside engineers, data scientists, and designers, operating with high autonomy to turn ambiguous problems into shipped solutions.
  
  
Our work is powered by AI, applying the mindset and tooling across the entire development lifecycle to move from idea to production in days while maintaining the highest standards of security, quality, and trust.
  
  
**This Role Offers The Opportunity To**

* Lead complex technical programs from problem definition through to delivered outcomes
* Drive decisions that directly influence business strategy and customer outcomes
* Collaborate with leading global organizations across industries
* Apply the latest advancements in AI and engineering workflows to deliver value at scale

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Embed with strategic customers to lead complex technical programs with high autonomy, aligning business needs with engineering solutions across AI, cloud, and data. Take ownership of the customer journey end-to-end, from problem definition through co-engineering delivery to measurable business outcomes.
* Apply AI assisted engineering practices as a daily operating mode: use AI tools across the full software development lifecycle to accelerate requirements-to-specs, generate high-quality engineering artifacts from customer context, and drive continuous flow of value from business need to production.
* Operate fluently in engineering tooling (e.g., VS Code, GitHub, AI agents) as primary work surfaces for planning, documentation, and technical program leadership. Validate AI-generated outputs with domain expertise to maintain quality at speed.
* Navigate ambiguity in customer environments with self-direction and high ownership. Make technical and program decisions with incomplete information, proactively identify opportunities and manage risks, providing data-driven recommendations to stakeholders.
* Champion and cultivate reusable solution patterns, open-source assets, and engineering playbooks that scale impact beyond individual engagements. Contribute to the broader engineering community through knowledge sharing and best practices.
* Partner with multi-disciplinary engineering teams (software engineers, data scientists, designers) to evaluate, design, and deliver AI-powered cloud solutions side-by-side with customer engineers. Give key stakeholders data-driven recommendations based on identified risks and tradeoffs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree AND 10+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
* Or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.
* Experience partnering directly with customers or internal stakeholders to deliver solutions end-to-end.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Title: Solution Delivery Manager
Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada | Brampton, Ontario, Canada | Brampton, ON, Canada

Description:
Our Technology team wakes up every day with one goal in mind - connecting Canadians to the people and things that matter most. Together, we are proud to support 30 million Canadians each month through managing a robust portfolio that champions leading-edge technology. We drive large-scale, complex, and high-visibility technology projects and programs that shape the future of technology in Canada and expand connectivity from coast to coast. If you are interested in being a part of this, consider applying for the following opportunity
  
  
**Who We're Looking For**
We are seeking a Solution Delivery Manager reporting to the Senior Manager, Residential Solution Delivery. In this role as Solution Delivery Manager, you will provide end-to-end leadership for the planning, solutioning, sequencing, and delivery of initiatives within an assigned workstream, squad, or program. You will establish trusted relationships with Product, Business, Architecture, Delivery, Security, Quality Assurance, and domain teams, translating product roadmaps and project requirements into aligned, executable delivery plans.
  
  
You will balance business outcomes, technical feasibility, risk, capacity, and release constraints. The role is accountable for driving clarity across scope, solution, estimates, dependencies, approvals, quality, and timelines while supporting teams through execution and issue resolution.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Stakeholder Partnership and Roadmap Alignment
  
  

* Build and sustain trusted relationships with Product and Business stakeholders, creating transparency on priorities, trade-offs, risks, and delivery outcomes.
* Develop a detailed understanding of the product roadmap for the assigned workstream, squad, or program and translate it into actionable delivery priorities.
* Partner closely with the Product Owner to shape the backlog, negotiate priorities, clarify acceptance outcomes, and maintain alignment to business value.
* Represent Solution Delivery in cross-functional discussions and ensure decisions, dependencies, and commitments are documented and communicated.

Requirements, Scope, and Solution Leadership
  
  

* Read and understand project requirements; challenge assumptions, identify gaps and dependencies, provide feedback, and sign off on the scope committed for delivery.
* Provide direction and guidance to the Business Analyst throughout project execution, including requirements clarification, dependency management, decision tracking, and issue resolution.
* Work closely with the Solution Architect to finalize the end-to-end solution, ensuring alignment across business requirements, architecture, integration, data, operations, security, and support considerations.
* Coordinate solution reviews with domain teams and Business stakeholders and obtain the required sign-offs before delivery proceeds.
* Work closely with the Cyber Security prime and the Business Systems Analyst to close security requirements, risks, assessments, and required approvals.

Integrated Planning and Delivery Management
  
  

* Work with domain leads and the Project Manager to sequence deliveries and formulate the Plan of Intent and Plan of Release in alignment with business goals, dependencies, team capacity, and release windows.
* Negotiate delivery timelines with domain teams, release dates, and other delivery commitments, while clearly identifying prerequisites and trade-offs.
* Obtain and consolidate estimates from all contributing teams; validate assumptions, dependencies, and resource needs to support an achievable integrated plan.
* Proactively identify delivery risks, scope gaps, resource constraints, and cross-team dependencies, and drive timely mitigation or escalation.
* Maintain clear delivery governance, decision records, status reporting, and accountability across the end-to-end lifecycle.

Facilitation, Decisions, and Governance
  
  

* Schedule and lead Joint Application Design (JAD) sessions with domain teams and relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure every JAD session and key delivery meeting has a clear agenda, required pre-work, appropriate decision-makers, and a specific outcome to be achieved.
* Drive timely decisions and sign-offs by surfacing options, impacts, risks, and recommendations in a concise and fact-based manner.
* Promote collaborative ways of working across Business and Technology teams, resolving conflict constructively and keeping teams focused on shared outcomes.

Quality Assurance and Delivery Support
  
  

* Ensure the QA Test Plan and Test Cases fully cover the approved project scope and end-to-end solution and align with expected business and technical results.
* Provide technical or process support during QA to help resolve defects, clarify intended behaviour, remove major blockers, and coordinate the appropriate domain expertise.
* Validate readiness for release by confirming scope completion, solution and security sign-offs, test evidence, operational readiness, dependencies, and outstanding risks.
* Support post-release reviews and continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and strengthening delivery practices.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of progressive experience in technology delivery, solution delivery, program delivery, systems implementation, or a related discipline, including demonstrated leadership across complex initiatives.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional delivery involving Product, Business, Architecture, Engineering, Security, Quality Assurance, Operations, vendors, and multiple technology domains.
* Strong understanding of the software delivery lifecycle, requirements practices, solution design, estimation, release planning, testing, defect management, and operational readiness.
* Demonstrated ability to understand technical and business requirements, evaluate end-to-end impacts, and make sound scope and delivery decisions.
* Experience facilitating JAD or solution-design sessions and driving groups toward clear, documented decisions and accountabilities.
* Strong negotiation and influencing skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, timelines, capacity constraints, and stakeholder expectations.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills; able to communicate complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail and a bias for action.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity, privacy, risk, and governance requirements within enterprise technology delivery.
* Experience working in Agile, hybrid, and project-based delivery models; familiarity with backlog management and iterative planning practices.
* A collaborative leadership style that builds trust, protects sustainable team capacity, and creates accountability without compromising quality.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Stakeholders have a shared understanding of scope, solution, priorities, dependencies, timelines, and decisions.
* Delivery plans are integrated, realistic, and aligned to roadmap outcomes, team capacity, security obligations, and release constraints.
* JAD and governance forums produce clear decisions, owners, and next steps.
* Quality plans provide full coverage of the committed scope and defects are resolved through coordinated, timely support.
* Risks and blockers are identified early, managed transparently, and escalated with options and recommended actions.
* Teams deliver sustainable outcomes through clear roles, practical processes, and trusted cross-functional relationships.

Title: Director of Datacenter IT Operations
Description:

Microsoft's Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. It delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services, including Bing, Microsoft 365, Xbox, OneDrive and the Microsoft Azure platform. Our infrastructure is a global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. It supports more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries.
  
  
Reporting to the Charlotte Metro Director, the
**Director of Datacenter IT Operations**
is the senior IT Operations leader for the Charlotte Metro. This leader owns end-to-end IT operations, IT outfitting and IT infrastructure delivery across all
**Class A and Class B datacenter facilities**
in the metro. That organization is accountable for safe, secure, on-time and defect-free delivery of customer capacity, and for reliable, SLA-compliant operation of IT infrastructure once it is live.
  
  
The role covers the full IT lifecycle. That starts with design input and construction coordination, continues through IT outfitting, network and server deployment, operational readiness and turnover, and extends into steady-state operations, hardware lifecycle management and decommissioning. The Director partners closely with Critical Environment (CE), IAM/Logistics, Datacenter Delivery (DCD), Datacenter Engineering (DCE), Commissioning, network and hardware engineering teams, and vendors. Together they ensure IT requirements are built in from the start and that Operations is ready to take ownership on Day 1.
  
  
Success in this role requires strong organizational leadership, disciplined service management, financial acumen, and the ability to turn technical and operational risk into clear, decision-ready recommendations for metro, regional and CO+I leadership. With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve to meet the business demands that make Microsoft a world-class cloud provider.
  
  
Do you want to empower billions across the world? Come and join us in CO+I and be at the forefront of the action!
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Organizational Leadership and People Management

+ Build, lead, coach and develop the Charlotte Metro IT Operations organization, including Datacenter Technician Managers, Datacenter Program Managers and Datacenter Technicians across all Class A and Class B facilities.
+ Deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching and caring. Live our culture, embody our values and practice our leadership principles.
+ Set the IT organization's strategy, priorities, operating rhythm, performance expectations and long-term capability roadmap in line with metro and CO+I priorities.
+ Lead IT workforce, capacity and succession planning across the metro. Allocate resources across campuses and sites based on business priority, infrastructure complexity, operational risk and future demand.
+ Attract, hire and retain great people. Know everyone's capabilities and aspirations, invest in the growth of others, and develop the next generation of leaders through intentional delegation and succession planning.
+ Make sure teams complete required training and certifications. Partner with Learning & Development to evolve the training portfolio as technology and site requirements change.
+ Recognize team successes and reward teamwork while keeping the culture focused on strategic goals.

* IT Operations and Service Delivery

+ Own end-to-end service compliance, quality and client satisfaction for all IT services in the metro, against agreed SLAs, OLAs, KPIs and OKRs.

Description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

The US Federal Solutions & Services Team is dedicated to being the premier, compliant provider of high-quality communications solutions, products, and services to the U.S. Federal Government. Driven by a skilled and diverse workforce, this group focuses on building strong customer relationships, driving business growth, and delivering complete customer satisfaction. Within the US Federal Solutions & Services Team, the Secret Service Sustainment Unit manages the global implementation, integration, and servicing of complex mission critical systems. As a Project Manager Operations Consultant/ Circuit Analyst, you will support a broad range of mission-critical communication projects across pre-sale and post-sale phases worldwide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Project Manager Operations Consultant/ Circuit Analyst position is responsible for providing technical and administrative support within the Radio Team and in cooperation with the EIS circuit team of a sensitive Federal customer. The role further includes coordinating operations to include order/initiate provisioning, execute decommissioning, and tracking status of the appropriate voice circuits, data circuits, and POTS lines on time and in accordance with customer procedures. This position reports to the on-site Sr. Mgr. Field Service Team.

  

* Serve as the primary operational liaison between cross-functional internal teams, external stakeholders, enterprise solution providers, and site vendors (including EIS, OCI, and AT&T) to ensure seamless project alignment and communication.
* Direct, coordinate, and schedule site surveys, Technical Transition Units (TTUs), and infrastructure construction activities across project locations to maintain strict project timelines.
* Provide comprehensive root-cause analyses and operational overviews during site outages, collaborating directly with AT&T and OCI Field Technicians for rapid issue resolution.
* Proactively align preventive maintenance schedules with AT&T and OCI teams to safeguard mission-critical circuits and minimize operational disruptions.
* Manage the full lifecycle of circuit-related hardware, coordinating delivery, deployment, stage-gate tracking, and reverse logistics in partnership with USSS points of contact (POCs), site leads, and vendor representatives.
* Deliver high-level administrative oversight for newly onboarded circuit sites, facilitating rigorous documentation reviews and securing required approvals from OCI executive leadership.
* Prepare and present weekly executive status dashboards for OCI leadership regarding the RAD initiative, offering detailed breakdowns of outstanding deliverables, TTUs, and site construction timelines.
* Lead coordination for National Special Security Event (NSSE) circuit requests alongside Field Technicians, serving as OCI's principal point of contact for EIS and AT&T during high-priority operations.
* Maintain and continuously audit the global circuit inventory database, collaborating with the CIO, onsite network engineering teams, and EIS to reconcile data gaps and ensure full record integrity.
* Administer and manage telecom circuits for the communications program by processing, auditing, analyzing, organizing, and correcting telecommunications billing; validating discounts; ensuring accurate department billing; monitoring the disconnection of unused lines and circuits; and reporting to the on-site Senior Manager of the Field Service Team.
* Coordinate operations to order, initiate provisioning for, execute decommissioning of, and track the status of voice circuits, data circuits, and POTS lines in a timely manner and in accordance with USSS procedures.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive circuit tracking spreadsheet covering installed, on-order, awaiting disconnect, or decommissioning stages, capturing key metadata (site identifiers, name, coordinates, address, lessor info, circuit type, circuit ID, A/Z ends, and provider POCs).
* Consult with Sales, Program Managers, the Senior Field Service Team Manager, and additional internal teams to establish strategy, project direction, and execution plans.
* Prepare technical briefings, white papers, financial analyses, business cases, independent research, and technical recommendations for leadership.
* Perform strategic planning and develop near-term, mid-term, and long-term implementation roadmaps.
* Utilize the ServiceNow ticketing platform to efficiently manage, track, and route incoming work requests and operational issues.
* Process contract transition workflows from legacy agreements (e.g., Networx) to the new Enterprise Infrastructure Solutions (EIS) contract.
* Oversee the migration from legacy circuits to modern EIS circuits under federal government oversight and management.
* Assist with daily financial transactions, support budget maintenance for the program office, prepare purchase requisitions, and track financial data calls.
* Assist the program office with the end-to-end development and preparation of procurement packages.

---------------

Does working hard, making history and having fun resonate with your professional lifestyle? Do you like to be creative, solving challenges with innovative ideas? Do you feel passionate about operating secure facilities using structured project management methodologies?  
  
The mission of the Cornerstone - Design, Build, and Operations (DBO) Team to own and drive strategic, operational and tactical initiatives that improve US Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) operations by planning, designing, operating, and managing Remote Management Facilities (RMFs). Our team is looking for an experienced Secure Facility Operations Manager (SFOM). SFOM's lead daily facility operations, security, and continuity of operations (COOP). This role requires someone with strong relationship building skills. Someone who will work with stakeholders on strategic planning/projects.  
  
The SFOM will develop mechanisms to work across various organizations. The SFOM will define and execute plans for facility maintenance of critical infrastructure and other operational components. The SFOM will play a critical role in partnering with a group of diverse teams to meet team and business level objectives. The ideal SFOM will have facility operations, critical infrastructure, and process improvement experience.
  
  
You must be comfortable managing remote project delivery teams. Have the ability to hold technical discussions to troubleshoot project management issues. Be willing to find ways to remove barriers to project success. This position is essential and SFOM's have after hours on-call responsibilities.  
  
This position requires that the candidate selected must be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. The position further requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Manage daily facility operations and customer requests  
Prioritize and execute tasks  
Document writing and presentations up to the director level  
Serve as Facility Manager responsible for developing plans and programs  
Support and develop budgetary requirements for the operation and maintenance of the facility  
Ensure maintenance, alterations and repairs of the facility are complete and correct  
Maintain alternate work location facilities with other SFOM's  
Serve as the primary coordinator of secured facility emergency actions and planning  
Submit work orders, maintain area security, provide escorting when required
  
Develop and maintain facility operations, procedures, and blueprints  
Manage one or more functions for alternate work facilities. Acquisition, maintenance, and disposal phases in support of COOP

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Title: Senior Customer Success Manager

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dubai for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Our ideal candidate will have
  
  

* 7+ years experience working in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Professional Services or other similarly customer-centric role for a technical product (ideally consumption based)
* 4+ years experience being accountable for customer health and revenue realization for a defined book of business/portfolio of accounts for Forbes Global 2000 customers
* A background and passion for advocating on behalf of your customers - this role should act as an extension of our customers team within MongoDB
* A mind for technology - we’ll teach you about MongoDB and databases, but our customers and product are inherently technical and you should have an aptitude and curiosity to learn about those concepts
* The ability to act with a high level of autonomy, you will be expected to take full ownership of your customer portfolio and make key decisions to drive effective customer outcomes; including deciding when to include our executive team or c-suite in customer escalations, how to de-risk or de-escalate customer issues and conflict and advocating to internal teams including sales, professional services, etc
* An entrepreneurial mindset - you will be required to both deviate from established procedure and often build entirely new process or practices to ensure we best serve this customer segment
* A team player approach and passion for collaboration - this role will work with some of our most strategic growth customers so must align closely to Sales, Professional Services, Tech Services, and the broader MDB ecosystem
* Demonstrated continuing technical education (e.g., MongoDB DBA track, hyperscaler certifications)
* Prior exposure to database, cloud, and infrastructure technology is a plus

On a given day in this role you will:
  
  

* Work as a strategic advisor to your customer providing them with guidance on MongoDB best practices and their overall technology strategy; this could include running enablement sessions alone or with another internal MongoDB team members, advising the customer on strategies to optimize their technical environment or current spend with MongoDB, positioning and recommending product features and best practices to accelerate customers time to value and growth
* Guide customers through the customer journey to accelerate their time-to-value from MongoDB, overseeing the technical success plan from committed ARR to active consumption. Includes advising customers on on their deployment health & strategies for operating and maturing their MongoDB environments
* Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks for complex accounts by designing custom remediation plans and implementing best practices to pre-empt critical issues
* Facilitate the resolution of high-stakes customer challenges while identifying strategic opportunities to expand MongoDB usage through optimized technical solutions
* Collect feedback and identify roadblocks from customers to inform internal teams including Product, Professional Services, and Leadership on how MongoDB can build a stronger product and go to market organization
* Act as the link between our customers and product engineering to develop new innovative solutions. You will be key in building the future roadmap of our product by acting as the Product team’s eyes and ears in this field
* De-escalate and resolve critical customer issues and complaints by finding the best possible solution for both the customer and MongoDB; this could include anything from navigating a customer outage that has a financial impact on their business, to helping an application team devise a custom MongoDB solution or implementation for their critical application, no day is the same
* Build and execute account plans to mitigate risk and drive growth 3+ quarters out across your portfolio
* Lead in-person executive business reviews for strategic customers in your portfolio, including interfacing with C-suite executives and other technical leaders to align to business objectives and agree to a mutual success plan
* Work on strategic internal projects to help build the Customer Success program; our expectation is that anyone in this role has strong business acumen and the ability to create and teach best practices, new process, and enablement to the broader organization
* Document all customer interactions in internal systems, including Gainsight and Salesforce.com
* Provide feedback and guidance to leadership on key signals within MongoDB Atlas that indicate healthy or unhealthy customer accounts; as our product evolves, we’ll need to be constantly adjusting our engagement strategies based on these signals, which you’ll be in the best position to identify and share back with internal teams
* Manage the relationship with Sales Leadership and Account Executives in your territory, including reporting on business performance, training on best practices, and rolling out program updates to ensure sales people and leaders are abreast of best practices for interacting with Customer Success
* Forecast expected churn and growth to your senior leadership team
* Help interview, onboard and ramp new team members - as a more senior team member you will have an immediate role in who joins the team
* Act as a leader amongst your peers, running enablement sessions, product certifications and being vocal in team meetings to ensure those around you grow
* Fluent level of Arabic and English

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Title: Director, Technology Operations
Description:
**Director, Technical Operations (Platform)**
**Job Type:**
Permanent Full Time
  
  
**Location:**
Hybrid - Toronto, Ontario
  
  
**Reporting to:**
Chief Technology Officer
  
  
**Salary**
: $160,000 – $190,000 CAD
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Director, Technology Operations owns the operational health of the platforms Goway sells and services travel on: our reservations platform, the infrastructure it runs on, the supplier, air and distribution integrations it depends on, and the automation and data pipelines built around it.
  
  
This is a practice-building role. You will define and own Goway's technical operations discipline: service levels, incident management, change control, observability and operational readiness, and you will make them the standard across our technology organisation. You will work alongside other Technology leaders. You will own the technology operations of our platform. You will have the CTO's mandate and backing to build the practice.
  
  
**What will be your key responsibilities?**
Reliability and service management
  
  

* Define, publish and report service levels and service-level objectives for revenue-critical services, starting with quoting, booking, payment and traveller servicing.
* Own incident management end to end: severity definitions, escalation, incident command, communication during an incident, and post-incident review with corrective actions.
* Own RCA and problem management.
* Own change and release management as a company standard, balancing delivery throughput against change failure rate.
* Build observability sufficient to detect degradation.
* Own disaster recovery and business continuity for platform services, tested and documented on a stated cadence.

Integration and supplier platform operations
  
  

* Monitoring of integration paths, error and failure-rate thresholds, and defined fallback behaviour when a partner degrades.
* Maintain a dependency map of the external platforms our revenue-generating flows rely on, with assessed operational risk and mitigation for each.
* Own operational readiness for new integrations and new product lines entering the platform.
* Own the operational reliability of automation and data pipelines in production.

Platform and cloud operations
  
  

* Day-to-day operation of the AWS and managed hosting infrastructure serving our platform estate: environments, provisioning, patching and lifecycle management.
* Own hosting cost governance: visibility by service, a unit-cost measure, and an annual optimisation target.
* Lead capacity planning against forecast booking and travel volumes.
* Reduce manual, repeatable operational work through automation.
* Address seasonal capacity planning, change freezes and enhanced coverage aligned to our booking and departure peaks and to new product launches.

Vendors, partners and compliance
  
  

* Platform, hosting and integration partner relationships: SLA definition, enforcement and structured performance review.
* Reduce single points of dependency, whether on a vendor or an individual.
* Partner with security on vulnerability management, patch compliance, access control and audit readiness.

Practice leadership and stakeholder engagement
  
  

* Build and maintain a multi-year technical operations roadmap aligned to Goway's growth plans.
* Report operational performance, risk and investment needs to the CTO and executive team in business terms.

**What are we looking for?**
**Required**

* 8 or more years in platform operations, technical operations, infrastructure or site reliability engineering, including 5 or more years in a lead or leadership capacity.
* Demonstrated accountability for the availability and performance of a revenue-critical transactional platform.
* Evidence of having built operational practice where little existed: SLOs, incident management, change control and observability introduced from the ground up, with measurable improvement to show for it.
* Hands-on depth in AWS, including cost management and multi-environment operation.
* Substantial experience operating and governing third-party platforms and integrations, including holding vendors to service levels.
* Ability to set standards and drive adoption across teams.
* Ability to communicate operational risk and performance.

**Preferred**

* Experience stabilising and operationalising new systems.
* Infrastructure-as-code and container orchestration experience.
* AWS Certified DevOps Engineer (Professional), or AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer (Associate). Solutions Architect certifications are welcome, but less relevant to this role than the operations-focused ones.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering or equivalent practical experience.

**What can you expect from Goway?**

* Imagine working for a company where your career feels like an adventure. At Goway, you’ll join a global community that supports one another:
* We offer a competitive salary accompanied by performance incentives, and we place real importance on time away from work, such as paid personal days for when life calls for them and your birthday off each year.
* Our commitment to professional growth means you’ll have access to continuous learning and industry-leading training that keeps you at the forefront of travel innovation.
* You’ll enjoy generous paid time off, including [three] weeks of vacation, [six] personal days, and a dedicated day off to celebrate your birthday.
* Travel is in our DNA, so you’ll enjoy exclusive perks and discounts on worldwide getaways.
* Since we operate across Toronto, Vancouver, Los Angeles, Manila, Sydney, and beyond, you’ll collaborate across cultures and shape a career path that reflects your ambitions.
* Goway is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate differences and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace for everyone. We appreciate every applicant’s interest. Please be advised that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

**How To Apply**
If this role feels like your next step, click "Apply Now" to create your profile, upload your CV, and share a few details about yourself. Our talent team reviews every application, and if your experience aligns with our needs, we will reach out to set up the next step.
  
  
**AI Screening Disclosure**
To help us fairly and efficiently review applications, we use an automated screening process to assess responses to pre-determined questions. This initial step ensures all candidates are evaluated consistently. Qualified applicants will be reviewed by our recruitment team for further consideration.
  
  
**Additional Notes**
Goway Travel Ltd will retain applications, notifications, and records related to this posting for three years, reflecting our commitment to fair and equitable hiring practices.

We will never ask you to install an app during the recruitment process. If you receive a message of this nature, please ignore it and report it to Goway.
  
  
**About Goway**
Founded in Toronto in 1970 by Australian economist Bruce Hodge, Goway has evolved from a one-person dream into a family-owned global leader in tailor-made travel. With our headquarters in Toronto and hubs in Vancouver, Los Angeles, Sydney, and Manila, our team of over 800 talented employees designs travel experiences in more than 115 countries across all seven continents. We’re united by a passion for travel and are committed to doing the right thing: supporting diversity, equity, inclusion, and sustainable tourism that enriches local communities. Whether working remotely or side by side in one of our offices, we operate as one forward-thinking team, transforming wanderlust into life-changing adventures for our fellow Globetrotters. Title: Test Manager | National Digital Services Programme | Doha, Qatar
Description:
**Test Manager | National Digital Services Programme | Doha, Qatar**

6-month contract, then permanent | Onsite

A government ministry in Qatar is building a national citizen-facing super app. It brings services from many government and private-sector bodies into one mobile app. Each release is tested at several levels by different parties. We need one person to make those levels work as a single, joined-up process.

As Test Manager, you will own the test process for the app: the plan, the standards, the evidence and the reporting across all test levels. The delivery vendor runs unit, integration, end-to-end and regression testing, and you set what it must test and show. Your main focus is user acceptance testing (UAT) and the hand-over between levels, so that nothing is tested twice and nothing is missed. You will lead the client’s UAT testers and report to Programme Management.

**What you’ll do**

* Define the test levels, with entry and exit criteria, and keep one test plan per release
* Agree what the vendor tests and what evidence it hands over, review its results before UAT starts, and send work back when the evidence falls short
* Work with the vendor and the hosting team so test environments and masked or synthetic test data are ready on time
* Own the regression pack: decide what is automated and what is manual, keep it current, and make sure it runs before every release
* Make sure end-to-end tests cover complete user journeys, including payments and connections to partner systems
* Plan and lead UAT for each release, and support the representatives of partner organisations as they test and sign off their own services
* Run one defect process across all levels: severity definitions, triage with the vendor and Product Owner, and closure with evidence. Analyse defects that slipped through and tighten the tests.
* Report test status in plain figures, with a readiness recommendation for each service
* Give the Change and Release Manager the test evidence for each release
* Support go-live readiness and the first limited release to real users

**What you’ll bring**

* 7+ years in software testing, including at least 3 years as a test manager or test lead covering more than one test level, on a system delivered by two or more suppliers
* A strong record writing test strategies and plans, and judging when testing is complete enough
* Experience planning and leading UAT with business users who are not professional testers
* A sound grasp of test automation and CI/CD. You can judge a supplier’s automation; you don’t need to write the code.
* Testing experience with mobile apps (iOS and Android), web services and APIs
* Jira or a similar tool (Xray, Zephyr, Azure DevOps Test Plans)
* Experience leading testers and getting results from several suppliers and organisations with different priorities
* Clear written and spoken English, including reports for non-technical readers
* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, engineering or a related field

**Nice to have**

* Testing government, regulated-sector or payment services
* ISTQB Foundation or Advanced Test Manager
* Arabic

* Onsite at the client’s premises in Doha
* Extended or weekend hours may be needed in the weeks before go-live
* The role involves confidential government test data

**What You'll Be Doing**
Nationwide CCTV Deployment Planning and Coordination
  
  

* Lead program level planning, mobilization, and delivery coordination for the nationwide CCTV deployment program within the agreed PMO scope.
* Develop and maintain the technical workstream delivery plan, including scope, milestones, dependencies, resources, risks, costs, and benefits, and provide validated updates to the integrated program baseline maintained by the Program Manager – PMO Governance and Controls.
* Coordinate technical workstreams covering CCTV infrastructure, command-and-control platforms, connectivity, data storage, monitoring, analytics, cybersecurity, and systems integration.
* Define deployment models, implementation phases, site prioritization criteria, rollout sequencing, and readiness requirements.

Regulatory and Operational Framework Development
  
  

* Coordinate the development of regulatory compliance and operational frameworks required to support the CCTV program with the responsible client and specialist owners.
* Define policies, procedures, standards, controls, roles, responsibilities, and approval mechanisms for CCTV deployment and operation.
* Ensure that program activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, privacy requirements, data protection principles, cybersecurity standards, and government policies.
* Develop operating models covering surveillance operations, monitoring, incident management, access controls, data retention, evidence handling, system maintenance, and service support.
* Establish operational readiness criteria, service management processes, escalation routes, and performance requirements.
* Coordinate with legal, regulatory, cybersecurity, data protection, law enforcement, and operational stakeholders.
* Support the development of regulatory submissions, technical standards, operating procedures, compliance controls, and assurance documentation.
* Establish mechanisms for ongoing compliance monitoring, audit readiness, risk management, and continuous improvement.

Technical Laboratory Establishment and Operational Readiness
  
  

* Lead program-level planning and coordination for establishing the client’s technical laboratory as an innovation, testing, demonstration, and operational readiness environment.
* Define the Lab’s purpose, scope, capabilities, governance model, operating procedures, and success measures.
* Develop requirements for Lab infrastructure, systems, equipment, connectivity, cybersecurity, data environments, and testing capabilities.
* Coordinate and monitor the program plans, interfaces, and readiness evidence for the design, procurement, installation, integration, testing, and commissioning of Lab facilities and technology by the appointed delivery entities.
* Establish processes for proof-of-concept testing, solution validation, interoperability assessment, demonstrations, training, and technology evaluation.
* Develop the Lab operating model, including staffing, support, maintenance, access management, health and safety, and asset management.
* Coordinate operational readiness reviews, track readiness evidence and outstanding actions, and support formal acceptance of the Lab by the authorized client and operational owners before launch.
* Develop a roadmap for future Lab capabilities, innovation partnerships, vendor engagement, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure that lessons learned and validated technical standards are incorporated into the wider CCTV deployment program

Procurement and Market Engagement
  
  

* activities, and market engagement.
* Coordinate the development and specialist review of technical requirements, statements of work, specifications, evaluation criteria, service levels, and acceptance criteria with the responsible technical owners.
* Support market sounding, supplier briefings, requests for information, requests for proposals, tenders, and competitive dialogue activities.
* Engage with technology vendors, system integrators, telecommunications providers, infrastructure partners, consultants, and specialist service providers.
* Assess market capability, technology maturity, supplier capacity, delivery risks, and commercial models.
* Participate in supplier evaluation, clarification sessions, negotiations, due diligence, and recommendation processes.
* Ensure procurement packages are aligned with the program roadmap, regulatory framework, operating model, and commercial objectives.
* Support contract mobilization, supplier governance, performance management, change control, and issue resolution.
* Monitor supplier delivery against contractual requirements, milestones, quality standards, and key performance indicators

Program Governance, Controls, and Reporting
  
  

* Apply the program governance, controls, reporting, and escalation framework established by the Program Manager – PMO Governance and Controls, and lead the corresponding technical assurance and operational readiness arrangements.
* Prepare technical delivery inputs to program board papers, steering committee materials, executive reports, dashboards, and delivery updates.
* Monitor program performance across scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, issues, dependencies, benefits, and operational readiness.
* Maintain technical workstream registers, including risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, decisions, changes, actions, and lessons learned, and provide updates to the consolidated program records.
* Lead technical and operational readiness reviews and provide the technical evidence and recommendations required for program stage gates, assurance reviews, and health checks.
* Ensure that decisions and actions are documented, assigned, tracked, and escalated where necessary.
* Provide clear recommendations to senior leadership on program priorities, risks, options, and corrective actions.
* Ensure program documentation is complete, accurate, current, and compliant with governance requirements.
* Distinguishes ownership of the PMO governance framework and integrated baseline from Technical Delivery’s technical assurance, readiness reviews, and delivery inputs.

Stakeholder and Cross-Functional Leadership
  
  

* Build strong relationships with government stakeholders, regulators, internal business units, suppliers, technology partners, and operational teams.
* Lead cross-functional workshops and facilitate alignment between technical, operational, commercial, regulatory, and procurement stakeholders.
* Manage competing priorities and resolve complex program-level issues.
* Communicate technical and program information clearly to both specialist and non-specialist audiences.
* Support stakeholder engagement, change management, communications, training, and adoption activities.
* Represent the program at internal and external forums, industry events, supplier meetings, and governance committees.

**What Required Skills You'll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, information technology, project management, telecommunications, business, or a related discipline.
* 20 experience managing complex technical programs, preferably involving large-scale technology deployment, security systems, smart infrastructure, telecommunications, or public-sector transformation.
* Demonstrated experience leading nationwide, multi-site, or multi-stakeholder implementation programs.
* Experience developing technical and operational frameworks, governance models, standards, and operating procedures.
* Experience defining and commercializing technology-enabled services or service bundles.
* Experience establishing technical laboratories, innovation centers, testing environments, or operational readiness facilities.
* Strong understanding of procurement, supplier engagement, tendering, technical evaluation, and contract mobilization.
* Experience working with CCTV, video management systems, command-and-control platforms, IoT, analytics, artificial intelligence, networking, cloud, cybersecurity, or related technologies.
* Proven experience managing program budgets, schedules, risks, dependencies, vendors, and delivery performance.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring**

* Program or project management certification, such as PMP, PgMP, MSP, PRINCE2, or equivalent.
* Degree or professional qualification in engineering, technology, cybersecurity, telecommunications, or systems integration.
* Experience in physical security, surveillance, smart cities, critical infrastructure, public safety, or government technology programs.
* Experience with privacy, data protection, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and information governance.
* Experience with commercialization, product management, service design, or business development.
* Experience managing major systems integrators and technology vendors.
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture, systems engineering, service management, and operational technology environments.
* Experience with Agile, waterfall, hybrid, or scaled program delivery methodologies.

* Manage staffing, workload allocation, scheduling, and coverage to support business volumes and service commitments.

* Monitor operational performance through scorecards, service levels, productivity measures, quality results, and other relevant indicators.

Title: Manager, Operations Integration Subways
Description:
**Job Description**
Metrolinx is connecting communities across the Greater Golden Horseshoe. Metrolinx operates GO Transit and UP Express, as well as the PRESTO fare payment system. We are also building new and improved rapid transit, including GO Expansion, Light Rail Transit routes, and major expansions to Toronto’s subway system, to get people where they need to go, better, faster and easier. Metrolinx is an agency of the Government of Ontario.
  
  
At Metrolinx, equity, diversity and inclusion are essential to living our values of serving with passion, thinking forward and playing as a team.
  
  
The Manager, Operations Integration – Subways plays a key role in ensuring the safe, reliable and efficient delivery of subway and LRT services. The position provides operational, technical and functional oversight of operator, maintainer and project agreements across the subway and LRT programs, supporting high-quality, customer-focused transportation services that are safe, timely and delivered in accordance with contractual requirements.
  
  
**What will I be doing?**

* Oversee the planning, coordination and delivery of subway and LRT services, ensuring safe, effective and efficient customer movement, service levels, schedules and operational plans align with Metrolinx strategies and organizational objectives.
* Manage operator, contractor and maintainer performance against service level plans, contractual obligations and KPIs; identify non-compliance, implement mitigation and corrective action strategies, and ensure quality assurance and continuous service improvement.
* Lead the development, implementation and monitoring of operational plans, management programs, policies, procedures, workflows, SOPs and performance measures in consultation with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable safety, regulatory, legal and contractual requirements through audits, monitoring, risk assessments and engagement with regulatory bodies, while incorporating industry best practices and emerging issues.
* Prepare and deliver executive-level reports, presentations and operational studies outlining service performance, KPIs, strategic directions, findings and improvement initiatives to Metrolinx leadership and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate operational activities across Metrolinx departments and business units, providing transportation expertise and input into major service improvement projects, service extensions, operational planning and negotiations with internal partners.
* Represent Metrolinx on contractual, operational and transportation development matters with service providers, contractors, consultants, industry associations, government representatives and other external partners.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, partners, vendors and government representatives through ongoing communication, consultation, negotiation and issue resolution.
* Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement by researching, recommending and implementing new or revised standards, specifications, processes and procedures that enhance efficiency, customer service, design standards and safety.
* Manage departmental activities, service delivery objectives and budgetary requirements while providing leadership, guidance and constructive feedback to contractors, consultants and partners, ensuring appropriate resources, capabilities, performance standards and positive working relationships.

**What Skills and Qualifications Do I Need?**

* Completion of a degree in Business, Engineering or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
* Demonstrated years' of progressively responsible experience in the transportation and/or public transit sector, including leadership of frontline staff and/or project management, ideally within the public sector.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is considered an asset. A Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation is also an asset but not required.
* Demonstrated leadership and interpersonal competencies, including service-focused and transformational leadership, effective communication, sound decision-making, delivering results, building high-performance cultures, energizing teams, personal effectiveness and alignment with organizational values.
* Knowledge of applicable Human Resources legislation, including the Employment Standards Act and Occupational Health and Safety Act, as well as railway operating rules and legislation governing railway, environmental, public and employee safety.
* Strong knowledge of transportation, engineering and planning, including commuter rapid transit (subway, LRT and BRT) system planning, design and delivery, maintenance facilities, stations, storage yards and related infrastructure.
* Understanding of transit system functional requirements and technical components, including signalling and train control, SCADA, communications, trackwork, vehicle and wayside interfaces, traction power, power supply and distribution, mechanical systems, system and train simulation, tunnels, and fire and life safety systems.
* Knowledge of System Safety Certification processes and the ability to identify technical inadequacies, evaluate plans and apply appropriate rail transportation analytical tools.
* Demonstrated experience managing, mentoring and developing employees and contractors, applying collective agreement provisions, overseeing vendors and externally provided services, monitoring contractual performance, and understanding IT capabilities and budget planning and monitoring processes.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint), with strong written, verbal, interpersonal and presentation skills, including the ability to prepare reports and communicate operational studies, findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.

**There will be multiple vacancies for this position, and the**
**recruitment for this requisition may be used to fill future permanent roles with substantially similar requirements.**
***This role requires the successful candidate to be at the office, f**
**ive days per week, with regular travel throughout the Toronto area (at least twice weekly), availability outside regular business hours to maintain relationships and address operational issues, and site visits to transit operating environments, including train facilities and above- and below-grade track alignments. Personal protective equipment (PPE) is required at worksites.***
**Don’t Meet Every Requirement?**
If you’re excited about working with Metrolinx but your past experience doesn’t quite align with every qualification of this posting, we encourage you to apply. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles. We are always looking for great talent to join our team.
  
  
We invite all interested individuals to apply and encourage applications from members of equity-deserving communities, including those who identify as Indigenous, Black, racialized, women, people with disabilities, and people with diverse gender identities, expressions and sexual orientations.
  
  
**Accommodation**
Metrolinx is an equal opportunity employer and committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. We are also committed to offering reasonable accommodation to job applicants in accordance with applicable legislation. If you require assistance or an accommodation at any point during the hiring process, please contact us at: 416-202-5601 or email hr.recruitment@metrolinx.com.
  
  
**Application Process**
All applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada. Metrolinx will be using email to communicate with you for all job competitions. It is your responsibility to include an updated email address that is checked daily and accepts emails from unknown users. As we send time-sensitive correspondence, we recommend that you check your email regularly. If no response is received, we will assume you are no longer interested in pursuing the opportunity. Please be advised that a Criminal Record Check may be required of the successful candidate.
  
  
For Internal applicants, with the recent implementation of the Internal Mobility Policy, the internal recruitment process has changed for non-union roles. Candidates must be in their current role for 12 months prior to applying for another role and each applicant must be in good standing (not participating in a Performance Improvement Plan). Please review all provisions of the policy before submitting your application.
  
  
Should it be determined that any background information provided is misleading, inaccurate or incorrect, Metrolinx reserves the right to discontinue with the consideration of your application.
  
  
We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted.

Title: Risk Operations and Visibility Manager
Description:

**Description:**

  

The Risk Operations and Visibility Manager position is part of the Information Security Governance Risk and Compliance (GRC) team and will focus on the Risk Operations and Visibility function. This position will be responsible for monitoring and analyzing findings from vulnerability management and attack surface management tools to identify, prioritize, and track information security exposures across the University's environment and consolidating findings from multiple technical sources into a unified risk view of the University's threat landscape.

  

The incumbent shall possess advance knowledge of IT security tools and technologies amidst a continually evolving threat landscape and to apply such knowledge in evaluating the performance of the operational security risks by producing clear, actionable reporting and risk narratives for technical and non-technical stakeholders, including academic and administrative leadership. They will liaise with distributed IT teams across faculties and divisions to support timely remediation and closure of identified exposures and vulnerabilities while researching, recommending, and supporting the use of software and tools for vulnerability management, attack surface management, and risk reporting to build the internal expertise and function of risk operations and visibility management.

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

  

EDUCATION:

  

* University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information security, or equivalent combination of education and experience. A relevant certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+, GIAC GSEC, CRISC, or equivalent) is an strong asset

  

EXPERIENCE:

  

* Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in creating, implementing, and maintaining Information Security management programs with a broad range of platforms and technologies
* In-depth knowledge of Information Security controls applicable for web applications, cloud, IoT, mobile applications, networks, and servers
* Minimum 3 years experience performing security assessments of infrastructure (cloud and on-premises), applications and websites
* Minimum 3 years experience working with vulnerability management lifecycle concepts (discovery, scanning, validation, prioritization, remediation tracking) and CVSS/exploitability-based scoring (e.g., EPSS); ability to interpret output from vulnerability scanning tools (e.g., Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7) and attack surface management / cyber security posture management tools (e.g. Falcon, etc.)
* Understanding of Information Security and Risk Management frameworks like ISO27001, ISO27005, NIST CSF and NIST 800-30
* Deep understanding of exposure management and external attack surface management processes
* Experience in grouping individual vulnerabilities and risks for overall reporting purposes
* Experience in threat monitoring and threat intelligence
* Familiarity with legal and regulatory requirements like PCI-DSS, PIPEDA, PHIPA, GDPR etc

  

SKILLS:

  

* Able to think strategically about change and new solutions
* Strong writing, communication, presentation and interpersonal skills with the ability to produce high quality, comprehensive communications materials and articulate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Strong leadership and problem-solving skills
* Ability to prioritize and reprioritize work as required
* Adept at conforming to shifting priorities, demands and timelines
* Ability to work both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment
* Proficiency with data analytics and data aggregation; experience with BI/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and basic scripting (Python, PowerShell) is an asset
* Thirst for knowledge, self-education, and research
* Strong organizational skills in planning and task coordination

  

OTHER:

  

Ability to work under pressure of high volume and expectations, while meeting multiple deadlines for multiple projects; strong service orientation coupled with ability to recognize and assess the operational significance of a problem, control/mitigate the risk, and set priorities accordingly. Strong ability to assess risks and controls of computing systems and operations. Demonstrated broad knowledge of information technology, instructional technology, classroom technology, audiovisual technologies, digital signage, network technologies, databases, and application development. Strong ability and willingness to work effectively as a team leader and team member; must be able to collaborate and cooperate with team members, project sponsors, other stakeholders. Ability to lead team members of varying levels and skill sets including Professional/Managerial as well as staff. Must be able to deal calmly and effectively with a variety of people. Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, tact, and diplomacy. Ability to effectively navigate a professional and political climate including assessing the requirement to escalate and issue to more senior levels of management or resources or bodies outside the Faculty; ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality. Ability and willingness to learn new systems, technologies and project management methods and tools.

The Delivery Manager owns the successful delivery of multiple projects, leading teams to deliver high-quality software solutions and achieve client outcomes. The role combines effective leadership, client-facing engagement, and Agile methodologies with a collaborative, product-thinking approach. As a trusted advisor, the Delivery Manager cultivates client relationships, identifies business opportunities, and drives delivery excellence and exceptional client experiences.
  
  
Position Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead project teams to deliver high-quality services within agreed timeframes and budgets, proactively managing risks and maintaining project RAID logs.
* Serve as the primary client contact throughout the product development life cycle. Manage delivery across that lifecycle by coordinating work and fostering collaboration across functional teams.
* Define business outcomes through working with stakeholders to establish measurable goals and key performance indicators (KPIs) that align with strategic priorities.
* Coordinate delivery across multiple projects, working with stakeholders to align priorities, managing cross-project dependencies, and resolving competing resource requirements.
* Manage milestones and realistic timelines by developing detailed project plans with phased deliverables, dependencies, and resource requirements.
* Provide regular stakeholder updates on milestones, budgets, risks, and progress toward agreed business outcomes. Use these updates to maintain transparency, inform delivery decisions, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement and client expansion.
* Own project backlogs, keeping delivery work aligned with agreed project goals. Apply Agile and Scrum methodologies to organize and guide delivery toward those goals.
* Work with AI-enabled, high-velocity delivery teams, collaborating closely across engineering, product, design, and QA to define and achieve project goals.

**Required Experience, Skills, Knowledge And Expertise**
The following qualifications are required unless explicitly identified as preferred.
  
  

* 7+ Years of project management experience with progressive responsibility and complexity in projects being delivered.
* Experience in Agile consulting environments, with a proven track record of delivering high-quality software solutions.
* Proven experience leading complex, multi-phase engagements in the software development industry, including delivery planning and execution.
* Exceptional communication, management, and client engagement skills, demonstrated through aligning stakeholders around project goals; strong problem-solving and systems thinking skills applied to complex delivery challenges.
