Title: IT Project Manager
Description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**IT Project Manager – ERP & E-Invoicing Implementation**

**Job Title:** IT Project Manager  
**Department:** Information Technology / Project Management  
**Location:** UAE  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years (preferred)  
**Reporting To:** Head of IT / Director / Management

**1. Job Purpose**

We are looking for a proactive, organized, and results-oriented IT Project Manager to plan, coordinate, execute, and deliver IT implementation projects, particularly in the areas of ERP systems, e-invoicing, ERP add-on solutions, business process automation, and other technology-driven initiatives.

The candidate will be responsible for managing projects from initiation through completion, acting as the primary coordination point between clients, management, functional consultants, technical teams, and external vendors.

The ideal candidate should possess excellent project management, client relationship management, communication, scheduling, and reporting skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and ensure delivery within agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Project Planning & Execution**

* Develop comprehensive project plans, implementation schedules, milestones, and delivery timelines.
* Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, resource requirements, and responsibilities.
* Coordinate and manage end-to-end implementation projects, including ERP implementations, e-invoicing solutions, ERP add-ons, and system integrations.
* Monitor project progress against agreed timelines and ensure timely completion of milestones.
* Identify potential project risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and delays and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure appropriate allocation and utilization of project resources.
* Manage multiple client projects simultaneously.

**B. Client Coordination & Relationship Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients throughout the project lifecycle.
* Conduct project kick-off meetings and coordinate discussions with client stakeholders.
* Understand client requirements and coordinate with functional and technical teams to ensure proper execution.
* Schedule client meetings, workshops, review sessions, and follow-up discussions.
* Maintain regular communication with clients regarding project progress, pending activities, issues, and deliverables.
* Follow up with clients for data, documents, approvals, access credentials, and other implementation requirements.
* Manage client expectations and ensure a positive project delivery experience.

**C. ERP Implementation & System Integration**

* Coordinate ERP implementation, customization, enhancement, and integration projects.
* Work closely with functional consultants, developers, database administrators, and third-party vendors.
* Monitor requirement gathering, solution design, configuration, development, testing, UAT, and deployment activities.
* Coordinate data migration, system integration, user training, and post-implementation support.
* Ensure proper documentation of business requirements, functional specifications, testing results, and project sign-offs.

**D. Meetings, Scheduling & Follow-ups**

* Organize and schedule internal and external project meetings.
* Prepare meeting agendas and circulate them to relevant stakeholders.
* Record meeting minutes (MoM), action points, responsibilities, and target completion dates.
* Follow up with respective team members and clients to ensure closure of pending action items.
* Maintain project calendars and ensure that all important milestones and meetings are scheduled in advance.

**E. Project Monitoring & Reporting**

* Prepare and circulate weekly and monthly project progress reports to management and clients.
* Maintain project trackers covering milestones, deliverables, pending tasks, dependencies, and completion status.
* Monitor project timelines and highlight delays or deviations.
* Prepare management dashboards highlighting project status, risks, issues, and resource utilization.
* Escalate critical issues and seek management intervention wherever necessary.
* Ensure timely submission and approval of project deliverables.

**F. Documentation & Quality Management**

* Maintain project documentation, including:
* Project Charter and Project Plan.
* Requirement Gathering Documents.
* Meeting Minutes and Action Trackers.
* Project Milestone and Progress Reports.
* Risk and Issue Registers.
* Testing and UAT Sign-off Documents.
* Go-Live and Project Closure Reports.
* Ensure proper documentation and handover of completed projects to support teams.
* Coordinate hypercare and post-go-live support activities.

**G. UAE E-Invoicing Project Management – (preferable)**

* Coordinate e-invoicing and similar implementation projects.
* Understand the overall e-invoicing framework, Peppol architecture, PINT AE specifications, and relevant FTA/MoF requirements.
* Coordinate with clients to understand their existing invoicing processes, ERP systems, and business requirements.
* Plan and monitor ERP integration, e-invoice configuration, testing, validation, and go-live activities.
* Coordinate with technical teams, ERP consultants, and Accredited Service Providers (ASPs), where applicable.
* Track implementation issues, functional gaps, testing results, and resolution timelines.
* Ensure that project deliverables are completed in accordance with agreed regulatory and implementation requirements.

**3. Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of experience in IT project management, ERP implementation, or IT consulting.
* Experience managing multiple client-facing implementation projects.
* Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or other business management solutions.
* Exposure to e-invoicing implementation, system integration, or digital transformation projects will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of UAE VAT and the UAE e-invoicing framework will be an added advantage.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or other project management certifications will be preferred.

**4. Required Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent project planning and execution skills.
* Strong client coordination and stakeholder management abilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong organizational, scheduling, and follow-up capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
* Good problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Strong reporting and presentation skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and MS Project or equivalent project management tools.
* Familiarity with Jira, Trello, Monday.com, Asana, or similar project tracking tools.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and commitment to project deadlines.

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The candidate's performance will be evaluated based on:

* **Project Delivery:** Percentage of projects completed within agreed timelines.
* **Milestone Achievement:** Timely completion of project milestones and deliverables.
* **Client Satisfaction:** Client feedback and satisfaction levels.
* **Project Reporting:** Timely submission of project progress reports and status updates.
* **Issue Resolution:** Effective tracking and closure of project issues and action items.
* **Meeting Management:** Effective scheduling, documentation, and follow-up of meetings.
* **Project Documentation:** Completeness and accuracy of project documentation.
* **Resource Coordination:** Effective coordination and utilization of internal and external resources.
* **Go-Live Management:** Successful coordination of testing, deployment, and go-live activities.

**6. Preferred Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should be a hands-on project manager who can independently manage day-to-day project activities without requiring continuous supervision.

The candidate must be comfortable interacting with senior client management, coordinating with technical and functional teams, managing implementation schedules, preparing progress reports, and ensuring that all stakeholders remain aligned with project objectives.

Experience in an IT consulting or software implementation company, particularly in ERP and e-invoicing projects, will be highly preferred.

Pay: AED5,900.00 - AED25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Make every client feel valued, supported, and confident in working with Zentrela. Build lasting relationships through excellent communication, responsiveness, and reliable service.

**2. Keep Our Research Team Connected, Organized, and Happy**

Help our research team collaborate effectively, stay organized, meet deadlines, and enjoy a positive, supportive working environment.

**3. Help Our Business Team Build More Partnerships**

Support our executives and business development team with the coordination, communication, documentation, and follow-up activities required to develop new business relationships and strengthen existing ones.

* Serve as the main operational point of contact for clients.
* Build strong, positive, and lasting client relationships.
* Proactively communicate project updates, timelines, next steps, and deliverables.
* Respond promptly to client questions, requests, and concerns.
* Resolve misunderstandings and coordinate solutions to client-related issues.
* Ensure clients consistently receive an exceptional experience.

* Coordinate team activities to ensure responsibilities are clear and tasks are completed correctly and on time.
* Track research project milestones, deadlines, deliverables, and outstanding tasks.

* Identify and resolve logistical, operational, and communication challenges.
* Help maintain a collaborative, positive, and supportive team environment.
* Coordinate complex schedules, meetings, resources, and operational logistics.
* Keep everyone informed and aligned on priorities, progress, and next steps.

* Prepare and coordinate agreements, contracts, NDAs, and other business documentation for review and signature.
* Schedule client meetings, internal meetings, and video calls.
* Prepare and send client invoices, monitor payments, and follow up on outstanding balances.
* Coordinate vendor registration and onboarding within clients' procurement systems.
* Process authorized payments to suppliers and service providers.
* Purchase equipment, materials, and supplies needed by our team.
* Maintain organized administrative records, documents, and operational systems.
* Support day-to-day administrative needs of the executive and research teams.

**Business Development & Partnership Support**

* Support our business development team in building and maintaining relationships with prospects, partners, and existing clients.
* Coordinate introductory calls, follow-up meetings, and partner communications.
* Track business development activities and ensure agreed next steps are completed.
* Assist with preparing, organizing, and coordinating proposals, agreements, and other commercial documents.
* Help ensure prospects and partners receive prompt, professional, and thoughtful service.

Who We're Looking For

You're someone who genuinely enjoys helping people and naturally takes responsibility for making things happen.

**You have proven experience and confidence in:**

* **Excellent communication:**
  Communicating clearly, warmly, professionally, and proactively with clients, executives, and team members.
* **Outstanding planning and organization:**
  Managing multiple projects, deadlines, people, and priorities without losing track of important details.

  Coordinating people, setting expectations, resolving obstacles, and ensuring work is completed correctly and on time.

  Understanding people, demonstrating empathy, handling difficult conversations, and resolving interpersonal challenges constructively.
* **Problem-solving:**
  Taking initiative, making sound decisions, and finding practical solutions under pressure.
* **Business administration:**
  Managing documentation, scheduling, invoicing, vendors, procurement, and other operational responsibilities.
* **Digital communication:**
  Being highly comfortable with frequent, real-time communication through instant messaging, calls, email, and video meetings.

Communication & Availability

This role requires someone who enjoys working in a highly collaborative, responsive, and fast-moving environment.

You must be fully comfortable using instant messaging and calls as primary communication tools and maintaining strong availability throughout agreed working hours to assist the executive, research, and business development teams.

Occasional flexibility outside regular working hours may be required to support time-sensitive activities, with appropriate scheduling and arrangements.

* Our clients are delighted with Zentrela's professionalism, responsiveness, and service.

* Operational and administrative activities are completed accurately and on time.

* Our business development team receives reliable support to build and strengthen commercial relationships.

**Above all:**
we're looking for someone who combines excellent communication, exceptional planning and organizational skills, dependable responsiveness, and a genuine passion for helping people.

Experience

Title: IT Operations Lead
Description:
***About SJC***

*SJC*
stands as Canada’s largest privately owned communications company, distinguished by its portfolio of leading media brands, including Toronto Life, Chatelaine, and Maclean’s. At SJC, creativity, technology and journalism intersect to deliver content that resonates and performs. From integrated creative studios and advanced ad-tech to a portfolio of iconic media brands, we craft and distribute award-winning stories for audiences and advertisers alike. Our influence—and a 22-year streak on Canada’s Best Managed Companies list—reflects a culture committed to excellence and constant evolution. To learn more about our organization, please visit www.stjoseph.com

***About the Role***

Our IT team is seeking an IT Operations Lead to manage the people and systems that keep our infrastructure, network, and endpoints secure, reliable, and well maintained. This is a player-coach role: you'll manage and grow a small IT team while remaining hands-on as our Tier 3 escalation point for the more complex issues that come up day to day. The role touches on-prem server administration, networking, cloud infrastructure, and endpoint management, with a strong emphasis on cybersecurity readiness—including planning and running tabletop exercises that stress-test our incident response. We're also looking for someone who brings an automation-first mindset, encouraging the use of AI tools and scripting to reduce manual toil across on-prem and cloud environments. You'll work closely with the Director, Engineering & Technology and other stakeholders across the business to set IT priorities, develop your team, and keep our people prepared for whatever comes next.

***What You'll Do in this Role:***

* Lead, mentor, and develop a small IT team, setting priorities, running performance and growth conversations, and building the team's on-call and incident response capabilities.
* Own Tier 3 escalations: stepping in on the trickier infrastructure, networking, and security issues that Tier 1/2 support can't resolve.
* Oversee on-prem server infrastructure, corporate networking, cloud infrastructure and identity, and endpoint management, ensuring these are reliable, secure, and well maintained (working with vendors or MSPs where deep specialist support is needed).
* Champion the organization's cybersecurity posture, including access management, patching cadence, and backup/recovery practices.
* Plan and facilitate cybersecurity tabletop exercises to test and improve incident response readiness across IT and the broader business.
* Enforce support standards and processes and hold the team accountable to them.
* Assist the Director in evaluating external vendors and managed service providers.
* Encourage and guide the adoption of AI tools and automation/scripting to streamline IT operations, user management, and security monitoring.
* Collaborate with production, facilities, and business stakeholders to support office and infrastructure needs.
* Ensure documentation, systems, and runbooks are kept current to support consistency and knowledge sharing across the team.
* Other duties as assigned.

***Our ideal candidate:***

* Experienced IT generalist with solid working knowledge of on-prem server environments and enterprise networks, and a genuine interest in staying hands-on with day-to-day technical problems.
* Proven team-lead experience coaching and developing IT staff; 1-2+ years management experience. 4+ years contributing consistently on modern IT teams.
* Some hands-on exposure to cybersecurity practices, and comfortable planning or facilitating tabletop exercises and incident response discussions.
* Working familiarity with cloud infrastructure and identity/access management concepts (provisioning/deprovisioning, access reviews, conditional access).
* Comfortable overseeing endpoint fleets (Windows/MacOS) with the help of standard endpoint management tools.
* Enthusiastic about using AI tools and automation/scripting to make IT operations more efficient, even if not a deep scripting expert.
* Clear communicator who can explain technical risk and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including leadership.
* Comfortable with balancing hands-on Tier 3 work with people management, planning, and strategic responsibilities.

***Your Skills Include:***

* On-prem & networking: General comfort administering Windows Server and/or Linux environments and troubleshooting LAN/WAN, VPN, and firewall issues.
* Cloud & identity: Working knowledge of a major cloud provider (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and identity/access tools (e.g., Active Directory/Entra ID, SSO).
* Endpoint management: Familiarity with common endpoint management tools (e.g., Microsoft Intune, JAMF, SCCM) for provisioning and securing devices.
* Cybersecurity: General understanding of incident response planning, tabletop exercise facilitation, and security best practices.
* AI & automation: Interest and some experience in using AI tools or scripting/automation platforms to streamline IT operations.
* Service management: Experience with ticketing/ITSM tools, SLA design, and Tier 1–3 support structures.
* People leadership: Demonstrated experience managing, mentoring, or leading IT staff, including performance management and team development.
* Education: A bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

Title: Senior Delivery Manager - Enterprise Workflow & AI Transformation (PL6441)
Description:
### **Role Summary**

Paralucent is seeking a Senior Delivery Manager to lead a multi-workstream enterprise modernization program in financial services. You will turn an established future-state vision into an executable roadmap, coordinate business and technology teams, manage dependencies and controls, and guide incremental releases through testing, approval, deployment and stabilization.

This role is for a hands-on leader who creates clarity, raises risks early and keeps teams focused on measurable outcomes.

### **What You'll Do**

* Own the integrated delivery plan across business process, user experience, workflow/case management, integrations, AI/document intelligence, security, testing and release workstreams.
* Translate program outcomes into increments, milestones, release plans, dependencies, decision points and acceptance evidence.
* Operate within an Agile or hybrid enterprise delivery model, including backlog readiness, sprint/release planning, demonstrations, retrospectives and production governance.
* Maintain disciplined RAID, decision, change, action and dependency management; surface material issues early with options and recommendations.
* Coordinate architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, records management, Responsible AI, operations and production-readiness reviews.
* Manage client and Paralucent governance, status reporting, financial tracking, forecasting, resource planning and milestone acceptance.
* Ensure requirements-to-test-to-evidence traceability and that no prototype is represented as production-ready.
* Plan cutover, pilot, hypercare, transition-to-support and progressive knowledge transfer.
* Create a high-accountability team environment with clear owners, due dates and escalation paths.

### **What Success Looks Like**

* A credible integrated plan, governance cadence and decision model are operating early.
* Milestones are achieved with transparent scope, budget, quality and risk reporting.
* Dependencies on enterprise teams and legacy-system owners are identified before they block delivery.
* Working end-to-end increments reach pilot and production with complete approval and test evidence.
* Operational teams are prepared to adopt, support and improve the solution after launch.

* 8+ years leading enterprise software, digital transformation or workflow/case-management delivery, including several years in senior delivery or program leadership.
* Demonstrated success delivering complex solutions into production in banking, financial services or another highly regulated industry.
* Strong command of Agile delivery, release planning, dependency management, change control, financial management and executive reporting.
* Experience coordinating architecture, security, privacy, records, compliance, operations and technology stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple vendors, distributed teams and cross-functional workstreams without losing end-to-end accountability.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including concise executive reporting and difficult escalation conversations.
* Practical understanding of cloud applications, enterprise integration, workflow, AI governance and production-readiness controls.

### **Preferred Experience**

* Experience with Canadian banking environments and enterprise risk/governance processes.
* Experience delivering high-volume operational workflow, document-processing or regulated case-management solutions.
* PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum, SAFe or comparable delivery certification.
* Experience using EOS-style scorecards, clear seat accountability and issue-solving disciplines.

### **Role Scorecard: Illustrative Measures**

*Final targets and cadence will be confirmed for the specific assignment. Typical measures include:*

* Milestone predictability and release readiness
* Budget and capacity variance
* Age and closure rate of critical RAID items
* Decision and dependency turnaround
* Defect escape and production-stability trends
* Stakeholder confidence and acceptance timeliness
* Knowledge-transfer and operational-readiness completion

### **How You Demonstrate Our Core Values**

**Driven:** Moves important work forward, recovers quickly from blockers and focuses on meaningful outcomes.

**Takes Ownership:** Closes loops, communicates risks early and remains accountable across handoffs.

**Creative Problem Solver:** Clarifies the real problem and proposes practical options with trade-offs.

**Humbly Confident:** Brings sound judgment, explains reasoning and actively invites challenge and feedback.

**Customer Centric:** Understands operational reality, success measures and the impact of decisions on users and the institution.

Title: Program Manager

Description:
**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.**
At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
  
  
Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.
  
  
**This role is open to candidates based in either Dubai or Riyadh.**
**Role Summary**
The Program Manager is responsible for leading Genesys’ largest, most complex and strategically important customer engagements while providing governance and delivery oversight across the regional project portfolio.
  
  
The Program Manager serves as the senior point of accountability and escalation for project delivery within the region. The role ensures that engagements are delivered to consistent Genesys standards, achieve the customer’s intended business outcomes, maintain strong customer and executive confidence, and meet Genesys revenue, margin and financial-performance objectives.
  
  
Working across Professional Services, Sales, Customer Success, Solution Engineering, Product, Support, partners and customer leadership teams, the Program Manager creates the alignment, governance and executive focus required to deliver complex transformation programs successfully.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic and Mega-Engagement Leadership**

* Lead Genesys’ largest and most complex customer programs from initiation through deployment, adoption, value realization and transition to ongoing Customer Success.
* Establish the overall program vision, governance model, delivery strategy, integrated roadmap and measurable success criteria.
* Coordinate multiple projects, workstreams, countries, partners and stakeholder groups as one integrated program.
* Ensure that scope, solution design, delivery plans and priorities remain aligned with the customer’s strategic and operational objectives.
* Maintain executive-level relationships with customer sponsors and provide clear, outcome-oriented program reporting.
* Drive timely decisions, remove cross-functional obstacles and maintain momentum across the entire engagement.
* Ensure effective transition from sales to delivery and from implementation to adoption and ongoing success.

**Regional Delivery Governance**

* Provide oversight of the regional project portfolio, with particular focus on strategic, high-value, high-risk or escalated engagements.
* Establish and enforce consistent delivery standards, governance practices, project controls and quality expectations.
* Conduct regular portfolio and project-health reviews covering scope, schedule, financials, staffing, dependencies, risks, customer sentiment and business outcomes.
* Ensure project teams maintain effective governance artifacts, including integrated plans, RAID logs, decision records, financial forecasts, status reports and escalation plans.
* Identify systemic delivery risks, capability gaps and recurring project issues, and lead regional improvement initiatives.
* Promote the consistent application and continuous improvement of Genesys delivery methodologies and best practices.
* Coach Project Managers, Delivery Managers and project leads on program governance, executive communication, risk management and customer engagement.

**Escalation and Risk Management**

* Act as the senior point of escalation for project-delivery issues across the region.
* Establish clear escalation paths, ownership, decision rights and recovery actions.
* Intervene early when project conditions could affect customer objectives, delivery commitments, revenue, margin or customer confidence.
* Lead recovery planning for critical projects, bringing together the appropriate Genesys, partner and customer stakeholders.
* Escalate product, support, resource or commercial dependencies to the relevant leadership teams and drive them through resolution.
* Ensure material risks and issues are communicated transparently, with clearly defined business impact, accountable owners and target resolution dates.
* Balance immediate issue resolution with protection of the long-term customer relationship.

**Customer Business-Value Realization**

* Translate customer strategic priorities into measurable program objectives, operational KPIs and value-realization plans.
* Ensure every strategic engagement has clearly defined success measures covering business outcomes, customer experience, operational performance, adoption and financial value.
* Maintain traceability between contracted deliverables, implementation outcomes and the customer’s business case.
* Work with Customer Success and account teams to monitor adoption, benefits realization and achievement of agreed outcomes following deployment.
* Facilitate periodic executive value reviews to demonstrate progress, validate realized benefits and agree corrective or expansion actions.
* Ensure delivery decisions prioritize time-to-value and sustainable customer outcomes—not simply technical completion.
* Identify opportunities to expand adoption and deepen the customer’s strategic use of Genesys capabilities where this supports genuine customer value.

**Revenue and Financial Accountability**

* Own the consolidated financial performance of assigned strategic programs and provide governance over the regional project portfolio.
* Ensure accurate forecasting of revenue, backlog conversion, delivery velocity, resource demand and project completion.
* Monitor revenue realization, project margin, effort consumption, change requests, milestone achievement and financial risks.
* Work with delivery and resource leaders to align staffing with project priorities, skills requirements, utilization and profitability objectives.
* Identify and resolve conditions that could delay revenue recognition or negatively affect margin.
* Ensure changes in scope are governed effectively and translated into appropriate commercial change controls.
* Partner with Sales and account leadership to identify follow-on services opportunities while maintaining clear separation between delivery commitments and new scope.
* Contribute directly to achievement of regional Genesys revenue and professional-services performance targets.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Create alignment among Professional Services, Customer Success, Sales, Solution Engineering, Product, Support, Finance, partners and customer teams.
* Establish an effective cadence for program leadership, workstream coordination, account-team alignment and executive steering.
* Ensure decisions, actions and dependencies are documented, communicated and tracked to completion.
* Build a culture of ownership, transparency, constructive challenge and continuous improvement.
* Represent regional delivery in strategic account planning, executive reviews and pre-sales discussions for complex opportunities.
* Provide delivery insight during opportunity qualification, solution planning and commercial development to ensure commitments are achievable.
* Capture and share lessons learned, reusable assets and delivery best practices across the region.

**Required Experience And Qualifications**

* Typically 15 or more years of relevant experience with a bachelor’s degree, 12 or more years with a master’s degree, or 8 or more years with a PhD; equivalent combinations of education and substantial professional experience will also be considered.
* Recognized expertise in enterprise program management, professional-services delivery, customer transformation or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated success leading large, complex and strategically important programs involving multiple projects, functions, partners and geographies.
* Proven ability to serve as a principal adviser to senior leaders, helping shape critical decisions and resolve issues that materially affect customer outcomes, program success and organizational objectives.
* Extensive experience establishing governance structures, delivery standards, operating plans and controls for complex enterprise programs.
* Strong track record of solving ambiguous and high-impact problems where information may be incomplete, considerable judgment is required and decisions have long-term implications.
* Demonstrated ability to assess risks and develop solutions that account for dependencies and impacts across multiple functions, business units or geographies.
* Proven accountability for program financial performance, including revenue forecasting, backlog conversion, delivery velocity, margin management, resource planning and commercial change control.
* Demonstrated experience connecting technology delivery to measurable customer business outcomes, adoption goals and value-realization objectives.
* Strong executive presence, with experience establishing trusted relationships and formal networks with senior internal leaders, customer executives, partners and other external decision-makers.
* Ability to serve as a Genesys expert and external spokesperson on strategic program delivery, governance and transformation matters.
* Demonstrated ability to influence decisions and drive action across organizational boundaries without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Experience providing guidance, coaching and professional development to Project Managers, Program Managers, Delivery Managers and other delivery professionals.
* Proven ability to lead large cross-functional initiatives of strategic importance. Direct people-management experience is beneficial but is not a prerequisite for the role.
* Deep understanding of enterprise cloud transformation, customer-experience technology and professional-services delivery. Experience with Genesys Cloud or large-scale contact-center transformation is strongly preferred.
* Exceptional executive communication, negotiation, facilitation, conflict-resolution and escalation-management capabilities.
* Project or program management certification—such as PgMP, PMP, PRINCE2 or an equivalent—is preferred.

**Leadership Capabilities**
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
  
  

* Executive presence and credibility.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Customer- and outcome-first decision-making.
* Commercial and financial acumen.
* Structured problem-solving and sound judgment.
* The ability to see both program-level detail and the broader strategic picture.
* Confidence operating in ambiguity and managing competing priorities.
* Empathy combined with the willingness to address difficult issues directly.
* The ability to influence without relying on formal authority.
* A continuous-improvement mindset and commitment to delivery excellence.

**Working at Genesys**

* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work

* Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
* Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys

Title: Cybersecurity Manager
Description:
**JOB OVERVIEW**

The Cyber Security Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of information security controls across Daman Securities and Daman Investments. The role manages the relationship with the Group's managed security service provider, runs vulnerability management and incident response, maintains security policies and the risk register, and supports regulatory and audit requests. The Cyber Security Manager reports to the Group CIO and executes the Group's information security program rather than setting Group strategy.

**KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Security Operations & Incident Response**

* Manage the day-to-day relationship with the managed SOC / MSSP, including alert triage, escalation, and tracking performance against SLA.
* Execute incident response playbooks, coordinate containment and recovery, and support post-incident review and regulatory notification under the Group CIO's direction.
* Run the vulnerability management programme and coordinate penetration testing, tracking findings through to remediation.

**Policy, Risk & Compliance Support**

* Maintain and update information security policies, standards, and procedures within the framework set by the Group CIO.
* Maintain the information security risk register and produce regular reporting on risk position and remediation status.
* Prepare evidence and coordinate responses for internal audit, external audit, and CMA regulatory requests on information security matters.
* Support responses to institutional due diligence reviews and client security questionnaires for Daman Securities and Daman Investments clients.

**Identity, Access & Data Security**

* Administer identity and access management processes, including joiner-mover-leaver workflows, privileged access, and periodic access recertification.
* Support data classification, data loss prevention, and encryption standards, and test backup and recovery restorability.
* Provide security input on change requests — new systems, integrations, and vendor onboarding — ahead of go-live.

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable experience.

**Technical Competencies**

* Working knowledge of security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, identity and access management, and data protection.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 security tooling (Defender, Entra ID, Purview) and cloud security fundamentals.
* Experience working with a managed SOC or MSSP provider.
* Working knowledge of UAE information security expectations relevant to financial services (CMA, PDPL) is an advantage.

**Skills/Personal Attributes**

* Structured and detail-oriented, with the ability to execute consistently against an established control framework.
* Good communicator, comfortable working across IT, trading, wealth management, and HR/EOS teams.
* High level of integrity and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information.
* Arabic language skills are an advantage.

**Work Experience**

* 5–8 years of experience in information security or IT risk, with hands-on exposure to SOC operations, vulnerability management, or identity and access management.
* Experience in financial services is preferred but not required.
* A relevant certification (e.g. CISSP, CISM, CISA, Security+) is preferred, or a willingness to obtain one.

Title: AI Product and Delivery Manager (18-Month Contract)
Description:
Centennial College recognizes and affirms Diversity, Equity and Inclusion and Indigenous ways of knowing as central to the vibrancy and uniqueness of its learning and working academic mission. We strongly encourage applications from members of Indigenous communities and all equity-deserving groups including Women, Racialized, Persons with Disabilities, and LGBTQ+ communities.

We also recognize that Centennial is situated on the Treaty Lands of the Mississauga’s of the Credit First Nation and pay tribute to their legacy as well as that of all First Peoples that have been and remain present here in Toronto. We recognize that First Peoples come from sovereign Nations and that part of understanding our responsibilities of residing on this territory are understanding the true history, circumstances and legacy of the Treaties signed here (such as the Toronto Purchase, Robinson-Huron Treaty and Williams Treaties) and including pre-contact Treaties and Agreements between sovereign Nations and that all peoples in this area are therefore Treaty people with obligations and responsibilities to all our relations.

**Position Summary**

**The future of artificial intelligence in higher education isn't something we're waiting for. It's something we're building.**

Centennial College is launching an ambitious AI Incubator to accelerate the adoption of artificial intelligence across teaching, learning, student services, and institutional operations. We're moving beyond experimentation to develop intelligent solutions that solve real problems, transform experiences, and deliver measurable outcomes.

We're looking for an exceptional **AI Product and Delivery Manager** to help turn that ambition into reality. This is a unique opportunity to join a newly established AI Incubator at a defining moment in the College's digital transformation. You'll help shape how AI opportunities are discovered, evaluated, prioritized, built, and deployed—working with a multidisciplinary engineering team, institutional leaders, and technology partners to move ideas from concept to production.

Imagine helping bring to life an AI-powered student concierge that supports students throughout their academic journey, intelligent service agents that transform how employees access support, or AI-enabled workflows that eliminate friction and create new possibilities across the institution. These are the kinds of opportunities the AI Incubator is being established to pursue.

Reporting directly to the Associate Vice President, Strategy, Innovation and Assurance, who establishes the College's institutional AI strategy and direction, you will lead the Incubator's product and delivery activities. You'll translate approved strategic priorities into actionable roadmaps, coordinate technical delivery, manage the Incubator's portfolio and budget, and work with functional-area product owners to ensure solutions deliver meaningful business value.

This isn't a role focused on producing AI strategy documents. It's about turning strategy into working solutions—and ensuring those solutions make a difference.

  

**Responsibilities**  
  
Shape the AI Opportunity Pipeline and Product Roadmap

* Lead the AI Incubator's opportunity intake, assessment, and prioritization processes across academic, student-service, and administrative areas.
* Partner with institutional leaders, faculty, staff, and service owners to identify high-value opportunities for AI Agents, generative AI, intelligent automation, and emerging technologies.
* Facilitate discovery sessions that translate real-world challenges into compelling product concepts, clear requirements, and measurable success criteria.
* Evaluate opportunities against strategic alignment, technical feasibility, data readiness, cost, risk, and anticipated value.
* Develop business cases, product roadmaps, delivery recommendations, and benefits hypotheses that support informed institutional decision-making.

  

Turn AI Concepts into Real-World Solutions

* Lead cross-functional delivery planning, translating approved initiatives into coordinated work plans, milestones, dependencies, and release schedules.
* Work closely with AI Development, Data, and Platform Engineers to assess technical approaches and coordinate the delivery of secure, scalable, production-ready solutions.
* Facilitate product discovery, backlog refinement, prototype reviews, pilot planning, and release readiness activities.
* Evaluate engineering recommendations involving AI Agent architecture, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), enterprise integrations, and platform capabilities.
* Coordinate testing, business acceptance, deployment readiness, and operational transition with functional-area product owners and IT teams.
* Identify delivery risks, competing priorities, and resource constraints, recommending practical solutions and escalating decisions where necessary.

  

Drive Adoption, Impact, and Continuous Improvement

* Partner with functional-area product owners to establish measurable outcomes, adoption targets, and benefits realization approaches.
* Coordinate demonstrations, pilots, user feedback, and change enablement activities to support successful adoption.
* Monitor product performance, adoption, task completion, service improvements, cost avoidance, and other indicators of realized value.
* Translate delivery progress and performance insights into executive-ready reports and recommendations.
* Help establish repeatable approaches for AI product discovery, evaluation, delivery, and continuous improvement

  

Champion Responsible and Sustainable AI

* Collaborate with cybersecurity, privacy, enterprise architecture, and data governance specialists to embed responsible AI principles throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Ensure appropriate consideration of AI accuracy, groundedness, reliability, accessibility, human oversight, security, and operational readiness.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and delivery approaches, balancing innovation with institutional risk, cost, and sustainability.
* Manage the AI Incubator's approved budget and coordinate the work of external vendors and technology partners.
* Foster a collaborative, delivery-focused environment where experimentation, learning, accountability, and measurable results go hand in hand.

  

**Qualifications/Experience**

* A four-year degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
* Seven-years of progressive experience in digital product management, technology delivery, business transformation, or cross-functional program management, ideally involving AI, automation, cloud technologies, or enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of generative AI, AI Agents, large language models, RAG, enterprise integration, data architecture, and cloud-based AI platforms.
* Experience translating complex business challenges into product requirements, delivery roadmaps, prioritized backlogs, and measurable outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate technical recommendations and trade-offs involving feasibility, security, scalability, performance, cost, and supportability.
* Experience coordinating multidisciplinary technical teams, business stakeholders, external vendors, and complex delivery dependencies.
* Knowledge of agile delivery, product lifecycle management, user acceptance testing, change enablement, and benefits realization.
* Strong financial, analytical, and organizational skills, including budget oversight, business case development, and executive reporting.
* Exceptional communication, facilitation, stakeholder engagement, and relationship management skills.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Fabric, or comparable enterprise AI platforms is an asset.
* Experience in higher education, the public sector, or another complex service-oriented organization is an asset.

  

**What will set you apart?**  
You're equally comfortable discussing business outcomes with senior executives and challenging technical assumptions with engineers. You understand that a successful AI initiative isn't measured by how impressive the demonstration looks, but by whether the solution works, is adopted, and delivers lasting value.  
  
You're curious, pragmatic, collaborative, and energized by the opportunity to build something new.  
Most importantly, you're ready to help move AI from possibility to production.

Title: Partner Portfolio Lead Architect
Description:
**THE ROLE: THE RIGHT PARTNER, ON THE RIGHT TERMS**
---------------------------------------------------

Reporting to the Head of Partner Strategy, you lead the decision on which partners are brought into Echelon’s portfolio and under what terms. Each recommendation goes to the leadership team after you apply four key tests: technology, industry, layer, and mutual fit. You collaborate with the CRO’s technical principal and our engineers for technical diligence, tap account teams for customer insight, and leverage Partner Sourcing and Intelligence to challenge and enhance recommendations. Then, you agree on the partnership model, contract framework, and commercial terms with Legal, Finance and the business, before handing each signed partner to Partner Development for activation.

**Your Mandate:**
-----------------

* **The right technology:** Collaborate with engineering leadership to assess candidates’ architecture, maturity, security, and deployability, considering engineering effort required.
* **The right industry:** Validate industry demand with account teams—sectors, use cases, and accounts—before committing.
* **The right layer:** Determine where the partner sits in the stack and if that layer needs filling, strengthening, or should remain open.
* **The right mutual fit:** Assess strategic intent, commercial ambition, ways of working, and appetite for joint investment, ensuring mutual commitment.
* **A portfolio that holds:** Evaluate each partner’s addition relative to our roadmap and signed partners, checking for gaps, overlaps, or competition, and ensuring a cohesive market offering.
* **The model and the terms:** Recommend a partnership model, negotiate terms—go-to-market, delivery, revenue share, exclusivity, liabilities, and exit—with leadership, Legal, Finance, and the business.
* **Build the recruitment model:** With leadership and Partner Sourcing and Intelligence, shape the partner profiles, assessment frameworks, recruitment process, and the operating model for smooth partner transition.

**WHERE WE ALIGN**
------------------

### **AI AND TECHNOLOGY FIRST**

* **Partnership record:** Experience assessing, structuring, and signing partnerships at a technology vendor, integrator, or in corporate development or consulting.
* **Technical judgement:** Comfortable engaging engineers on architecture, integration, and deployment; able to discern robust technology from demonstrations.
* **Industry sense:** Deep understanding of how sectors buy and run technology, with an ability to judge where value will (and won’t) be created.
* **Commercial structuring:** Designed channel/partnership models and negotiated revenue share or terms with larger counterparties.
* **Portfolio and fit judgement:** Credibility with founders, engineers, Legal, and Finance; able to assess how partners add to the whole.

### **STRONG ADVANTAGE**

* **Ecosystem background:** Experience in a technology vendor’s partner organisation or a cloud provider’s ecosystem team.
* **Deal experience:** Exposure to venture investment, M&A, or joint ventures, including diligence and documentation.
* **Sector knowledge:** Depth in sectors where Echelon leads (government, energy, financial services, healthcare).
* **Arabic:** Professional fluency in Arabic.

**OUR VALUES**
--------------

* **Customer first:** Measured by customer outcomes; prioritise accordingly.
* **Ownership mentality:** Own outcomes end-to-end; fix what breaks or stalls.
* **Clear communicator:** Simplify complex systems; make the value of your work visible.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity:** Progress with partial data and unclear environments.
* **Long-term builder:** Invest in Echelon’s success; bring insight back to strategy and operations.
* **Builds others:** Measure success by the people and capabilities you develop.

**THE SEAT**
------------

* **Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
* **Reports to:** Head of Partner Strategy
* **Travel:** Limited
* **Package:** Base salary plus housing, transport, education allowances, medical cover, and equity through our employee equity programme. Full terms shared at offer stage.

**HOW WE WORK**
---------------

You start from the problem, not the tool—and greet unclear briefs or broken environments with energy and a plan.

Title: Engagement Manager, Strategy Consulting, TMT

You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.
  
  
Are you ready to make your impact?

Are you ready to dive into complex business environments and contribute to high-impact recommendations that drive client success?
  
  
As an Engagement Manager at FTI, you will play a key role in formulating strategic recommendations and implementing changes to clients by managing individual project modules, deploying commercial acumen in structuring and performing key analysis/ deliverables with little support and develop areas of focus as well as identify leads from existing projects. Title: Senior PMO Manager
Description:
**Job Overview:**

The
**Senior PMO Manager**
will establish and lead a fit-for-purpose Enterprise PMO that converts business demand into a transparent, prioritized and executable project portfolio. The role owns the operating model, governance, controls, tools and management information for Demand Management, Portfolio and Prioritization Management, Cost Management, Resource Management and project delivery assurance. Working across Albatha Group businesses, IT leadership, Finance, HR, Procurement and delivery partners, the role will provide decision-quality insight, strengthen accountability and optimize investment, capacity and benefits realization.

This is a hands-on leadership position for an experienced PMO practitioner who can design new processes from the ground up, embed adoption across diverse stakeholders, and progressively mature the PMO from project reporting to enterprise portfolio management.

**Key Accountabilities:**

PMO Setup, Operating Model and Governance

* Design and implement the Enterprise PMO charter, service catalogue, governance model, decision rights, RACI, policies, standards, stage gates and delivery lifecycle.
* Establish integrated PMO processes, templates, controls, calendars and forums covering idea intake through prioritization, approval, delivery, benefits tracking and closure.
* Create a pragmatic PMO maturity roadmap, baseline current capabilities and deliver prioritized improvements in 30, 60, 90 days and annual horizons.

Demand Management

* Create a single demand intake process and demand register for strategic initiatives, regulatory work, business requests, technology lifecycle needs and operational improvements.
* Define minimum data requirements including business problem, strategic alignment, sponsor, expected benefits, urgency, dependencies, high-level cost, capacity needs and risk.
* Introduce demand triage, qualification and routing with benefit targets, ensuring incomplete or low-value requests are challenged before entering the portfolio pipeline.
* Facilitate demand discovery with business and technology teams
* Monitor demand ageing, conversion, rejection and backlog health; provide transparent feedback to requestors

Portfolio and Prioritization Management

* Build and maintain a single source of truth for the project portfolio, including approved, proposed, paused, at risk and completed initiatives.
* evelop and administer a transparent scoring model using strategic alignment, value, risk/compliance, customer impact, urgency, feasibility, dependency and capacity criteria.
* Facilitate prioritization sessions; model scenarios and trade-offs within budget and resource constraints.
* Provide independent challenge and assurance at stage gates, ensuring continued investment is supported by evidence and agreed tolerances.

Cost and Investment Management

* Establish portfolio financial controls for business cases, annual planning, budget baselines, forecasts, actuals, commitments, accruals and estimate-at-completion.
* Partner with Finance, Procurement, project managers and vendors to reconcile project costs and improve the timeliness and accuracy of financial reporting.
* Monitor budget variance, burn rate, and financial risk; escalate exceptions and support corrective actions.
* Create investment views by strategic theme, business unit, platform and delivery status.
* Coordinate benefits baselining, ownership, measurement and post-implementation realization reporting.

Resource and Capacity Management

* Create a consolidated resource and skills inventory covering internal teams, contractors and strategic partners.
* Implement role-based capacity planning, allocation, demand forecasting and resource heatmaps across projects and operational priorities.
* Facilitate periodic resource reviews with functional leaders and delivery managers; maintain agreed allocations and forward-looking capacity forecasts.
* Define resource planning standards, utilization measures and data ownership while avoiding counterproductive activity-level timesheet administration.

Stakeholder and Team Management

* Lead, coach and develop PMO analysts, project coordinators and portfolio specialists; set objectives, quality standards and development plans.
* Build trusted relationships with Group and business-unit executives, sponsors, Finance, HR, Procurement, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity and delivery teams.
* Facilitate evidence-based decisions, constructively challenge optimistic assumptions and communicate difficult trade-offs with clarity.
* Manage PMO service quality and stakeholder satisfaction; drive adoption through communications, training and change management.

AI-Enabled PMO and Intelligent Automation

* Define and implement an AI-enabled PMO roadmap that applies generative AI, predictive analytics and workflow automation to demand intake, portfolio planning, reporting and governance.
* Use AI-assisted analysis to identify delivery risks, schedule slippage, cost anomalies, resource constraints, dependency conflicts and emerging portfolio trends, while retaining accountable human review.
* Introduce intelligent automation for project status consolidation, data-quality checks, meeting summaries, action tracking, RAID updates, executive reporting and portfolio insights.
* Build AI literacy within the PMO, coach project teams on effective use of approved AI tools, and measure adoption, efficiency gains, decision quality and realized value.

**Key Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline; a postgraduate qualification is advantageous.
* Strong knowledge of project, program and portfolio methods. PMP, PgMP, PfMP, PRINCE2, MSP, PMI OCP, MoP or equivalent certification is strongly preferred.
* Experience with IT financial management, business cases, CAPEX/OPEX, forecasting, benefits realization and vendor-commercial governance.
* Advanced proficiency in portfolio reporting and analytics using Power BI and Excel; practical experience with PPM and delivery tools such as Planview, ServiceNow SPM, Jira, Azure DevOps or Microsoft Project Online is advantageous.
* Exposure to SAP S/4HANA and large-scale ERP or digital transformation portfolios is advantageous.
* Excellent written and spoken English, presentation, facilitation, negotiation and conflict-resolution skills.

**Senior Manager Lottery Research & Insights**

We are ready to take this game to the next level and need someone passionate about understanding customers, uncovering actionable insights, and shaping business strategy through research as **Senior Manager Lottery Research & Insights**. In this role, you will serve as OLG's customer and research expert, leveraging advanced research methodologies and behavioural insights to inform strategic decision-making across all lines of business. Reporting to the Director Enterprise Customer Strategy & Experience, you will be empowered to:

* Business judgment and strategic insight

* Executive communication, presentation and customer storytelling capabilities

**Job Description:**
The Head of IT Data Governance reports to the Group Head of IT and Security and is accountable for the quality, consistency and usability of the data the IT function relies on to run and improve itself. The role involves leading the IT Data Programme and establishing and sustaining an IT data governance capability that keeps the data model accurate.
  
  
This is a governance role, not a data ownership role. The IT leader accountable for a service remains accountable for the data supporting that service (e.g. the Head of IT Infrastructure and Networks owns infrastructure and identity data, the Head of IT Platforms owns platform and application data, etc.). This role is responsible for implementing and operationalising data governance across IT, in accordance with the Enterprise Data Governance framework, policies and standards. It works closely with the Enterprise Data lead to ensure alignment with enterprise governance, data quality, metadata and information management requirements.
  
  
The role develops IT-specific controls within the enterprise framework, measures compliance, reports performance and escalates non-compliance through agreed arrangements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Lead the IT Data Programme
  

* Own delivery of the IT Data Programme end to end, including the traceability model, the roadmap and the implementation backlog that follows.
* Make sure the programme answers the business questions IT needs answered and doesn't become a documentation exercise. Every data requirement should be traced to a question and every gap to a prioritised action.
* Turn assessment findings into a sequenced backlog with named owners and see it through to completion.

Implement and operate the data governance framework
  

* Implement and operationalise the enterprise Data Governance Framework within IT. Support the nomination of named Data Owners, Stewards and Custodians across in-scope IT data domains, consistent with enterprise roles, responsibilities, standards and decision rights.
* Apply enterprise data governance decision rights, escalation pathways and dispute resolution processes to IT data domains, escalating cross-functional matters through the established enterprise governance arrangements.
* Set up and chair an IT Data Governance forum that makes decisions instead of reviewing status, aligned with the Enterprise Data Governance Framework and the governance arrangements led by the Enterprise Data team. Oversee IT data quality, stewardship, compliance and remediation through the forum.
* Support the identification of a network of data stewards in each IT function, and support their training, standards and ways of working.
* Hold Data Owners to account for the quality of their domains and report non-compliance through appropriate escalations.

Maintain IT data standards, definitions and authoritative sources
  

* Develop and maintain the IT domain-specific data definitions, metadata, reference data and lifecycle requirements in accordance with enterprise data standards established by the Enterprise Data team, working closely with Enterprise Architecture and relevant Data Owners.
* Maintain the catalogue of IT systems of record and their authoritative data sources, ensuring alignment with the enterprise data catalogue and metadata standards. Identify and resolve IT-specific source conflicts, escalating cross-domain ownership or authoritative source disputes through enterprise data governance.
* Ensure that IT data assets, ownership, classifications, definitions and lineage are maintained in the enterprise data catalogue, working with the Enterprise Data team to establish consistent metadata and assurance requirements.
* Govern alignment to the ServiceNow Common Service Data Model, ensuring the CMDB conforms to the enterprise IT data model rather than diverging from it.
* Apply the existing data standards that system integrations, platform changes and new tooling must meet before approval.

Data quality, measurement and remediation
  

* Implement the enterprise data quality framework across IT data domains, developing domain-specific rules, thresholds, controls and KPIs in collaboration with IT Data Owners and Stewards, consistent with enterprise data quality standards and reporting requirements.
* Establish ongoing data quality measurement and remediation across IT data domains, using enterprise-approved methodologies and integrating results into enterprise data quality reporting and assurance processes.
* Drive remediation of quality failures through the accountable Data Owner, escalating where remediation does not happen.
* Operate the IT data certification process, so users of the data know which data they can trust.
* Operate the information lifecycle for IT data, including retention, archiving and disposal, in line with Information Security policy.
* Build data literacy across IT leadership so Data Owners understand and can discharge their accountability.
* Publish and track an IT data maturity assessment, with a target state and a measurable trajectory.

Reporting and insight
  

* Lead the development of trusted IT management reporting and performance measures, ensuring alignment with enterprise data architecture, common definitions, semantic standards and approved reporting platforms, in collaboration with Enterprise Data and Enterprise Architecture. This should be the single agreed source of the metrics used in leadership reporting, scorecards and business impact reporting.
* Ensure that every metric reported to leadership has a defined calculation, a named owner and a known level of confidence.
* Reduce reporting duplication across the function, retiring competing versions of the same measure.
* Provide the data foundation that lets IT quantify its impact on business productivity in hours and cost.

Enable AI and automation
  

* Lead IT data readiness activities supporting enterprise AI and automation initiatives, working with the Enterprise Data team to assess data availability, quality, classification, accessibility and fitness for purpose against enterprise AI readiness and governance requirements.
* Maintain the data classification and sensitivity position for IT data sources feeding AI and automation tooling, to standards set by Information Security.
* Identify and prioritise the data gaps that currently prevent automation, agentic use cases and self-healing capability.
* Collaborate with the Enterprise Data team to prioritise IT data improvements that enable agreed AI analytics and automation use cases, ensuring alignment with the enterprise data strategy and roadmap.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* IT Data Programme milestones delivered to committed dates.
* Percentage of in-scope IT data domains with a named Data Owner and Data Steward.
* Percentage of core IT data entities with a defined authoritative source and no unresolved source conflict.
* Data quality scores by domain, trending against published thresholds.
* Number of data quality defects remediated after their committed date, trending down.
* CMDB completeness and accuracy against the CSDM-aligned target model.
* Percentage of leadership metrics with a defined calculation, named owner and stated confidence level.
* Reduction in duplicate or competing versions of the same reported measure.
* IT data maturity assessment score, trending against target.
* Number of business questions the function can answer reliably, against the agreed question set.

**Candidate Specification**
**Essential**

* Substantial experience leading data governance in a complex, global or federated organisation, with results to show rather than frameworks produced.
* Proven experience implementing a Data Owner, Data Steward and Data Custodian model and making it work, including holding senior stakeholders to account for the domains they own.
* Experience working in Enterprise IT teams and an understanding of how they are structured, the services they provide and the frameworks that underpin them (ITIL, COBIT, NIST, Cyber Essentials, etc.)
* Strong technology domain knowledge, specifically of IT data: configuration items, service and application dependencies, identity and entitlement, asset lifecycle, vulnerability and risk, and event and telemetry data.
* Practical experience of ServiceNow CMDB and the Common Service Data Model, sufficient to govern conformance and challenge platform decisions credibly.
* Experience implementing and operating data quality frameworks including rules, measurement, KPIs, certification and remediation.
* Programme leadership experience, including accountability for external advisory or delivery partners, deliverable acceptance and commercial performance.
* A track record of turning an assessment or strategy into a delivered backlog, not stopping at recommendations.
* The credibility and confidence to challenge senior peers constructively, including those at or above their own grade, and to report uncomfortable findings plainly.
* The ability to explain data governance in terms of business consequences (risk, cost, productivity and decision quality) to audiences with no interest in data management as a discipline.

**Desirable**

* Experience in professional services, engineering, consultancy, construction, regulated or global matrix organisations.
* Experience of data governance in support of enterprise AI or Copilot adoption, including readiness assessment and classification.
* Experience of identity data governance, including non-human and service identities.
* Familiarity with LeanIX, enterprise architecture repositories or IT asset management tooling.
* Formal data management credentials alongside practical delivery experience.
* Experience building a data steward network across a distributed organisation.
* Experience preparing governance papers or investment cases for executive committees.

**Personal Attributes**

* Comfortable holding authority without owning the assets, and working through influence, evidence and governance rather than direct control.
* Pragmatic. Delivers a working standard quickly rather than a perfect one slowly, and sequences improvement instead of attempting everything at once.
* Persistent. Data governance works through repetition and follow-through, not through the launch.
* Direct. Willing to publish an uncomfortable quality score and name the owner, while keeping the relationship intact.
* Commercially aware, able to justify data investment in terms of risk reduction, cost and productivity.
* A clear communicator who can make data governance matter to people who don't care about it.
* Builds capability in others rather than becoming the single point of knowledge.

Title: Bid Manager
Description:
**About the Role**

Lead InfraX's end-to-end bid, solutioning and commercial development lifecycle, converting customer requirements into compliant, competitive and executable multi or single-vendor solutions. The role coordinates technical, commercial, financial, procurement, legal and delivery inputs across InfraX's connectivity, telecommunications, IoT, managed services and digital infrastructure portfolio. It owns bid strategy, business cases, pricing and governance from opportunity qualification and ideation through contract award, delivery handover, execution oversight, revenue recognition and collection readiness, ensuring commitments are profitable, deliverable and aligned with customer outcomes and InfraX objectives.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead bid lifecycle: Own qualification, bid planning, compliance, response development, reviews, approvals, submission, clarification, negotiation and handover for RFIs, RFPs, tenders and direct proposals.
* Establish governance: Create the bid plan, responsibility matrix, review gates, document controls, risk log and approval path; ensure adherence to customer instructions and InfraX governance.
* Shape the win strategy: Define customer value proposition, differentiators, competitive positioning, partners, commercial approach and executive messaging with the opportunity owner.
* Translate needs into solutions: Structure customer business, technical, operational, security, service-level and implementation requirements into a coherent solution and scope of work.
* Cover InfraX environment: Coordinate solutions spanning fiber and managed connectivity, MPLS and enterprise networks, IoT and sensor ecosystems, LoRaWAN/RF mesh, private LTE/5G, cloud/edge, platforms, systems integration, professional services, operations and support.
* Maintain traceability: Use compliance matrices, assumptions, exclusions, interfaces, dependencies and acceptance criteria to keep the solution complete and auditable.
* Architect one integrated offer: Combine InfraX capabilities with multiple OEMs, technology vendors, telecom operators, cloud providers, system integrators, subcontractors and affiliates into one end-to-end solution.
* Align responsibilities: Define work packages, bills of materials, partner scopes, interfaces, warranties, SLAs, support models, delivery obligations and a clear RACI.
* Validate third-party inputs: Obtain and challenge quotations, technical compliance, lead times, dependencies, licensing, support, validity and contractual flow-downs; remove gaps, overlaps and unpriced exposure, vendor price protection.
* Build the business case: Develop CAPEX/OPEX, one-time and recurring revenue models, total contract value, cost-to-serve, gross margin, cash flow, payback, NPV/IRR where applicable, sensitivity scenarios and funding requirements.
* Design commercial models: Structure outright purchase, subscription, managed service, lease, consumption-based, revenue-share, project-finance or public-private-partnership approaches where relevant.
* Protect profitability: Validate pricing, mark-ups, contingencies, taxes, foreign exchange, escalation, payment milestones, performance securities, penalties and working-capital exposure with Finance and Procurement.
* Produce quality submissions: Lead clear, persuasive and compliant technical and commercial proposals, executive summaries, implementation plans, pricing schedules, presentations and clarification responses.
* Coordinate reviews: Consolidate inputs from Sales, Technology, Operations, Project Delivery, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Risk and partners; close review comments before approval.
* Support negotiations: Manage clarifications, best-and-final offers and scope or price revisions while maintaining an approved negotiation position and complete decision record.
* Delivery Planning: Ideation to Execution
* Design for execution: Define delivery strategy, work breakdown, resources, milestones, dependencies, procurement lead times, testing, commissioning, migration, acceptance, training, transition and service commencement.
* Assure deliverability: Validate capacity, resources, permits, access, logistics, cybersecurity, safety, operational readiness and vendor commitments before submission.
* Handover to delivery: Conduct a formal post-award handover covering the baseline scope, contract, cost model, schedule, risks, assumptions, obligations, acceptance criteria and change-control process.
* Align commercial milestones: Structure contractual deliverables and customer acceptance evidence to enable accurate invoicing and revenue recognition in coordination with Finance.
* Track financial realization: Maintain visibility of purchase orders, supplier commitments, delivery and acceptance status, billing milestones, invoices, receivables and collection risks from award to closure.
* Resolve blockers: Coordinate with the customer and internal teams to close documentation, acceptance, dispute and dependency issues that delay billing, revenue recognition or collection.
* Manage bid security requirements: Identify bid bond, performance bond and advance payment guarantee requirements in each tender; confirm amounts, validity periods, issuing-bank conditions and required wording.
* Coordinate issuance: Work with Finance, Treasury, Legal and banks to request, issue, amend, extend and submit bonds and guarantees ahead of bid deadlines, within approved limits and delegated authority.
* Track and release: Maintain a bond register covering value, issuing bank, expiry, renewal and release status; follow up on return or release after award or non-award, and coordinate conversion to performance securities on award.
* Manage bid and delivery risk: Identify commercial, technical, contractual, regulatory, financial, schedule, dependency and supplier risks; define owners, mitigations, contingencies and escalation points.
* Maintain compliance: Coordinate required legal, regulatory, information-security, data, insurance, bonding and customer-specific compliance, with all commitments made within delegated authority.
* Improve performance: Maintain reusable content, solution and pricing references, vendor intelligence, lessons learned and bid metrics; conduct win/loss and post-bid reviews.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor degree in engineering, telecommunications, information technology, computer science, business, finance or a related discipline.
* Minimum Experience: 8 years or more in bid management, solutioning, presales, commercial management, project delivery or business development within telecommunications, ICT, IoT, managed services or infrastructure; experience leading complex multi-vendor bids is strongly preferred.
* Language Fluency: Fluent English. Arabic is preferred.
* Professional Certifications: APMP, PMP/PRINCE2, finance/business-case, contract management or relevant technical/vendor certifications are advantageous.

**Required Skills**

* Bid governance; technical and commercial writing; requirements analysis; multi-vendor solution integration; pricing and financial modelling; business cases; contract and risk review; project planning; executive presentations; negotiation; stakeholder management; revenue, billing and collection-cycle awareness.
* Customer focus, ownership, commercial judgment, structured problem solving, attention to detail, strategic thinking,
