Title: VP, Global Customer Support
Industry: Software Development and IT Services and IT Consulting
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.
  
  
We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.
  
  
**Summary:**
Clio is the global leader in legal AI, trusted by hundreds of thousands of legal professionals across 130+ countries and having surpassed $500M ARR in 2026. As legal work is rebuilt around AI, the expectations customers hold for service are being rebuilt with it — and this role sits at the center of that shift.
  
  
We are seeking a
**Vice President of Global Customer Support**
to define and lead the multi-year strategy for how Clio serves its customers worldwide. You will own the end-to-end support experience across Clio's core practice management platform and Clio Work, our intelligent Legal AI assistant, leading a 150+ person global organization across five locations and a portfolio of AI agents operating alongside them.
  
  
This is an executive mandate to reimagine support, not optimize it. You will build a model where every Clion is focused on the complex, high-value interactions that require real expertise, judgment, and relationship depth — while AI agents handle the rest at scale. You'll own the P&L for global support, set the operating standard for service quality across the company, and establish support as a durable growth engine and competitive differentiator rather than a cost center.
  
  
You will report to the SVP, Customer Success, sit on the CX leadership team, and partner directly with Product, R&D, Revenue, and the executive team on the decisions that shape the customer experience. You'll present results and strategy to the C-suite and the board.
  
  
Who you are:
  
  
You are a seasoned support or CX executive who has built and scaled global service organizations in high-growth B2B SaaS — and who has genuinely operationalized AI, not just piloted it. You've led leaders across multiple geographies, owned a substantial budget with real ROI accountability, and navigated the tension between service quality, cost to serve, and growth without treating any of the three as negotiable.
  
  
You think in systems and see the whole board, not just the next move. You are energized by ambiguity and by building things that don't yet exist. You have informed opinions about where AI support technology is heading and you follow the space closely. You can translate complex AI and operational concepts credibly for a board audience and for a frontline agent in the same day, and you create environments where high performers thrive and everyone has a clear path to growth.
  
  
What you'll work on:
  
  
*Set Vision & Multi-Year Strategy*

* Define and execute the multi-year global support strategy, including the operating model, service architecture, geographic footprint, and AI roadmap.
* Own the P&L for global support, making deliberate trade-offs between cost to serve, service quality, and growth contribution — and defending them at the executive and board level.
* Align with the C-suite on company-wide priorities, representing the voice of the customer at the highest level of the organization.
* Set the standard for what world-class service means at Clio and hold the broader company accountable to it.

*Build & Scale the Global Support Organization*

* Lead, develop, and inspire a 150+ person global organization across five locations, building a bench of support leaders capable of scaling well beyond current size.
* Recruit and develop top-tier leadership talent with a specific lens on AI-native and AI-fluent professionals who are excited about redefining their roles alongside technology.
* Build a culture of continuous improvement, psychological safety, and AI curiosity — and lead the organization through significant role and workflow change with credibility and care.
* Design the career architecture, competency frameworks, and enablement systems required for a support organization whose work is fundamentally changing.

*Own the AI-First Support Architecture*

* Own the strategy and execution to evolve support into an AI-first model — elevating Clions to the complex, high-judgment work while AI agents handle routine inquiries at scale.
* Evaluate, select, and drive enterprise adoption of AI support platforms (e.g., Maven AI, Decagon, Sierra, Intercom Fin, or equivalent), owning the build-versus-buy decisions and vendor relationships.
* Deploy intelligent AI voice and chat agents capable of handling complex, multi-product workflows for legal professionals, and set the governance for escalation logic, confidence thresholds, knowledge curation, and human-in-the-loop design.
* Build AI-assisted agent tooling — agent assist, real-time suggestions, auto-summaries — that measurably improves time to resolution and first-contact resolution.
* Establish the accuracy, compliance, and quality standards that AI-delivered support must meet in a high-trust, regulated vertical, and own accountability for them.

*Drive Growth, Retention & Commercial Contribution*

* Own support's contribution to retention and expansion, including the identification and conversion of Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs) at every touchpoint.
* Build PLG-integrated support motions — in-product nudges, proactive outreach triggers, self-service optimization — that reduce friction at critical conversion and adoption moments.
* Partner with Revenue, Marketing, and Post Sales to make support a measurable input to net revenue retention, not an adjacent function.

*Lead Multi-Product Support Excellence*

* Own the end-to-end support lifecycle for Clio's core practice management platform and for Clio Work (Legal AI drafting, research, and intelligence).
* Build differentiated support models tuned to each product's complexity, customer segment, and AI-sensitivity — recognizing that Clio Work customers have fundamentally different needs than core platform users.
* Design specialized routing and escalation frameworks for complex customer questions, and manage multi-channel environments (voice, live chat, email, AI chat, async messaging) with consistent service levels across all.

*Drive Cross-Functional & Product Alignment*

* Partner with Product, Engineering, and R&D to build a rigorous product feedback loop powered by support signal — influencing roadmap priorities, not just filing bugs.
* Build proactive partnerships across Post Sales (Onboarding, Professional Services, CSM) to deliver a seamless customer experience across the lifecycle.
* Serve as the escalation executive for critical customer and product incidents, owning resolution and the durability of the customer relationship afterward.

*Build Scalable Systems & Operational Rigor*

* Set and own the support KPI framework, including the AI-era metrics that don't yet have industry standards — deflection quality, containment, AI resolution accuracy, cost per resolution, and outcome-based CSAT.
* Own the Support Systems architecture across Salesforce Service Cloud, CCaaS platforms (e.g., Talkdesk), knowledge management, and AI support tooling.
* Lead Workforce Management to forecast demand across traditional and AI channels, enabling intelligent staffing decisions and intraday optimization in a rapidly shifting volume mix.
* Establish the operating cadence, data infrastructure, and reporting that allow support performance to be understood and trusted company-wide.

*Market Leadership*

* Serve as the executive face of Clio's support organization externally, representing Clio at industry events and thought leadership forums.
* Build Clio's reputation as the reference case for what AI-first support looks like in a high-trust vertical.

What you bring:
  
  

* 12+ years in customer support, service, or CX leadership, including 5+ years managing managers in high-growth B2B SaaS environments.
* Proven experience leading global support or CX organizations of 150+ people across multiple geographies, with full budget or P&L ownership.
* A demonstrated track record deploying AI support technologies at scale — you have actually done this and lived with the results, not advised on it.
* Direct, hands-on experience with modern AI support platforms such as Maven AI, Decagon, Sierra, Intercom Fin, or equivalent, including vendor selection and enterprise rollout.
* Deep understanding of AI agent architecture: escalation logic, confidence thresholds, knowledge base curation, and human-in-the-loop workflow design.
* Strong command of support operations and SaaS metrics, with a bias toward outcome-driven, AI-augmented efficiency and the analytical rigor to defend the model to a board.
* Experience supporting complex, multi-product SaaS environments with distinct customer personas and varying technical depth requirements.
* Experience in hypergrowth environments where the business doubles while headcount grows far more slowly.
* Experience in legal tech, professional services SaaS, or another high-trust, regulated vertical where content accuracy and compliance carry real stakes.
* A track record of building feedback loops between support signal and product roadmap — influencing priorities, not just reporting issues.
* Exceptional executive presence and communication, with the ability to influence at every level and present to the C-suite and board.
* A "Draw the Owl" mindset — comfort with ambiguity, a bias toward action, and the drive to build the structures, processes, and playbooks where the path isn't yet defined.
* Genuine passion for transforming legal work through AI, and a clear point of view on how service will evolve over the next decade.

Technology:
  
  
You'll be expected to evaluate, select, and drive adoption of tools across these categories:
  
  

* AI Support Agents: Maven AI, Decagon, Sierra, Intercom Fin, and equivalents
* AI Enterprise Platform: Claude
* CRM & CCaaS: Salesforce Service Cloud, Talkdesk
* Analytics & WFM: Looker, Playvox
* Knowledge Management: Zendesk and equivalents

This role is a backfill for an existing position.
  
  
**What you will find here:**
Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.
  
  
**Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:**

* Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
* Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin and Sydney) to be in office minimum twice per week.
* Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
* $2000 annual counseling benefit
* RRSP matching and RESP contribution
* Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

Variable compensation is not guaranteed and will depend on individual, team, or company performance. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. Description:

****CLA Lender of the Year****

****Nesto Group****
Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.
  
  
Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of
****Deloitte's Fast 50****
companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.
  
  
Operating through our family of brands—
****CMLS****
****,****
****nesto****
****, and****
****Nesto Cloud****
—our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services. Learn more at: https://nestogroup.ca/
  
  
****Life at nesto****
At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.
  
  
**About The Role**
As Business Performance Manager , you own operational performance and profitability across the business. You are accountable for how efficiently we turn marketing spend, leads, and our existing book of clients into net income, and for keeping that performance high and predictable.
  
  
Next year that means a $2B renewal book and $1B of D2C origination. You will have the levers, the data, and the cross-functional relationships to move both. This role suits someone who sees a business as a system of levers: you know which ones exist, how they interact, and how to build new ones when the existing ones aren’t enough.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Own operational performance and profitability by driving conversion, net income, and productivity across the top of the funnel and the renewal book, planning and forecasting against targets, and adjusting in real time when results drift from plan
* Own the top of the funnel by managing lead volume, quality, and cost from first touch through qualification, deciding where the next marketing dollar goes, and pulling back where returns fall short
* Find and fix leaks by reading P&L and funnel data to locate where conversion, productivity, or cost is slipping, and fixing it across cross-functional teams
* Manage the renewal book by owning renewal performance and potential mid-term opportunities, mining it for refinances, HELOCs, and other revenue events, and building pipelines to capture them
* Balance supply and demand in real time by monitoring lead volume against advisor and SDR capacity and acting on it, such as launching SMS blasts, adjusting SDR qualification length, or proactively reaching out to advisors to change their states
* Design and pull levers with functional stakeholders, leading horizontally with data across Marketing, Sales team leads, and Tech to guide routing and tactical decisions like rate changes and competitive response
* Translate business needs into technology by writing clear tickets, specifying workflows and automations, working with developers to ship them, and configuring Five9 and Salesforce with our Five9 architect to improve speed to lead and the agent experience, building new processes through technology and AI where needed
* Build the visibility the business runs on by working with the data team on dashboards and operating rhythms so managers run on the same numbers, and drive cross-functional initiatives such as external partner profitability work

****KPIs you’ll be accountable for****

* Conversion, net income, and profitability
* Marketing spend and labour efficiency
* Funnel metrics
* Advisor availability and productivity (% of time on call + ready)
* Performance metrics design
* Submissions and lead to submission %
* Attempts and connect per client
* Renewal retention and revenue generated from the book

**What You Bring**

* 5-8 years in marketplace operations, fintech, or mortgage/lending, or 2-4 years in consulting
* Exceptional analytical ability: strong SQL and BI tools (Tableau or similar), and the skill to connect top-of-funnel activity to bottom-line funding and net income
* A deep understanding of the drivers of revenue and expense in a lending business
* Proficiency with modern tech stacks (CRM, dialer, data tools), with the ability to specify and get tickets built for developers
* Systems thinking: you see how a change in one lever affects the rest
* Strong communication and the ability to lead peers and managers without direct authority
* Comfort in a high-growth environment where AI and telephony automation are evolving quickly

****Why You'll Love Working Here****
We believe great people do their best work when they're supported professionally, personally, and financially. That's why we offer a comprehensive rewards package designed to help you thrive at every stage of your career.
  
  

* Competitive Rewards — Competitive compensation, performance incentives (where applicable), and recognition for your contributions.
* Health & Wellness — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, Health & Wellness Spending Accounts (where applicable), telemedicine, Employee Assistance Programs, and mental health support for you and your family.
* Time to Recharge — Generous vacation (4 weeks), floater days, and statutory holidays to help you recharge.
* Planning for the Future — RRSP matching to support your long-term financial wellbeing.
* Family Support — Enhanced maternity and parental leave top-up programs.
* Learning & Growth — Education assistance, mentorship, training, and opportunities to build your career across Nesto Group.
* Tools for Success — Modern technology, collaborative teams, and the resources you need to do your best work.

****Diversity, Equity & Inclusion****
At Nesto Group, we believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to succeed.
  
  
We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including Indigenous Peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis), persons with disabilities, members of racialized communities, women, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community.

Title: Development Lead
Description:
**Being part of Air Canada is to become part of an iconic Canadian symbol, recently ranked the best Airline in North America. Let your career take flight by joining our diverse and vibrant team at the leading edge of passenger aviation.**

Join Air Canada—an iconic Canadian brand and North America’s top ranked airline—as we continue to evolve our digital platforms supporting critical operational and customer experiences.

The Development Lead is a senior, hands-on developer who drives sprint execution and delivery outcomes within an Agile delivery pod, and who practices AI-first, agentic engineering as the default way of working. This role owns delivery predictability, code quality, and release readiness while implementing solutions within the technical direction, architecture, and standards established by the Technical Lead and Development Manager.

As the most senior developer/lead within the pod, the Development Lead provides day-to-day technical leadership through delivery coordination, coaching, and hands-on contribution. They set up and run the pod’s AI agent workflows (coding, testing, review, and documentation agents working under human oversight), prove measurable productivity gains, and coach every developer in the pod to work the same way. The Development Lead is the primary execution authority within approved architectural and responsible-AI guardrails, escalating design decisions that fall outside defined patterns, and ensuring operational learnings are fed back into the backlog.

Let your career take flight by joining a team that’s redefining the digital passenger experience at the forefront of global aviation.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead sprint commitments, delivery predictability, and delivery outcomes for the pod; proactively manage scope, dependencies, and trade-offs, and ensure stories are well defined, estimated, sequenced, and delivered as agreed.
* Shape the breakdown of complex requirements into clear technical tasks and agent-ready specifications (acceptance criteria, constraints, test cases) that both engineers and AI coding agents can execute against; anticipate risks early and guide the team through implementation and validation.
* Serve as the primary delivery execution authority within approved architectural guardrails; apply and enforce established patterns and standards, and escalate design decisions that exceed those guardrails to the Technical Lead.
* Lead by example in AI-first, agentic development: use AI coding agents (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) daily for design exploration, implementation, test generation, refactoring, and documentation, and coach the pod to adopt the same practices.
* Design, configure, and maintain the pod’s agentic development workflows, including multi-agent setups with clearly scoped roles (e.g., implementer, reviewer, test writer), version-controlled agent instructions and repository coding standards, scoped tool permissions, and reusable prompts and playbooks.
* Connect AI agents safely to the pod’s real systems of work (repositories, CI/CD, issue tracking, cloud, observability) through governed integrations such as  
  Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, applying least-privilege access and secrets hygiene in partnership with Cybersecurity.
* Enforce human-in-the-loop guardrails: no destructive, production-impacting, or externally visible agent action without human approval, and no AI-generated change merged until it has been independently reviewed and verified by tests.
* Champion high-quality peer code and pull-request reviews, including AI-generated code, focusing on correctness, maintainability, performance, reliability, security, and adherence to approved patterns.
* Own the pod’s testing strategy, including test-driven development, unit, integration, and API test automation, and AI evaluation coverage, so that quality gates are consistently met and defects are prevented.
* Drive readiness for production releases, including completion of quality gates (tests, security checks, performance), runbooks/operational documentation, observability coverage, and rollback/mitigation plans.
* Uphold and enforce engineering standards for coding, testing, documentation, security, observability, and responsible AI practices within the pod.
* Enhance CI/CD pipeline efficiency, build automation, and AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., automated AI review and test generation in the pipeline) to improve deployment frequency and developer productivity.
* Lead and support complex or high-risk feature implementations, balancing delivery timelines with technical quality and operational risk.
* Partner with Product Owners, QA, Designers, and Scrum Masters to ensure clarity, feasibility, testability, and timely decision-making on scope changes.
* Provide first-level ownership for pod production issues and technical integrations; coordinate triage (using AI-assisted diagnosis where appropriate), restore service, and communicate status and mitigation to stakeholders.
* Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) for pod-owned incidents/defects and drive corrective and preventive actions; ensure learnings are translated into backlog items and completed.
* Establish and maintain clear, accurate, and up-to-date technical, prompt, and agent-instruction documentation to support maintainability, onboarding, and operational support.
* Monitor and improve delivery, quality, and AI-impact metrics such as defect rates, PR lead time, deployment frequency, rollback frequency, AI-assisted change share, and cycle-time improvement; use the data to report measurable gains and drive improvement actions.
* Evaluate and prototype emerging AI development tools and techniques; share what works with the Technical Lead and contribute pod learnings to IDD bootcamps, playbooks, and communities of practice.
* Provide day-to-day technical leadership and mentoring through pairing (including pairing on agent workflows), feedback, and guidance; foster a culture of craftsmanship, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Design, develop, integrate, maintain, and troubleshoot software applications and services; write, review, test, and debug code for new features and enhancements, and analyse requirements, dependencies, and system interactions to recommend implementation approaches.

**Personal Attributes:**

* Inspires and energizes engineering teams with a high level of enthusiasm, fostering a culture of excellence and ownership.
* Demonstrates a forward-thinking, innovative mindset—constantly exploring emerging technologies and unconventional solutions to complex challenges.
* Is a curious, hands-on builder who treats AI agents as everyday engineering tools, and is equally disciplined about verifying their output before it reaches  
  production.
* Builds and sustains a culture of trust, transparency, and psychological safety, enabling open dialogue and empowering diverse perspectives.
* Challenges assumptions and the status quo with curiosity and courage, driving continuous improvement and elevating team performance.
* Balances strategic vision with hands-on technical guidance, ensuring alignment between business goals and engineering execution.
* Leads by example with integrity, resilience, and a commitment to mentoring others toward their full potential.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* Minimum five (5) years of experience in software development in a production environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading delivery execution within Agile teams, with accountability for sprint commitments, delivery outcomes, and code quality.
* Strong hands-on expertise with modern programming languages and frameworks (e.g., Java, Node.js, TypeScript, Python, React, React Native, Angular, NestJS), and solid grounding in APIs, event-driven, and cloud-native architecture.
* Demonstrated daily, hands-on use of AI-assisted and agentic development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) in production work, with concrete examples of measurable impact on delivery speed or quality.
* Proven ability to write effective prompts and agent instructions, and to critically review and validate AI-generated code (spotting hallucinations, insecure patterns, and missing tests).
* Solid experience working with CI/CD pipelines, test-driven development, automated testing, and modern DevOps practices.
* Proven ability to uphold engineering standards, guide code quality, and support sprint-level delivery commitments.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical roles.
* Demonstrate punctuality and dependability to support overall team success in a fast-paced environment.

**Assets**

* Experience designing or orchestrating multi-agent development workflows (agent roles, scoped tool permissions, persistent memory/context, automated review gates).
* Experience connecting AI agents to engineering systems using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar tool integrations.
* Experience building AI features into products (LLM APIs, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling) and applying AI evaluation frameworks and responsible AI practices.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud-native architecture patterns; cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect or Developer) are an asset.
* Exposure to API platforms, integration technologies, or enterprise systems.
* Background in large-scale, regulated, or mission-critical environments such as aviation.
* A portfolio (e.g., GitHub, shipped side projects) showing software built end to end with agentic workflows.

Prior to their start date, candidates will also need to provide proof of their eligibility to work in the country of interest.

Based on equal qualifications, preference will be given to bilingual candidates.

Air Canada is strongly committed to Diversity and Inclusion and aims to create a healthy, accessible and rewarding work environment which highlights employees’ unique contributions to our company’s success.

Please take a moment to look over this opportunity and if interested, feel free to send us your application. If this is not the right opportunity for you, you can also sign up for Job Alerts by creating an account. This will give you a profile that you can use for all future applications, and you will be notified whenever a new position that matches your criteria becomes available.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Manager, Professional Services leads a customer-facing team responsible for delivering high-quality unified communications and customer experience solutions. This leader will play an important role in transforming the Professional Services organization: building new technical and consultative capabilities, improving operational discipline, and evolving the team beyond traditional product implementation.
  
  
The role will develop a team capable of delivering integrated UC and CX solutions with an increasing focus on business requirements, system integration, workflow optimization, automation, and customer adoption. The manager will ensure that technical delivery is connected to the customer’s operational objectives and produces measurable business outcomes.
  
  
This position owns team performance, delivery quality, resource readiness, and operational execution across a portfolio of customer engagements. The successful candidate will combine strong leadership and technical credibility with the ability to lead change, establish scalable delivery practices, and collaborate across Sales, Solution Engineering, Product Management, Customer Success, and Support.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership and Capability Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Professional Services engineers and consultants responsible for delivering UC, integration, workflow, and CX solutions.
* Build a high-performing, customer-focused culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and delivery excellence.
* Assess current team capabilities and develop a skills roadmap aligned with evolving customer needs, solution strategy, and market demand.
* Expand the team’s capabilities beyond traditional UC implementation to include application integration, workflow optimization, automation, APIs, customer experience, and business-outcome consulting.
* Establish individual development plans, technical learning paths, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing practices that strengthen team capability and career growth.
* Support recruiting, onboarding, succession planning, and workforce development based on sales pipeline, delivery demand, and future skill requirements.
* Lead the team through organizational and operating-model changes with clear communication, engagement, and accountability.

**Customer and Delivery Leadership**

* Own delivery performance and customer outcomes across a portfolio of Professional Services engagements.
* Ensure the team begins with an understanding of the customer’s business requirements, workflows, operating environment, and desired outcomes—not simply the technical implementation.
* Guide customers in improving communication workflows, employee experiences, customer interactions, and operational efficiency through effective use of UC and CX technologies.
* Serve as an escalation point for complex delivery challenges involving architecture, integrations, workflow design, solution configuration, resource alignment, and customer expectations.
* Engage with customer stakeholders, including technical teams, operational leaders, and executives, to build confidence, resolve challenges, and maintain alignment on outcomes.
* Ensure effective handoffs across Sales, Solution Engineering, Project Management, Professional Services, Support, Service Delivery, and Customer Success.
* Promote strong documentation, knowledge transfer, enablement, and adoption practices so customers can realize sustained value following implementation.

**Transformation and Operational Excellence**

* Help lead the transformation of Professional Services into a more consultative, scalable, and outcome-oriented organization.
* Translate the Professional Services strategy into practical operating processes, delivery standards, technical methodologies, and team behaviors.
* Establish and continuously improve delivery methodologies, quality standards, implementation templates, technical documentation, and governance practices.
* Create greater consistency in project scoping, estimation, resource assignment, solution delivery, risk management, and customer acceptance.
* Monitor resource capacity, skills alignment, utilization, project performance, delivery quality, forecast accuracy, and customer satisfaction.
* Proactively identify delivery risks, capability gaps, and operational constraints, taking timely action to protect customer and business outcomes.
* Use portfolio data and delivery insights to improve productivity, resource planning, project predictability, and services profitability.
* Evaluate the appropriate use of internal resources, global delivery capabilities, partners, and contractors while maintaining consistent customer experience and delivery quality.
* Identify opportunities to standardize and package repeatable services while retaining the flexibility needed for complex enterprise customer environments.
* Champion automation, improved tooling, and simplified processes that reduce administrative effort and allow the team to focus on higher-value customer work.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with Sales and Solution Engineering to improve discovery, scope services accurately, establish realistic delivery expectations, and position the value of Professional Services.
* Work with Services Architects and customer-facing teams to translate business requirements into appropriate services, architectures, integrations, and delivery strategies.
* Collaborate with Product Management and Services Portfolio Management to identify capability gaps and develop new, repeatable service offerings.
* Provide structured feedback on product functionality, implementation complexity, integration needs, customer workflows, and recurring delivery challenges.
* Partner with Project Management, Customer Success, Service Delivery Management, and Support to create a coordinated customer journey from presales through implementation and ongoing success.
* Represent Professional Services in cross-functional transformation initiatives focused on customer experience, operational efficiency, recurring revenue, and scalable growth.
* Share customer, technology, and market trends across the organization to help shape services strategy and future capabilities.

**Measures of Success**
**Success In This Role Will Be Reflected Through**

* Consistent, high-quality delivery and achievement of customer outcomes.
* Growth in the team’s UC, CX, integration, workflow, automation, and consulting capabilities.
* Improved customer satisfaction, stakeholder confidence, adoption, and time to value.
* Increased delivery predictability, resource utilization, forecast accuracy, and services profitability.
* Fewer escalations, delivery defects, scope gaps, and avoidable project delays.
* Improved consistency in delivery methodology, documentation, and customer handoffs.
* Development of repeatable and scalable service offerings.
* Strong employee engagement, skill progression, accountability, and retention.
* Effective alignment among Professional Services, Sales, Product, Project Management, Customer Success, and Support.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Five or more years of experience in Professional Services, technology consulting, solution implementation, or a related customer-facing delivery environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading, coaching, and developing technical or consulting professionals.
* Experience managing a portfolio of complex customer implementations with accountability for delivery quality, customer satisfaction, and business performance.
* Strong understanding of unified communications, collaboration, contact center, customer experience, or related enterprise communication technologies.
* Working knowledge of solution architecture, system integration, APIs, workflow design, application configuration, and enterprise technology environments.
* Demonstrated ability to connect technical capabilities with customer workflows, operational requirements, and desired business outcomes.
* Experience introducing new delivery practices, technical capabilities, or operating processes within a changing organization.
* Strong operational and analytical skills, including experience with capacity planning, resource management, project risk, delivery metrics, forecasting, and utilization.
* Ability to manage competing customer, employee, operational, and financial priorities in a complex environment.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, business leaders, customers, and cross-functional partners.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, influence without direct authority, and drive organizational change.
* Ability to travel approximately 25% of the time.

⠀
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering Mitel or comparable enterprise UC and collaboration solutions.
* Experience with contact center, customer experience, workflow automation, artificial intelligence, analytics, or workforce engagement technologies.
* Experience designing or delivering integrations between communication platforms and enterprise applications such as CRM, EHR, ERP, ITSM, or workforce-management systems.
* Familiarity with cloud, hosted, hybrid, and on-premises solution architectures.
* Experience working with APIs, integration platforms, low-code tools, or workflow automation solutions.
* Experience supporting enterprise customers in regulated industries such as healthcare, government, financial services, or utilities.
* Experience developing repeatable service packages, implementation methodologies, or consulting offerings.
* Familiarity with project-management methodologies, ITIL, Agile, SAFe, or comparable delivery frameworks.
* Experience operating within a blended delivery model that includes internal teams, global delivery resources, partners, and third-party providers.

Title: Technical Delivery Manager
Description:
Join phData, a remote-first data and AI consultancy company with employees across the United States, Latin America, and India. We partner with industry leaders, including Snowflake, AWS, Anthropic, Glean, and dbt, to solve the complex data and AI challenges that slow large enterprises.
  
  
We're growing fast, and we give our people real ownership over their work. We hire top performers and trust them to deliver results.
  
  
**Why phData?**

* Snowflake Implementation Partner of the Year — 7 consecutive years, and 2026 Snowflake AI Partner of the Year
* AWS Premier Tier Services Partner — the highest tier of recognition in the AWS Partner Network
* 2025 Fivetran Partner of the Year (4th consecutive year)
* 2025 dbt Labs Partner of the Year (3x winner) with Visionary partner status
* 2026 KNIME Customer Excellence Partner of the Year
* Preferred Partner in the Anthropic Claude Partner Network
* #1 Partner in Snowflake Advanced Certifications
* 600+ Expert Cloud Certifications (Sigma, AWS, Azure, Dataiku, and more)
* Recognized as an award-winning workplace in the US, India and LATAM

**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Technical Delivery Manager to join our Elastic Platform Operations (EPO)/Managed Services team. In this role, you will lead and scale the design, implementation, and ongoing operations of modern data platforms for multiple enterprise customers, ensuring reliable delivery and continuous improvement of their cloud data environments. You will collaborate closely with client sponsors, technical stakeholders, and globally distributed delivery teams to drive high-quality outcomes on time and within budget. You will also play a key role in major incident response, process improvement, and the development of delivery best practices across our Managed Services portfolio.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Client Delivery**

* Own and drive the delivery and operational excellence of modern data platforms (including streaming, data lakes, and analytics) for multiple customer accounts.
* Translate business and technical requirements into actionable Epics, Stories, and Tasks that mature and improve customer data platforms while aligning to phData methodologies and best practices.
* Ensure engagements are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget, with clear measures of success and value for customers.
* Lead and motivate client technical teams, providing hands-on technical leadership for design, implementation, and ongoing operational support of cloud data platforms.
* Provide leadership during major incidents, ensuring effective coordination, communication, escalation, and follow-through to resolution, root cause analysis, and remediation.

**Collaboration & Leadership**

* Collaborate with cross-functional partners including architects, engineers, and site reliability/operations teams in the US and India to deliver successful client engagements and seamless handoffs across time zones.
* Develop strong relationships with sponsors and stakeholders, keeping them informed of progress and outcomes, hosting leadership discussions, and identifying opportunities to expand the value of our services.
* Ensure teams are trained and prepared to deliver by driving accurate process documentation, clear internal and external communication, and continuous readiness for production operations.
* Maintain proper staffing levels across accounts, balancing delivery between US and India team members to support continuous delivery and high customer satisfaction.

**Practice & Firm Contribution**

* Deliver feedback and drive improvements to our overall Managed Services offerings through process optimization, knowledge sharing, and creation of accelerators and reusable assets.
* Champion phData’s core values and foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement within delivery teams.
* Contribute to the evolution of best practices for incident management, change management, and modern data platform operations across multiple customers.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders (Director and VP level), shaping roadmaps for cloud data platforms and influencing strategic decisions around data and analytics operations.
* Mentor and coach architects, engineers, and operations team members, helping them grow technical depth and delivery capabilities across large and complex environments.
* Help define and refine Managed Services standards, playbooks, and frameworks to support scalable growth across a broad customer base.

**About You**
You are a client-focused technical delivery leader who enjoys owning complex data platform operations, guiding teams through ambiguity, and building strong relationships with stakeholders. You are equally comfortable discussing architectural trade-offs with engineers and outcomes with business leaders, and you thrive in a remote, global, outcomes-driven environment.
  
  
**Experience**
**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in technical management, IT architecture, customer relationship management, project management, and/or delivery management, ideally within data, analytics, or infrastructure operations.

**Technical / Functional Skills**

* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform, specifically Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure.
* Technical knowledge deploying and managing modern cloud data technologies such as Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Airflow, Redshift, Matillion, Databricks, Azure Synapse, Qlik, StreamSets, NiFi, Cloudera, Coalesce, and EMR (not all required but familiarity with several is expected).
* Background in IT operations, infrastructure, or production support, including managing modern data platforms or data warehouses for multiple customers of various sizes.
* Experience leading technical operations teams through multiple large or complex projects, including backlog creation (Epics, Stories, Tasks), prioritization, and delegation.
* Experience scoping and planning large-scale, complex technology infrastructure or modern data platform initiatives.
* Demonstrated ownership of incident and escalation processes, including coordination among technical teams, end-users, and stakeholders through resolution, root cause analysis, and remediation.
* Active daily use of AI coding tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) with demonstrated judgment about when to trust, verify, and correct AI-generated output.
* Ability to describe specific engineering tasks completed with AI assistance.

**Consulting / Delivery Skills**

* Experience delivering services for external or internal customers in a professional services, managed services, or similar client-facing environment, including direct interaction with global customers and business partners.
* Ability to interact confidently with Director and VP level stakeholders, guiding discussions, building relationships, and communicating complex technical information in accessible ways (written, verbal, and formal presentations).
* Proven experience coordinating across technical teams managing IT infrastructure services or modern data platforms for multiple customers concurrently.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

**Collaboration & Ownership**

* Demonstrated ability to lead and collaborate with distributed, cross-functional teams across regions (e.g., US, LATAM, and/or India) and time zones.
* Strong leadership skills with a professional track record of creating, challenging, and improving processes and procedures.
* Highly organized, strategic thinker, and effective problem-solver who can manage multiple priorities and accounts simultaneously with minimal supervision.
* Flexibility to work across time zones as needed to support global teams and customers.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (degree preferred but not required).

**Preferred Qualifications**
Preferred qualifications help candidates stand out but are not required for success in this role.
  
  

* Experience managing IT or data operations/production support environments, including leading data warehouse, ML, or data engineering teams.
* Experience working with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, and Azure Synapse in a multi-customer or managed services context.
* Additional experience with tools such as Qlik, StreamSets, NiFi, Cloudera, or Coalesce.
* Prior experience in a consulting, managed services, or MSP-style environment supporting multiple enterprise customers.
* Prior experience working in global or remote teams and partnering across US, LATAM, and/or India.
* Demonstrated passion and curiosity for learning new technologies and staying current with technology trends to inform business strategy.
* Contributions to internal accelerators, process improvements, or knowledge sharing initiatives are a plus.

**Location & Time Zone Expectations**
This role is based in the US and operates primarily in Central or Eastern US time zones, with regular collaboration with teams in India and across the Americas.
  
  

* We are a remote-first company, and you should be comfortable working with a distributed global team.
* Some flexibility may be required to collaborate across time zones with colleagues and clients.
* Client needs may occasionally require flexibility in working hours and willingness to travel for client visits, team workshops, and strategic planning sessions.

**Why phData?**

* Impactful Work: Partner with leading organizations on meaningful data & AI initiatives.
* Collaborative Culture: Work with a supportive, high-performing global team that values transparency, autonomy, and continuous improvement.
* Growth Opportunities: Access to challenging projects, mentorship, and structured development pathways.
* Values-Driven: We prioritize doing the right thing for our clients, our teams, and our community.

**Benefits At PhData**
**US:**

* Remote-First Work Environment
* 401k plan with company match
* Dental and Vision insurance
* Home Office Equipment Stipend
* Annual stipend for Learning and Development
* Competitive comp, excellent benefits, 4 weeks PTO plan plus 10 Holidays (and other cool perks)

Title: Program Manager
Description:
Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial and high-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.
  
  
**Position: Program Manager**
**Location: Santa Clara, CA**
Amphenol High Speed Products Group is the market leader for high speed, high bandwidth electrical connectors for the Telecom/Datacom market (Mobile Networks, Storage, Servers, Routers, Switches, etc.). Our products help to enable the electronics revolution and remain a key enabler for all the major Tier 1 OEM’s globally. Our global headquarters are located in Nashua, NH and we have design, sales and manufacturing locations globally.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
This position will be responsible for customer communication, program planning, program budget, and program execution. Manage and provide Technical Leadership for new product development programs with high complexity. Manage these programs to ensure that products/technologies are delivered according to market/customer expectations in respect of specifications, timing and budget.
  
  

* Manage the program, the program team, contribute to the program scope and program objectives as well as assure that all steps are completed.
* Provide communication interface to customer for communication of program status, schedule, requirements, etc.
* Manage and provide Technical Leadership to program teams across multiple sites throughout the execution of product development programs.
* Schedule and manage internal team meetings to address necessary action items and keep programs on schedule.
* Manage internal and external suppliers for on time completion of actions.
* Timely communication to management for resource requirements to keep programs on schedule.
* Define product specifications and program scope to ensure it is in line with market / customer needs and ensure development of the product / process accordingly.
* Make sure that programs are in accordance with the financial objectives including creation, review, submission of capital requests, review and submittal of product costing information and managing program scope creep.
* Make decisions in order to speed up the process and ensure the best time to market, time to volume and time to profitability.
* Ensure application of Design for Manufacturability (DFM) principles during the product development.
* Ensure that capacity planning is performed through the program phases so that supply meets expected demand.
* Provide program updates to functional management on a regular basis.
* Ensure systems are set up for ordering / manufacturing of products.
* Manage & reduce risks including the development of alternatives using risk reduction tools in order to maintain program objectives and schedules.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline from a four-year university with 4+ years related experience and/or training within the connector industry, preferred.
* Ability to read, analyze and interpret technical product drawings.
* Ability to read, analyze and interpret technical procedures, write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from various levels of management.
* Ability to effectively manage customer communication and expectations.
* Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
* Should have knowledge and skills using:

+ Project Management software
+ Spreadsheet software (Excel)
+ Word Processing software (Word)
+ Presentation software (PowerPoint)

* Ability to communicate and relate with project teams in each region of the world.
* Demonstrated ability to operate with minimal supervision and provide updates on project status where issues or problems can be reviewed, discussed and resolved.
* Root cause analysis.

The base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $189,260 USD annually. In determining rate of pay, Amphenol considers a variety of nondiscriminatory factors, including but not limited to geographic location, relevant industry experience, qualifications, skills, and education. It would be rare for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for a given role. Base salary is one facet of Amphenol's total rewards package which includes participation in our comprehensive benefits program with medical, dental, and vision benefits effective day 1, vacation, sick leave, personal days, paid holidays, life insurance, short/long term disability, and matching 401K.

Our focus is to provide the highest level of support and responsiveness to both our employees and our customers, the world's largest technology companies. Amphenol Corporation offers the opportunity for career growth within a global organization. We believe that Amphenol Corporation is unique in that every employee, regardless of his or her position, has the ability to positively impact the business.

Title: Sr. Technical Program/Project Manager
Description:
**Who We Are:**

At
**Bandwidth**
, we shape how the world connects. We're the global communications software company and Tier 1 network operator with global reach.  The voice, messaging, and emergency services infrastructure behind the brands and apps you use every day.

Because we own the network we build on,
*the problems you'll solve here are bigger, more complex, and more impactful.*
And as communications shifts to AI, we're the infrastructure layer making it possible.

We call ourselves BANDmates because building something this big takes collaboration, different perspectives, and the freedom to bring your authentic self to the table.

We're experts who speak like humans. Ready to build what's next?
**#JoinTheBand**

**What We Are Looking For:**

We are looking for an experienced 
**Sr. Technical Program/Project Manager**
 who will take a leadership role in the management of key internal and external programs and projects, driving product development and large customer implementation objectives to achieve corporate goals. The successful candidate will be positive, energetic, determined, have an adaptable personality as well as the ability to inspire and influence with a willingness to take on challenges independently.  Ultimately, we are looking for an excellent team player that leads by example and drives organizational accountability and efficiency.

**What You'll Do:**

* Partner with our product management team to deliver products that support Bandwidth’s strategic direction
* Drive prioritization, roadmaps, and overall planning and delivery execution
* Work cross-functionally to establish and manage successful delivery across the complete business initiative with complex interdependencies -- you own the delivery!
* Drive definition of solution concepts into manageable deliverables in partnership with product, technology and business stakeholders
* Ensure technical delivery, operational readiness across Bandwidth, and go-to-market launch activities are in sync for overall program delivery
* Foresee, manage, and raise appropriate visibility to risks and issues; own definition and execution of mitigation/contingency plans
* Build and maintain strong relationships across the organization to unite and prepare stakeholders for the change/delivery
* Measure and monitor business value by evaluating ROI for a specified period after launch against original goals, analyze deltas, and report back to product management
* Refine existing standards and adhere to those standards for program management, including processes, methodologies, metrics and reporting to ensure the development and use of program management within our Delivery Office.

**What You Need:**

* Education:
  + BS Degree - preferably in a technical discipline.
* Experience:
  + A minimum of 5 years program management experience, preferably in telecom or other Enterprise software delivery industry.
  + Experience partnering with product, technology, and other business teams to collectively deliver on business and strategic goals.
  + Experience with Agile methodology and mindset required.
  + Demonstrable experience with program/project management tools (project status, dashboard reporting, Gantt/planning tools, etc)
* Skills:
  + Demonstrated leadership and self direction.
  + Ability to adapt and maneuver in a fast-paced environment.
  + Excellent client-facing and internal communication skills at all levels, including executive.
  + Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  + Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and ability to multitask.
  + Critical thinker and solution-oriented problem solver. Strong negotiator.

**Bonus Points:**

* Education:
  + Professional certifications (PMP) and/or training in a form of scaled agile, e.g. SAFe, LeSS, etc.
* Knowledge:
  + Knowledge of web-based interfaces, API’s and/or SIP telephony
* Skills:
  + Familiarity with JIRA and Google’s suite of productivity tools

**The Whole Person Promise:**

At Bandwidth, we’re pretty proud of our corporate culture, which is rooted in our “Whole Person Promise.” We promise all employees that they can have meaningful work AND a full life, and we provide a work environment geared toward enriching your body, mind, and spirit. How do we do that? Well…

* 100% company-paid Medical, Vision, & Dental coverage for you and your family with low deductibles and low out-of-pocket expenses.
* All new hires receive four weeks of PTO.
* PTO Embargo. When you take time off (of any kind!) you’re embargoed from working. Bandmates and managers are not allowed to interrupt your PTO – not even with email.
* Additional PTO can be earned throughout the year through volunteer hours and Bandwidth challenges.

Title: Engineering Program Manager
Description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
  
  
Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
  
  
At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
  
  
When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
  
  
**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
**How You Will Impact Skylo**
Skylo is seeking an Engineering Program Manager to solve the complex challenge of synchronizing our cloud-native software evolution with global network implementation and hardware certification. You will be the primary driver behind the world’s first live direct-to-device satellite service, ensuring that code deployed in the cloud works flawlessly with physical infrastructure on the ground and partner devices in the field. This role is not just about tracking tasks; it is about navigating the technical trade-offs between rapid software iteration and the rigorous, long-lead requirements of satellite network operations. You will resolve the systemic ambiguity that arises when software, hardware, and vendors collide, ultimately ensuring that our global network scales reliably as we expand across five continents.
  
  
This role is located in Mountain View, California (On-Site)
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**

* Drive the end-to-end integration of cloud-native software releases with physical network implementation across our global satellite ground stations.
* Synchronize hardware development cycles with firmware and software milestones to ensure seamless device certification with OEM and chipset partners.
* Navigate technical trade-offs between terrestrial roaming requirements and non-terrestrial network (NTN) performance standards.
* Resolve systemic ambiguity between software engineering, network operations, and external satellite operators to maintain 99.9% service availability.
* Define and track critical path dependencies for multi-continent network deployments, including regulatory and infrastructure milestones.
* Partner across teams to clarify requirements and drive decisions on resource allocation during high-stakes launch windows.
* Establish scalable post-launch retrospectives that transform operational bottlenecks into automated deployment workflows.
* Manage high-leverage risks associated with global spectrum coordination and hardware supply chains to prevent project slippage.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field that provides a foundation in both software and hardware systems.
* 5+ years of experience managing complex engineering programs that integrate cloud-native software with physical infrastructure or telecommunications hardware.
* Proven ability to synchronize the software development lifecycle (SDLC) with hardware testing and network deployment milestones.
* Deep understanding of the technical constraints associated with network implementation, including spectrum coordination or ground station operations.
* Experience navigating device certification processes and 3GPP standards in partnership with chipset makers or OEMs.
* History of managing high-stakes vendor relationships and external satellite operator partnerships to hit critical launch dates.
* Expertise in adapting agile software practices to fit the rigid, long-lead timelines of physical network infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated capability in using analytical skills to identify and resolve systemic bottlenecks across cross-functional engineering teams.
* Experience applying sound judgment to balance rapid software iteration with the reliability requirements of a live global network.
* Record of driving alignment between technical engineering requirements and non-technical business objectives in a fast-paced environment.
* Expert level experience with program management tools such as JIRA

**What We Offer**
With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we offer an attractive range of benefits:
  
  

* Competitive compensation packages including a stock option-based equity program
* Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and retirement plan
* Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
* A generous time-off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
* A once-in-a-career opportunity to operate the world's first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network
* Access to a world-class team across software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite, and network virtualization
* Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends Silicon Valley, Nordic, and South Asia characteristics

The estimated base salary range for this role is

. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant training.

Title: Director of Rooms
Description:
**Company Description**
**Raffles Hotels & Resorts**
The Birthplace of stories and legends since 1887, Raffles is a legendary brand, steeped in history and loved by generations past, present and future. Raffles, at distinguished landmark addresses around the world, is the vibrant heart of its destination, curating experiences that are culturally enriching, intellectually stimulating and always respectful of local communities, heritage and the environment.

Guests can enjoy panoramic views, a private beach, state-of-the-art entertainment and recreational facilities, including specialist boutiques, a VIP movie theatre, and signature and private restaurants complemented by exquisite banqueting and conference spaces.
  
  
More than a destination, Raffles the Palm Dubai embodies the spirit of a legendary brand, celebrated for its storied heritage since 1887 and its hallmark of intuitive, gracious service. At the palace, excellence is a craft, and every team member is a master in their field. Here, talent is not only recognized, it plays a vital role in shaping the next chapter of this extraordinary resort and its legacy within the brand.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Director of Rooms and Residences leads the Rooms Division and the hotel's residences services, with overall accountability for service delivery, profitability, cost control, asset care and colleague engagement. The role ensures a consistent Raffles experience for hotel guests, individual residence owners and residents, while delivering residential services within the hotel's approved management and service agreements.
  
  
The scope includes Front Office, Concierge, Raffles Club Lounge, Royal Service, Housekeeping, Laundry, Transportation and residences services. The role is accountable for Rooms Division and residences service profitability, budget delivery and cost control, alongside guest and resident satisfaction, brand standards and operational efficiency.
  
  
**Housekeeping reporting line:**
The Director of Housekeeping reports directly to the Director of Rooms and Residences, who has full operational and financial oversight of Housekeeping and Laundry, while the Director of Housekeeping is responsible for the day-to-day delivery through the departmental teams.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities**
**Rooms Division operations**

* Lead the departments within the division, conduct daily briefings and weekly management meetings, and maintain clear ownership of operational priorities and follow-up actions.
* Maintain complete knowledge of hotel and residence services, room types and layouts, rates, packages, promotions, occupancy, arrivals and departures, pickup, availability and scheduled group activities.
* Oversee departmental rosters and Manager on Duty schedules in line with staffing guidelines and labour forecasts, adjusting coverage to business demand.
* Coordinate Front Office, Housekeeping, Royal Service and related teams to deliver timely room readiness, accurate room status, smooth arrivals and departures, and effective handling of guest requests.
* Anticipate sell-out and overbooking situations, coordinate alternative accommodation when required, and ensure affected guests receive appropriate communication and follow-up under hotel policy.
* Review out-of-order and out-of-service rooms daily with Engineering and Housekeeping, track defects and work orders, and confirm completion dates and readiness before returning rooms to inventory.

**Housekeeping & Laundry**

* Set and enforce cleaning, presentation and inspection standards for guestrooms, suites, villas, hotel-managed residences and all assigned public and back-of-house areas, including washrooms and leisure areas.
* Conduct regular inspections with the Director of Housekeeping, review room and public-area audit results, and ensure corrective actions are completed and checked.
* Oversee daily cleaning, turndown, deep cleaning and periodic maintenance programmes, coordinating access and timing with Front Office, residences services and Engineering.
* Approve departmental staffing plans and monitor productivity, attendance, overtime and casual or outsourced labour against approved budgets and required service standards.
* Control linen, uniforms, guest supplies, cleaning chemicals and amenities through agreed stock levels, secure stores, accurate inventories, controlled issuance and regular consumption reviews.
* Oversee Laundry quality, turnaround times, equipment care and outsourced service performance; investigate losses, damage, excessive consumption and recurring service failures.
* Ensure safe cleaning practices, appropriate chemical handling, pest-control coordination, lost-property procedures and respect for guest and resident privacy and property.

**Service Quality And Guest Experience**

* Work closely with Guest Experience and Butler leadership to anticipate preferences, coordinate personalised service and resolve complaints promptly, with clear follow-up and corrective action.
* Develop and enforce SOPs, review guest feedback and TrustYou results, and lead action plans for LQA, Forbes service standards and other applicable quality audits.
* Tour the property regularly, act as a Raffles brand ambassador and introduce relevant best practices that improve service consistency and operational efficiency.

**Residences operations and resident relations**

* Lead the delivery of hotel-managed residences services within the agreed operating scope, ensuring that service commitments, responsibilities and escalation routes are documented and understood.
* Serve as the senior operational contact for individual residence owners and residents, maintain regular communication and manage expectations with discretion and professionalism.
* Coordinate resident onboarding, arrivals, planned absences, departures and move-in or move-out arrangements with relevant hotel teams and appointed property representatives.
* Maintain accurate records of authorised occupants, contact details, preferences, contracted services and access permissions, with appropriate confidentiality and controlled access to information.
* Oversee residence cleaning arrangements, service schedules, inspections and optional services; clearly communicate agreed inclusions, additional charges and access requirements.
* Ensure resident requests and complaints are logged, assigned and tracked through to closure, with response and resolution targets, updates and escalation for overdue or recurring issues.
* Coordinate maintenance and preventive works with Engineering, monitor progress and communicate disruption and completion arrangements to residents; escalate unresolved defects to the Hotel Manager.
* Work with Security and relevant teams on authorised access, contractor visits, key control, emergency arrangements and protection of resident privacy and belongings.
* Monitor residential service providers within the role's remit, review service quality and coordinate matters affecting agreed common areas with the appointed property-management representatives.
* Review residence service arrangements and propose operational improvements that protect service quality and profitability; ensure approved changes are communicated clearly and applied in line with the relevant service agreements.

**Financial management and asset care**

* Prepare annual operating expense budgets and monthly, quarterly and yearly expense forecasts for the Rooms Division and residences services, using approved business forecasts; monitor profitability, explain cost variances and implement corrective actions.
* Review departmental profitability, occupancy, payroll, cost per occupied room, residence service costs, accruals and operating expenses, including uniforms, linen, supplies and amenities.
* Align staffing, supplies and service delivery with approved occupancy and business forecasts, working with Finance and relevant departments to protect profitability and maintain service standards.
* Define and monitor the allocation of shared staff, supplies and service costs between hotel and residences activities with Finance, and ensure residence service charges are supported and recorded accurately.
* Coordinate billing and payment follow-up for approved residential services with Finance; investigate discrepancies and ensure concessions or changes to charges follow delegated approval limits.
* Prepare annual capital expenditure proposals, prioritise replacement and refurbishment needs, and coordinate preventive care and defect reporting to protect rooms, residences and divisional assets.
* Review outsourced service requirements, supplier performance and costs with Procurement and Finance, ensuring commitments remain within approved budgets and authority.
* Provide the Hotel Manager with a monthly report on Rooms Division and residences profitability, Housekeeping quality, operating expenditure, guest and resident feedback, outstanding issues and corrective actions.

**People leadership**

* Lead and develop departmental managers, including the Director of Housekeeping, through coaching, training, clear objectives and regular performance feedback.
* Oversee recruitment, induction and succession planning with People and Culture, ensuring sufficient management capability across hotel and residences operations.
* Conduct annual and semi-annual management performance reviews, address performance and disciplinary matters under hotel policy, and recognise strong service delivery.
* Build an engaged, accountable and collaborative multicultural team; provide development opportunities and prepare suitable colleagues for progression.
* Ensure teams understand the different needs of hotel guests and long-term residents, including discretion, continuity of service, cultural sensitivities and ownership of requests.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum five years of luxury hotel experience in Rooms Division leadership, ideally within a resort or ultra-luxury brand, with a strong Front Office background.
* Proven experience overseeing housekeeping and laundry operations, including cleaning standards, staffing, productivity, inventories and cost control.
* Experience in branded residences, serviced residences or comparable owner and resident relations is strongly preferred.
* Ability to interpret operational service agreements, define service responsibilities and coordinate residential services with Finance, Engineering, Security and property representatives.
* Proven ability to lead large multicultural teams in a high-volume environment with empathy, presence and emotional intelligence.
* Strong understanding of luxury guest and resident expectations, personalised service, cultural sensitivities, confidentiality and service recovery.
* Strong financial and operational judgement, including expense budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation, expense control and analysis of departmental profitability.
* Experience using property-management systems, preferably Opera Cloud or similar, and operational reporting tools.
* Excellent communication, relationship management, conflict resolution and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain calm under pressure.
