Title: Collections Manager
Description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

### **Position Summary**

Harness is seeking a Collections Manager to own accounts receivable and cash collections for our fast-growing SaaS business, as part of the Revenue Accounting team. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who drives cash in, reduces days sales outstanding, and builds the collections infrastructure to scale with the business.

The ideal candidate is an operator who works independently, maintains audit-ready processes, and acts as the go-to expert and escalation point for collections across Finance, Sales, Legal, and DealOps. You will partner closely with the billing team to keep invoicing accurate, but your focus is the full collections lifecycle: from credit review through cash application, dispute resolution, and reporting.

### **About the role**

**Collections & AR Lifecycle Management**

* End-to-end ownership: Own the AR aging cycle across the customer base; monitor outstanding balances, prioritize outreach, and drive timely collection of past-due accounts.
* Strategic collections: Develop tailored collection strategies for key and high-risk accounts, including executive-level escalations and payment plan negotiations.
* Forecasting: Partner with Finance to forecast cash receipts and flag collection risk, reserves, and write-off candidates ahead of period close.
* Escalation and mentorship: Serve as the escalation point and subject matter expert for collections; coach team members on best practices and set outreach cadences and standards.

**Cash Application & Reconciliation**

* Manage the end-to-end cash application process, ensuring timely and accurate posting of bank deposits, wire transfers, ACH, and credit card payments to the subledger.
* Reconcile unapplied cash and clear exceptions, working with Treasury and Accounting to keep the AR subledger tied to the general ledger.

**Credit Risk Assessment**

* Perform credit reviews for new customers and establish and monitor credit limits to mitigate financial risk.
* Identify accounts with deteriorating payment behavior and recommend holds, terms changes, or other risk actions.

**Dispute & Deduction Management**

* Resolve payment disputes, credit memos, and refund requests within defined SLAs.
* Partner with Legal and DealOps on complex contract interpretations, and with Sales on customer relationship strategy for sensitive accounts.
* Track root causes of disputes and feed them back to billing and sales operations to prevent repeat issues.

**Metrics & Reporting**

* Develop and maintain AR dashboards that track KPIs including DSO, collection effectiveness index, past-due percentage, aging trends, and unapplied cash.
* Provide regular reporting and insights on collections performance to Revenue Accounting and Finance leadership.

**Billing Partnership & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work with the billing team to resolve invoice errors, contract mismatches, and amendments that delay payment; escalate systemic billing issues with the right context and urgency.
* Build strong partnerships with DealOps, Sales, Legal, IT, and Finance, and communicate clearly with leadership on collections risk and cash performance.
* Maintain working knowledge of NetSuite and Salesforce-to-NetSuite data flows as they relate to invoicing, payment terms, and customer records.

**Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement**

* Analyze collections and cash application workflows to find bottlenecks, and implement scalable, automated solutions that reduce manual effort.
* Lead initiatives with IT and Sales Operations to streamline the quote-to-cash process, including dunning, payment reminders, and customer self-service payment options.
* Create and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all collections, cash application, and credit tasks, and keep them current as processes evolve.

**Month-End Close & Compliance**

* Complete all collections and AR tasks on schedule, including journal entries for adjustments, reserves, and write-offs, and support flux analysis on AR balances.
* Maintain audit-ready documentation and support external audit requests, including PBC samples and process walkthroughs.
* Ensure collections practices comply with ASC 606, SOX controls, and internal credit and revenue recognition policies.

Title: Technology Services Manager
Description:
**About Dean Dorton**

Dean Dorton’s team makes up one of the largest advisory firms in the United States. We thrive when you thrive! We are here to help you succeed in every step of your development and career as you work with nationally recognized experts in a recognized best place to work.

Our core values guide how we work, lead, and support one another every day. They are:

* Integrity - We do the right thing, integrity guides our decisions.
* Relationships - We value people, relationships drive our impact.
* Collaboration - We win as one team, collaboration fuels our success.
* Growth - We stay curious, growth is our mindset

**About the Team**

Dean Dorton’s Infrastructure & Managed Services team provides comprehensive technology support and infrastructure management for clients across diverse industries. Acting as a true IT partner, we deliver secure, scalable, and strategic solutions that align with each client’s operational goals. From day-to-day support to long-term planning, we help businesses operate more efficiently and confidently through reliable, best-in-class technology services.

**About the Role**

The Managed Services Manager is responsible for the people, service delivery, client relationships, and operational performance of parts of the Managed Services team. This role leads a team of technology professionals, oversees a portfolio of client environments, and ensures services are delivered consistently in accordance with client agreements, firm standards, and established service expectations.

The Manager serves as a senior escalation point and trusted client advisor while also developing team members, allocating resources, improving processes, and monitoring the metrics that support a healthy and scalable practice.

**Technical**

*Definition: your specialized knowledge & expertise associated with the work you perform for/with clients (note: clients may be internal to Dean Dorton).*

* Lead the day-to-day delivery of managed technology services across a portfolio of clients, establishing clear service standards and ensuring work is completed accurately, efficiently, and consistently.
* Partner with clients to maintain reliable and secure technology environments, including servers, networks, cloud platforms, endpoints, identity systems, backups, and related infrastructure.
* Serve as a senior escalation point and subject matter resource for complex technical issues, significant incidents, and recurring service challenges.
* Oversee incident, problem, change, and service request processes; guide root-cause analysis and ensure appropriate corrective and preventive actions are completed.
* Ensure proactive maintenance activities are completed, including monitoring, patching, backup verification, lifecycle management, capacity planning, and security hygiene.
* Lead client onboarding, service transitions, and offboarding activities, ensuring technology, processes, responsibilities, and documentation are transferred effectively.
* Develop and maintain client technology roadmaps, lifecycle plans, budgets, and recommendations that align technology investments with business priorities.
* Monitor compliance with client agreements, service scope, and response expectations; identify scope gaps, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve service delivery.
* Establish standards for ticket management, time entry, documentation, remote monitoring and management, and professional services automation platforms.
* Use operational dashboards and service data to monitor response and resolution times, backlog, client satisfaction, recurring incidents, utilization, and other key performance indicators.
* Lead resource and capacity planning, including workload assignment, scheduling, escalation coverage, and appropriate use of internal and external resources.
* Manage key technology vendor and partner relationships and support decisions related to licensing, procurement, renewals, and product standards.
* Maintain accurate and current client documentation, including network diagrams, configurations, credentials, standards, procedures, and business continuity information.

**Behavioral**

*Definition: the behaviors associated with performing your job (interpersonal skills).*

* Supervise, coach, and develop Managed Services team members through clear expectations, regular feedback, performance discussions, and individualized development support.
* Delegate and coordinate work based on client priorities, technical requirements, team capacity, and team member development needs.
* Build and maintain trusted client relationships through proactive communication, responsiveness, transparency, and dependable follow-through.
* Communicate complex technical information, service risks, and recommendations in clear business language for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Lead calmly and decisively during client escalations, service disruptions, competing deadlines, and other high-pressure situations.
* Hold team members accountable for quality, documentation, time entry, client commitments, and adherence to established processes.
* Collaborate across Technology Consulting and other Dean Dorton service groups to provide integrated solutions and a consistent client experience.
* Demonstrate sound judgment when balancing client satisfaction, technical risk, employee workload, contractual obligations, and firm resources.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative environment that encourages knowledge sharing, continuous learning, accountability, and professional growth.
* Lead teams through operational changes and evolving technology needs with flexibility, clarity, and a focus on sustainable improvement.

**Non-Charge**

*Definition: the contribution you make to Dean Dorton outside of client work.*

* Partner with Technology Consulting leadership to establish Managed Services priorities, operating goals, service standards, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Monitor the operational and financial health of the practice, including capacity, utilization, realization, profitability, client retention, and service quality.
* Support recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, succession planning, and leadership development for the Managed Services team.
* Improve and standardize service-delivery methodologies, workflows, templates, documentation, and technology tools across the practice.
* Contribute to business development through discovery conversations, solution design, service scoping, proposals, presentations, and relationship building.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and service opportunities that may strengthen client outcomes or expand the firm’s Managed Services capabilities.
* Maintain relevant professional and vendor certifications and promote technical training and knowledge sharing across the team.
* Represent Dean Dorton through industry events, professional organizations, community involvement, and firm initiatives.

  
**Requirements**

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field required; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* 6-8+ years of progressive experience in managed services, technology consulting, infrastructure operations, systems administration, or a related field required.
* Demonstrated experience supervising technical professionals, developing team members, and coordinating the work of others required.
* Strong knowledge of server, network, cloud, endpoint, identity, backup, and security technologies used in small and midsized business environments.
* Experience managing client-facing service delivery, escalations, service agreements, and operational performance metrics required.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple clients, projects, priorities, and deadlines while maintaining quality and responsiveness.
* Experience with professional services automation, remote monitoring and management, ticketing, and documentation platforms preferred.
* Experience supporting technology roadmaps, budgets, lifecycle planning, and infrastructure projects preferred.
* Microsoft, Cisco, ITIL, CompTIA, or other relevant technical or service management certifications preferred.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, relationship management, and problem-solving skills required.

**Software & Tools**

* Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams)
* Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) tools
* Endpoint security, backup, and IT Service Management (ITSM) platforms (e.g., ConnectWise, Autotask)
* Project management and documentation tools

**Travel**

This position requires travel to Dean Dorton offices and day travel to client locations  

  
  
**Benefits**

**The Fun Stuff**

Work isn’t all work! We want to make your experience at Dean Dorton a great one. From your health and happiness to your long-term satisfaction, we focus on YOU! A few highlights are listed below:

* Flexible work schedules and environment
* Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Paid family leave, medical leave, and maternity/paternity leave programs
* Retirement benefits, including a best-in-class employer match and automatic profit sharing.
* Telemedicine, mental health resources and wellness program reimbursement

It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Additionally, responsibilities and duties may vary depending on business needs and individual circumstances.*

We’re committed to growing and empowering an inclusive community within Dean Dorton and our industry which is why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of the best and brightest from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives across the organization. We welcome anyone of any race, religion, color, national origin, political affiliation, pregnancy, ancestry, handicap, medical condition, disability, marital status, age, sexual orientation or gender.*

Any resumes or candidate information submitted without a current, signed agreement in place will be considered unsolicited, become the property of the company, and will not obligate the company to pay any fees or commissions.*

Title: Director of Operations
Description:
**Operations Director – Abu Dhabi (Relocation Required) – Scale up StableCoin/Fintech**

Build and run the operating model for a research-backed UAE stablecoin payments fintech as it scales volumes and corridors.

* Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE (on-site)
* Salary: Competitive, tax-free package – 160-180K Euro equilivant tax free + amazing education allowances + 1 month hotel + x2 first month salary for relocation + private healthcare & dental etc
* Job Type: Permanent

**About the Business**

An early-stage Abu Dhabi fintech building a blockchain-powered cross-border payments platform. Using stablecoins and a network of regulated banking, custody and liquidity partners, the business helps companies move money across borders faster, at lower cost and with full transparency. It is backed by a leading UAE technology and research organisation, pairing deep cryptographic expertise with a startup operating model, and is building towards a VARA licence.

**About the Role**

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will design and run the operating model that makes stablecoin-based cross-border payments work reliably, securely and in line with UAE regulation. You will own end-to-end payment operations, partner operations, reconciliation and the processes, controls and service levels needed to operate as a VARA-licensed business. This is a hands-on leadership role, working closely with Technology, Treasury, Compliance and Network Expansion to grow volumes and corridors without losing control.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Designing, implementing and continuously improving the operating model, policies and procedures across processing, settlement, reconciliation and client servicing
* Owning day-to-day fiat and stablecoin payment operations - on-ramp, transfer, off-ramp and beneficiary payout - with clear exception and escalation paths
* Establishing daily reconciliation across bank accounts, wallets, custody and partner ledgers, and making sure breaks are explained and resolved quickly
* Managing operational relationships with banking, custody, liquidity and payout partners, including SLAs, performance reviews and incident handling
* Running client onboarding operations with Compliance and the MLRO, keeping KYB and due diligence efficient and well controlled
* Defining and reporting operational KPIs - success rates, processing times, cost per transaction and service levels - to the CEO and Board
* Implementing outsourcing and third-party oversight in line with VARA requirements
* Partnering with the CTO, CISO and risk function on 24/7 operational resilience, BCP and DR
* Supporting the VARA licensing application with process maps, documentation and evidence
* Driving automation and AI-enabled process improvement, and building a lean, high-calibre operations team

**What We're Looking For**

***Essential:***

* 10+ years in operations across payments, remittances, fintech or financial services, including senior leadership of payment or settlement operations
* Hands-on experience running stablecoin, virtual asset, digital payments or similar cross-border flows, including on/off-ramp, custody and settlement
* A proven record of building operational processes, controls and reconciliation frameworks from scratch in a startup or scale-up
* UAE experience, with working knowledge of VARA's Rulebooks (Company, Compliance and Risk Management, Technology and Information) and CBUAE requirements
* Experience managing banking, custody, liquidity and payout partners and negotiating operational SLAs
* A strong operational understanding of AML/CFT, KYB and sanctions screening
* Degree in Business, Finance, Engineering or a related field
* Able to meet VARA fit and proper requirements; based in, or willing to relocate to, the UAE

***Desirable:***

* Advanced degree in a relevant discipline
* Experience supporting a VARA or comparable virtual asset licensing application
* A track record of using automation or AI to scale operations

**What's On Offer**

* Competitive, tax-free executive package (details on application)
* Executive-level role reporting directly to the CEO, with Board visibility
* The chance to shape the business from the ground up at founding-team stage
* Based in Abu Dhabi, UAE

Description:

The role leads multiple specialized processing and support teams to deliver responsive, accurate and scalable service to Members, Advisors and business partners.
  
  
The Director translates enterprise and line-of-business strategies into practical operating models that integrate people, process, data, financial outcomes, controls, technology and change delivery. Accountabilities include effective and timely support services and transaction processing; capacity and workforce planning; service optimization; operational performance; and the delivery of strategic initiatives.
  
  
The role is accountable for mitigating operational and reputational risk, maintaining compliance with applicable industry rules, regulations and internal policies, and strengthening audit readiness. Working through a management team and in close partnership with business leaders, the Director builds future capability, improves Advisor and Member experience, and delivers measurable efficiency, quality and growth capacity.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Leadership and Operating Model**

* Provide strategic direction for Business Banking Operations, Wealth Operations, and Wealth Sales Support, aligning priorities with enterprise and line-of-business strategies.
* Translate strategy and business requirements into clear operating plans, service models, accountabilities and measurable goals.
* Lead annual operating planning, budget and expense forecasting, capacity planning and longer-term capability development.
* Ensure teams and structures evolve with business needs while preserving service quality, specialized expertise and scalability.
* Research emerging industry trends and leading practices, assessing implications for specialized operations priorities.
* Act as executive sponsor for initiatives involving process, technology, data, controls and organizational change.

**Service Delivery, Capacity and Stakeholder Support**

* Oversee specialized Business Banking operational support across Small Business, Commercial and Syndication activities.
* Lead multiple teams in delivering timely, accurate, consistent and expert operational support to Members, Advisors and business partners.
* Evolve the Wealth sales support strategy to provide the right value to Advisors, address capacity constraints and strengthen the end-to-end service experience.
* Plan and forecast workload and capacity to meet service commitments, manage critical priorities and support future growth.
* Build trusted partnerships across the enterprise, advocate for operational needs and provide subject matter expertise on specialized operations.

**Operational Excellence, Technology and Change**

* Design, standardize and continuously improve workflows, policies and procedures to increase efficiency, consistency and control effectiveness.
* Deliver measurable improvements in error rates, cycle time, throughput, capacity, cost and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Use performance data and operational insights to identify trends, root causes, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Lead implementation of workflow and technology solutions and support the operationalization of new or changed products and services.
* Lead transformational change and capability maturation, including systems and process design, technology procurement where required, and infrastructure renewal for specialized teams.
* Evaluate appropriate third-party and outsourcing opportunities and manage partner performance where applicable.

**Risk, Audit and Compliance**

* Maintain standardized, accurate processes and effective controls to mitigate operational, regulatory and reputational risk.
* Establish proactive management reporting and testing expectations to demonstrate that audit, regulatory and policy requirements are being met.
* Partner with Operational Excellence, Compliance and/or risk functions to identify non-compliance, escalate issues and implement practical solutions.
* Maintain working knowledge of applicable AML/ATF, privacy, securities, lending, and other regulatory or policy requirements relevant to the portfolio.

* Lead performance management, succession planning, talent development and professional development planning.
* Develop digital, analytical, risk and process-improvement capabilities across the leadership team and broader portfolio.
* Communicate strategy, performance, opportunities, risks and recommendations clearly to senior leaders, partners and external stakeholders.
* Create an environment that encourages open communication, innovation, accountability, thoughtful risk-taking and sharing of leading practices.

* Demonstrable gains in productivity, capacity, cost effectiveness, cycle time and error reduction.
* Improved Member, Advisor and stakeholder experience through responsive, accurate and consistent support.
* Strong control execution, audit readiness, timely issue remediation and adherence to regulatory and policy requirements.
* Successful delivery and adoption of strategic, technology and process-change initiatives.
* A capable, engaged leadership team with strong succession depth and future-ready skills.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Strategic and operational leadership across complex, multi-team environments.
* Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to connect operational insights to enterprise outcomes.
* Advanced judgment and problem-solving skills in complex, ambiguous, high-volume and deadline-sensitive situations.
* Ability to analyze structured and unstructured data, identify trends and translate insights into clear recommendations and action.
* Demonstrated capability in operating-model design, capacity planning, workflow optimization, reporting and performance management.
* Knowledge of operational risk, internal controls, audit practices, compliance obligations and issue remediation.
* Highly developed communication, presentation, facilitation, negotiation and strategic influencing skills.
* Proven ability to lead change, sponsor cross-functional initiatives and implement workflow or technology solutions.
* Strong Member, Advisor and partner orientation, with a focus on trust, responsiveness and service quality.
* Ability to develop talent, build inclusive teams and create a positive environment that encourages learning and innovation.
* High attention to detail, sound prioritization and the ability to communicate concisely without compromising facts.
* Proactive, curious and self-directed, with the agility to move between strategic priorities and critical operational issues.

**Education, Experience And Professional Qualifications**

* Undergraduate degree in business, finance, economics or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Ten or more years of progressive financial services experience, including at least five years in people leadership.
* Experience leading multiple operational, processing or sales-support teams in a regulated financial services environment.
* Demonstrated experience improving workflows, implementing change, strengthening reporting and optimizing stakeholder satisfaction.
* Business Banking experience, including exposure to credit, adjudication, legal documentation, commercial lending or government lending programs, is strongly preferred.
* Wealth operations, Advisor sales support, securities operations or estates-processing experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience with audit engagements, AML/ATF, privacy, operational controls and regulatory compliance is an asset.

* Ensure lessons learned and best practices are captured and implemented across projects.

* Support performance management, coaching, and capability development.

* Master's Degree desirable.

Conduent is seeking an experienced
**Problem Manager**
to lead enterprise-wide
**Problem Management**
,
**Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**
, and
**Incident Prevention**
initiatives across a complex technology environment.
  
  
This role is ideal for a hands-on IT operations professional with expertise in
**ITIL Problem Management**
,
**Incident Management**
,
**ServiceNow**
, and
**service reliability improvement**
. You will work across infrastructure, cloud, network, application, and operations teams to identify recurring issues, drive permanent corrective actions, and reduce repeat incidents.
  
  
Success in this role means delivering stronger RCAs, improving remediation execution, enhancing operational governance, reducing incident recurrence, and helping the organization build a proactive, data-driven Problem Management function.
  
  
**Key Skills:**
Problem Management, ITIL, Incident Management, Major Incident Management, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), 5 Whys, ServiceNow, Remediation Action Plans (RAP), Service Reliability, IT Operations, Continuous Improvement, Executive Communication, Cloud Infrastructure, AWS, Azure, Windows, Linux, Network Operations, Automation, AI-Assisted Workflows

* Incident recurrence rate

**Governance, Reporting & Executive Communication**

* Continuously improve governance processes, operational standards, runbooks, and reporting practices.
* Champion automation and AI-enabled workflows that improve operational efficiency and insight generation.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Experience conducting Root Cause Analysis (RCA), 5 Whys investigations, and post-incident reviews.

* Strong analytical, documentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive accountability without direct authority.

**Technical Knowledge:**
We're seeking broad technical understanding across enterprise technology environments, including:

**Storage**

Title: Quality Manager
Description:
***Maximize your potential. Minimize your footprint.***

Nortek Data Center Cooling builds the systems that keep modern data centers running — from liquid cooling to large‑scale air solutions. Our work supports some of the world’s most demanding AI and hyperscale environments, and we solve those challenges with engineering depth and practical execution.

We keep things simple here. We communicate early, stay close to the details, and follow through. When issues come up, we address them directly, not with layers of process. Customers count on us because we do what we say and we keep projects moving.

Our culture is hands‑on and collaborative. People take ownership, move quickly, and help each other. If you like working with teammates who are straightforward and accountable, you’ll feel at home.

With the backing of Madison Air, we have the scale, stability, and manufacturing footprint to support complex, high‑growth programs.

**Job Summary**

The Quality Manager is responsible for leading quality strategy, culture, and execution for Nortek Data Center Cooling's Dyersburg manufacturing facility. This role serves as a key business partner to Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Customer Quality, ensuring products consistently meet customer expectations while driving operational excellence throughout the organization.

The Quality Manager will champion a proactive quality culture focused on prevention, process capability, and continuous improvement. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, sound business judgment, and the ability to influence cross-functional teams to solve problems, improve performance, and eliminate recurring quality issues.

This leader will balance customer requirements, manufacturing realities, and business objectives while developing sustainable systems that support growth, improve product quality, and strengthen customer confidence.

**Key Outcomes**

Within the first 12-24 months, the Quality Manager will:

* Build and sustain a "Right First Time" culture where quality ownership exists throughout the organization.
* Improve first-pass yield and reduce defects, rework, scrap, and cost of poor quality.
* Strengthen process capability through effective controls, standard work, and preventive quality practices.
* Improve responsiveness and effectiveness of containment, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Reduce customer defects, warranty issues, and quality escapes.
* Improve supplier performance and incoming material quality.
* Develop a high-performing quality organization capable of supporting ongoing business growth and manufacturing scale.
* Increase visibility to quality risks, trends, and performance metrics that enable faster and more effective business decisions.

Responsibilities

Quality Management System & Compliance

* Lead implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the facility Quality Management System in alignment with company requirements and the intent of ISO 9001:2015.
* Ensure required procedures, work instructions, forms, records, and document controls are current, accessible, and followed.
* Plan and support internal, customer, and third-party audits; document findings, assign actions, and verify sustainable closure.
* Monitor compliance obligations applicable to the products and processes manufactured at the site and escalate gaps or risks promptly.
* Promote disciplined change control so engineering, process, material, and supplier changes are reviewed and implemented with appropriate quality controls.

Manufacturing Quality & Process Control

* Provide visible floor leadership for incoming, in-process, final inspection, end-of-line testing, packaging, and shipment release activities.
* Ensure inspection and test plans, acceptance criteria, check sheets, control plans, and workmanship standards are defined and consistently applied.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to identify process weaknesses, implement preventive controls, and reduce defects, rework, scrap, and disruption.
* Establish appropriate hold, quarantine, disposition, and release controls for nonconforming material and product.
* Confirm measuring and test equipment is suitable, controlled, calibrated, and used correctly.
* Assess manufacturing, shipping, packaging, installation, and service feedback and provide actionable recommendations to the responsible functions.

Corrective Action, Problem Solving & Improvement

* Lead or facilitate containment, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and effectiveness verification using structured problem-solving methods.
* Maintain strong governance of nonconformance, MRB, CAPA, deviation, and quality-improvement actions through closure.
* Analyze recurring defects and process trends; prioritize improvement work based on customer impact, risk, and business performance.
* Capture and communicate lessons learned and ensure applicable improvements are incorporated into future builds and processes.
* Support operational reviews with quality status, risk, aging actions, trend data, and recovery plans.

Customer, Project & Field Quality

* Serve as the site quality representative for customer reviews, witness testing, audits, escalations, and quality-related project meetings.
* Coordinate quality deliverables for assigned customer or project requirements, including quality plans, inspection records, test documentation, punch lists, and turnover records.
* Support evaluation of field issues, warranty concerns, service parts needs, installation deficiencies, and methods of procedure when site quality involvement is required.
* Ensure customer-facing responses are fact-based, timely, technically supported, and aligned with approved business positions.
* Provide quality feedback to manufacturing and engineering based on customer, commissioning, installation, and service experience.
* Supplier & Incoming Quality
* Partner with Supply Chain and Engineering to define supplier quality requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Support supplier qualification, issue escalation, corrective action, and performance improvement for critical materials and components.
* Ensure incoming inspection priorities are risk-based and aligned with supplier performance and product criticality.
* Contribute quality input to procurement decisions, sourcing changes, and supplier recovery plans.

**Leadership & Culture**

* Lead, coach, and develop quality personnel while establishing clear expectations, accountability, and growth opportunities.
* Develop and scale the site's quality systems, processes, and organizational capabilities to support increasing production volumes, operational complexity, and customer expectations.
* Build strong partnerships across Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Service, and Commercial teams.
* Drive a culture where quality issues are identified early, addressed directly, and prevented from recurring.
* Foster an environment where employees feel empowered to raise concerns, challenge assumptions, and continuously improve processes.
* Lead through visibility, engagement, and data-driven decision-making.
* Promote a mindset of ownership, urgency, and continuous improvement across the manufacturing organization.

**Success Metrics**

* Customer defects, complaints, escapes, and repeat issues
* First-pass yield, rework, scrap, and cost of poor quality
* Nonconformance, CAPA, audit finding, and MRB aging and closure effectiveness
* Inspection and test completion, record accuracy, and shipment-release readiness
* Supplier defect trends and corrective-action performance
* Training completion and demonstrated competency for quality-critical work
* Completion of site quality objectives and improvement plans

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Operations, or a related technical discipline or equivalent directly relevant experience.
* Progressive quality leadership experience within a manufacturing, engineered-to-order, or industrial equipment environment, including responsibility for leading teams, driving process improvement, implementing quality management systems, and delivering measurable improvements in product quality, process capability, customer satisfaction, and operational performance.
* Demonstrated success leading teams and driving measurable improvements in product quality, process capability, customer satisfaction, and operational performance.
* Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management Systems.
* Experience leading root-cause analysis, CAPA programs, nonconformance management, audit readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, bills of material, test procedures, and manufacturing documentation.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to think independently, challenge assumptions constructively, and make fact-based business decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in HVAC, data-center cooling, air-handling, refrigeration, electrical-mechanical equipment, or other complex configured-to-order manufacturing.
* Formal auditor training or certification; ASQ certifications such as Certified Quality Engineer or Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence are beneficial.
* Experience with Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, 8D, 5-Why, fishbone analysis, PFMEA, control plans, statistical process control, and layered process audits.
* Experience supporting customer factory witness testing, commissioning, installation, warranty, or field-service quality activities.
* Experience using Autodesk Construction Cloud/BIM 360 or similar platforms for project documentation and issue tracking.
* Prior experience working in a regulated or customer-controlled project-delivery environment.

Leadership Competencies

* Independent thinker who exercises sound judgment and applies practical decision-making in complex situations.
* Courage to challenge assumptions and escalate risks when product quality, customer satisfaction, or compliance is at stake.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to balance quality, cost, delivery, and customer requirements.
* Data-driven problem solver with expertise in root-cause analysis and continuous improvement.
* High degree of accountability with a demonstrated bias toward action and execution.
* Collaborative leader who builds trust and credibility across all levels of the organization.
* Continuous improvement mindset focused on prevention, process capability, and sustainable results.
* Effective coach and developer of people who creates strong teams and future leaders.

Work Environment & Position Requirements

* Primarily based at the Dyersburg manufacturing facility with regular presence on the production floor.
* Ability to work safely in an active manufacturing environment and use required personal protective equipment.
* Ability to inspect equipment and work areas, which may require standing, walking, bending, reaching, or accessing production and test locations.
* Occasional travel may be required for customer, supplier, field, audit, training, or other company needs.
* Work schedule flexibility may be required to support production priorities, customer events, containment activity, or critical quality issues.

**Why Join Nortek Data Center Cooling?**

* Help shape and scale quality systems within a rapidly growing business serving the expanding AI, cloud computing, and hyperscale data center markets.
* Lead quality initiatives that directly impact customer success, operational performance, and business growth.
* Work alongside experienced leaders in engineering, operations, and manufacturing who value accountability, ownership, and practical problem solving.
* Help shape the future of quality within a growing organization backed by Madison Air and supported by significant manufacturing scale and resources.
* Influence products that power mission-critical infrastructure relied upon by some of the world's largest technology companies.

Title: Manager, Number Support Group
Description:
**Who We Are:**

At
**Bandwidth**
, we shape how the world connects. We're the global communications software company and Tier 1 network operator with global reach.  The voice, messaging, and emergency services infrastructure behind the brands and apps you use every day.

Because we own the network we build on,
*the problems you'll solve here are bigger, more complex, and more impactful.*

We call ourselves BANDmates because building something this big takes collaboration, different perspectives, and the freedom to bring your authentic self to the table.

We're experts who speak like humans. Ready to build what's next?
**#JoinTheBand**

**What We Are Looking For:**

The
**Manager, Number Support Group**
 leads the analysts and Team Leads who run local, toll-free, international, and inventory number operations within the Number Support Group. The Manager owns the customer's number support experience, measured by SLA, CSAT, and order cycle time, serves as the escalation point for complex customer issues and incidents, and works with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to fix root causes. The role fits an operations leader with deep number support experience who has built and coached teams across time zones.

**What You'll Do:**

* Operational Leadership: Lead daily operations within the team across all number support functions: local porting, toll-free porting, international porting, and number inventory management.
* Performance Management: Set and manage team performance against key metrics including SLA, CSAT, QA scores, ticket resolution time, order cycle time, port completion rate, reject rate, FOC date adherence, and backlog aging. Report results to senior leadership monthly.
* Talent Development: Hire, coach, and develop Team Leads and analysts. Deliver ongoing feedback, manage individual performance, and plan for succession.
* Escalation and Incident Management: Serve as the primary escalation point for complex customer issues and critical incidents across all number support functions. Participate in MIM for number-related incidents and own the customer communication.
* Carrier, Vendor, and Regulatory Management: Own relationships with carriers and porting partners. Stay current on FCC, NPAC, Somos, and international number rules that affect customers.
* Process Improvement and Automation: Identify and drive process improvement initiatives using operational data, team feedback, and industry best practices. Use automation and AI tooling to reduce manual touches per order and fix recurring defects.
* Workforce Planning: Develop and maintain frameworks for workload distribution, scheduling, and capacity forecasting across a geographically distributed team.
* Quality Assurance: Conduct quality audits of porting tickets, phone interactions, and orders, delivering actionable feedback to team members and Team Leads.
* Training and Documentation: Oversee the creation and maintenance of training materials and internal process documentation.
* Collaboration and Culture: Partner cross-functionally with product, engineering, and customer success teams to improve the customer experience and resolve systemic issues. Run regular team meetings to drive communication, share updates, and build team culture across distributed locations.
* Undertake other duties as assigned to support the Number Support Group's strategic objectives.
* Leads a geographically distributed team across multiple time zones, with occasional travel required. Participates in an after-hours escalation rotation for customer-impacting incidents.

**What You Need:**

* Experience:
  + 5+ years in number porting or number inventory operations, including 2+ years leading a team with direct management of Team Leads and analysts.
  + Experience defining, tracking, and managing KPIs to drive operational performance.
  + Experience managing geographically distributed teams across multiple time zones.
* Knowledge:
  + Hands-on depth in at least two of: local number portability, toll-free porting, international porting, and number inventory management.
  + Working knowledge of carrier processes and the regulations that govern numbering and porting (for example, FCC LNP rules, NPAC, and Somos).
* Skills:
  + Strong communication skills, with the ability to interface with customers, senior leadership, and cross-functional partners.
  + Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace, with familiarity in order management and ticketing systems.
  + Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Bonus Points:**

* Education:
  + Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Communications, Business, or a related field.
* Experience:
  + Reducing manual work in porting or order management through automation or AI tooling.
* Knowledge:
  + NPAC and Somos experience. International numbering regulation.
* Skills:
  + SQL or BI tooling for operational reporting.
  + Process improvement certification, such as Lean or Six Sigma.

**The Whole Person Promise:**

At Bandwidth, we’re pretty proud of our corporate culture, which is rooted in our “Whole Person Promise.” We promise all employees that they can have meaningful work AND a full life, and we provide a work environment geared toward enriching your body, mind, and spirit. How do we do that? Well…

* PTO Embargo. When you take time off (of any kind!) you’re embargoed from working. Bandmates and managers are not allowed to interrupt your PTO – not even with email.
* Additional PTO can be earned throughout the year through volunteer hours and Bandwidth challenges.
* “Mahalo moments” program grants additional time off for life’s most important moments like graduations, buying a first home, getting married, wedding anniversaries (every five years), and the birth of a grandchild.
* 90-Minute Workout Lunches and unlimited meetings with our very own nutritionist.

Are you excited about the position and its responsibilities, but not sure if you’re 100% qualified? Do you feel you can work to help us crush the mission? If you answered ‘yes’ to both of these questions, we encourage you to apply! You won’t want to miss the opportunity to be a part of the BAND.

Title: System Director of Technology Operations and Governance
Description:
Pay Range:$75.26 - $105.59 The System Director, Technology Operations & Governance provides enterprise leadership and operational accountability for technology operations, service delivery, information security operations, technology project and portfolio performance, vendor management, service management, major incident coordination, and continuous improvement. The position ensures technology services are reliable, secure, responsive, financially responsible, and aligned with organizational priorities and the needs of clinical, operational, and administrative stakeholders.
  
  
Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, the System Director leads a multidisciplinary portfolio that includes Help Desk leadership and support personnel, Information Security Operations leadership and staff, and IT Vendor Management staff. The position establishes operating standards, governance practices, performance measures, escalation paths, decision rights, and accountability across these functions.
  
  
Serves as the CIO's designated operational leader and strategic partner for enterprise technology governance, service delivery, information security operations, portfolio performance, and vendor management activities. As a senior member of the Information Technology leadership team, the position translates strategy into disciplined execution, supports executive decision-making, and provides leadership continuity for day-to-day technology operations.
  
  
SEARHC is a non-profit health consortium which serves the health interests of the residents of Southeast Alaska. We see our employees as our strongest assets. It is our priority to further their development and our organization by aiding in their professional advancement.
  
  
Working at SEARHC is more than a job, it’s a fulfilling career. We offer generous benefits, including retirement, paid time off, paid parental leave, health insurance, dental, and vision benefits, life insurance and long and short-term disability, and more.
  
  
**Key Essential Functions And Accountabilities Of The Job**
**Strategy, Executive Leadership, and CIO Partnership**

* Serve as the CIO's designated operational leader and strategic partner for enterprise technology governance, service delivery, information security operations, portfolio performance, and vendor management activities.
* Translate organizational and IT strategy into operating plans, priorities, resource requirements, performance expectations, and measurable outcomes.
* Advise the CIO and executive leadership on operational performance, information security priorities, portfolio health, vendor exposure, service capacity, and investment priorities.
* Prepare executive briefings, governance materials, business cases, risk summaries, budget recommendations, and decision requests.
* Represent Information Technology in enterprise governance forums and act on behalf of the CIO for assigned operational matters.

**Enterprise Technology Operations and Service Delivery**

* Lead enterprise technology operations and assigned service-delivery functions across all organizational locations and supported users.
* Establish IT service-management standards, operating procedures, service ownership, escalation paths, and performance expectations.
* Oversee major incident coordination, executive escalation, service restoration, root-cause review, corrective actions, and communications.
* Ensure operational readiness for implementations, upgrades, major changes, and transitions from project delivery into sustainable support.
* Maintain dashboards addressing demand, capacity, service levels, recurring issues, risks, customer experience, and improvement priorities.

**IT Service Desk and End-User Support**

* Lead Help Desk and assigned end-user support functions, ensuring timely, effective, courteous, and consistent service.
* Establish and monitor service-level expectations, customer satisfaction, first-contact resolution, backlog health, response time, resolution time, and escalation quality.
* Improve intake, triage, assignment, knowledge management, self-service, automation, communications, and request-fulfillment workflows.
* Use performance data and customer feedback to drive problem management, training, standardization, automation, and continuous improvement.

**Information Security Operations**

* Provide leadership and administrative oversight for assigned Information Security Operations personnel and security operations capabilities.
* Coordinate security monitoring, threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, identity and access operations, security tooling, regulatory readiness, operational risk management, and performance reporting.
* Ensure information security risks, audit findings, security incidents, compliance gaps, and remediation commitments have accountable owners, target dates, documented status, and escalation.
* Provide clear, risk-based reporting to executives and governance bodies regarding security operations performance, threat activity, incident response, vulnerability exposure, regulatory readiness, remediation, and resource needs.
* Ensure information security requirements are incorporated into projects, procurements, vendor reviews, architecture decisions, operational changes, clinical workflows, and service transitions.

**IT Project and Portfolio Governance**

* Establish portfolio intake requirements for technology, evaluation, prioritization, sequencing, governance, resource planning, risk management, status reporting, change control, and closure practices.
* Ensure projects have defined sponsorship, scope, outcomes, timelines, budgets, dependencies, operational owners, readiness criteria, and benefit measures.
* Review portfolio health and intervene when technology projects face material schedule, budget, scope, resource, vendor, adoption, or operational-readiness risk.
* Coordinate technology portfolio priorities with the PMO to align with organizational strategy, regulatory commitments, operational capacity, technical roadmaps, information security requirements, and funding.

**IT Vendor, Contract, and Third-Party Governance**

* Lead governance for strategic, high-risk, and operationally significant technology vendors.
* Establish accountable ownership, performance standards, service-review cadence, scorecards, escalation processes, and corrective-action expectations.
* Coordinate technology contract planning, renewals, amendments, statements of work, licensing, support agreements, service levels, and vendor obligations.
* Monitor vendor cost, utilization, performance, support quality, regulatory posture, contractual compliance, lifecycle risk, concentration risk, and value realization.
* Maintain forward visibility into renewals, notice periods, price changes, licensing exposure, implementation commitments, and vendor dependencies.

**Financial, Workforce, and Resource Management**

* Develop and manage assigned operating and capital budgets, forecasts, staffing plans, consulting resources, and contract expenditures.
* Align staffing, vendor capacity, and project resources with demand, organizational priorities, risk, and operational commitments.
* Develop workforce plans, succession considerations, role clarity, cross-training, professional-development priorities, and recruitment strategies.
* Lead, coach, develop, and hold accountable directors, managers, professional staff, consultants, and vendor resources.

**Governance, Performance, and Continuous Improvement**

* Establish an integrated operating rhythm for service performance, information security operations, project delivery, vendor performance, budget, workforce capacity, and improvement initiatives.
* Define measurable goals and key performance indicators; use data to guide decisions and hold leaders and partners accountable.
* Ensure policies, procedures, standards, playbooks, service documentation, knowledge articles, dependency records, and escalation information are current and usable.
* Promote transparent prioritization, consistent decision-making, operational discipline, documentation, and follow-through.

**Other Functions**

* Other duties as assigned.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Provides direct leadership to the Information Security Operations leader and the IT Service Senior Manager, and may directly supervise managers, leads, or individual contributors responsible for IT Vendor Management.
* Provides matrixed leadership across technology teams during major incidents, enterprise projects, service transitions, vendor escalations, and material risk response.
* Accountable for workforce planning, performance management, coaching, development, succession planning, and appropriate staffing for assigned functions.

**Additional Details**
**Education, Certifications, and Licenses Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.
* An equivalent combination of education and progressively responsible experience may be considered in accordance with organizational requirements.

**Experience Required**

* Ten (10) years of progressively responsible experience in information technology, technology operations, service delivery, information security operations, project or portfolio management, vendor management, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience managing budgets, staffing, contracts, vendors, service levels, operational risk, executive reporting, major incidents, and complex initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications And Experience**

* Leadership experience in a healthcare delivery organization, hospital, tribal health organization, or integrated delivery network.
* Experience overseeing an IT service desk, information security operations, and technology vendor-management functions.
* Professional certification such as ITIL, PMP, CISSP, CISM, CGEIT, or a comparable credential.

**Knowledge of**

* Enterprise IT operations, IT service management, major incident management, problem management, change enablement, knowledge management, and service-level management.
* Information security operations, security monitoring, threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, identity and access operations, regulatory readiness, operational risk, security architecture, and applicable healthcare cybersecurity standards.
* Project, program, and portfolio governance; financial and resource planning; organizational change; and benefits realization.

**Skills In**

**Ability to**

Title: Vice President of Operations
Description:
We are seeking an experienced **Vice President of Operations** for our family owned and operated company. The VP of Ops will directly supervise our five process-focused operations managers and report to the CEO. In partnership with the CEO, CFO, and CRO, the VP of Ops will think strategically to develop dependable day-to-day executable procedures to drive our business forward. A successful candidate will enjoy building and developing cross functional teams, work in concert with all departments to ensure an exceptional customer experience, and collaborate with all leaders to achieve company goals. Mentoring the leadership and management abilities of all team members, particularly the Operations Managers, will be a focus to ensure everyone is performing to their potential.

Boswell Oil Company is a dynamic growth-oriented distributor of lubricants and fuels to wholesale, retail, and commercial end user markets throughout Georgia and surrounding states. Our nearly 100 year old company is headquartered in Athens, Georgia with additional facilities in Thomson, Waycross, Albany, and Moultrie. Our Purpose is that we exist to enrich lives by empowering our team to partner with customers, delivering guidance, service, and solutions that drive meaningful outcomes. We achieve that through our seven core values of Accountability, Relationship Driven, Ownership, Teamwork, Trust, Resourceful & Creative, and Commitment. Providing extraordinary service to our customers is a priority for every department and team member.  
  
Basing out of our Athens location, regular travel to each location is expected to to support local leaders, stay connected to day-to-day operations, and reinforce consistent service standards.

Compensation will be commensurate with experience. Boswell Oil Company offers a competitive benefit package including medical, dental, vision, 401k with matching, other ancillary insurance options, paid time off, and paid holidays. This is a full time, salaried exempt position.

Previous experience in logistics and transportation is very desirable for a candidate to be excel, and previous experience in the petroleum industry is strongly preferred.

**SUMMARY:**  
Cultivate a customer service-oriented culture and a strong commitment to teamwork across the Operations Division, ensuring that every team member consistently demonstrates Boswell Oil Company values. Provide strategic leadership and executive accountability for company operations by ensuring dependable results measured by KPIs, implementing efficiency and process improvements, and maintaining compliance with company policies and applicable government regulations.  
  
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include the following.  
These are functions a qualified incumbent or applicant must be able to perform with or without reasonable accommodation.

* Work with CEO and other senior leadership to drive organizational values and business strategy.
* Build and maintain positive relationships with key customers, partners, and stakeholders to ensure an exceptional customer experience.
* Review, analyze, and evaluate business procedures, particularly related to operational functioning.
* Improve customer service and satisfaction through policy and procedural changes.
* Lead and take ownership of warehouse, transportation/delivery, dispatch, fleet, and field service by setting and achieving measurable performance goals.
* Develop, mentor, and hold accountable operations team, particularly operations managers, for departmental performance, leadership effectiveness, and continuous improvement.
* In partnership with the CFO, own operational financial performance through the development and management of budgets and cost of operations.
* Communicate and explain new directives, policies, or procedures to managers; for major changes, meet with entire operations staff to explain changes, answer questions, and maintain morale.
* Drive accountability, collaboration, and effective execution among operations, sales, customer service, and support services to produce smoother workflows.
* Measure productivity by analyzing performance data, financial data, and activity reports.
* Coordinate with other support departments such as human resources, finance, and sales to ensure successful operations.
* Maintains harmony among workers and resolves grievances.

*This list is a sampling of responsibilities and not a comprehensive list of all tasks or duties. A complete job description will be provided upon request.*

**SAFETY REQUIREMENTS:**  
Required and responsible for employee safety, attending safety training, complying with all company safety and work policies and reporting all accidents/injuries immediately to Manager and HR Department.  
  
**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**  
Accountable for the leadership, performance, and development of the entire Operations team, with particular emphasis on the directly reporting operations managers, ensuring effective execution of company objectives across all operational departments and locations. Carries out leadership responsibilities in accordance with company policies, procedures, safety, and applicable laws.  
  
Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assisting, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.  
  
**QUALIFICATIONS:**  
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.  
  
**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:**  
The minimum education required for this position is a Bachelor’s Degree in business, logistics, or related field. Masters of Business Administration or similar preferred. Industry specific certifications may be considered in lieu of degree(s). Minimum 7 years experience in a similar role with experience in Transportation, Logistics, or Petroleum; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Managerial/supervisory experience required, progressive managerial positions though multiple aspects of operations preferred. Budget management and financial forecasting experience strongly preferred.  
  
**LANGUAGE SKILLS:**  
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret documents; to respond effectively to the most sensitive inquiries or complaints. Ability to read, speak, and write the English language. Ability to present prepared information to a variety of groups including drivers, employees, and management.  
  
**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:**  
Ability to comprehend and apply the principles of mathematics. Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios and proportions to practical solutions. Knowledge of costing and production methods in a manufacturing environment.  
  
**REASONING ABILITY:**  
This position requires an ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form. Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.  
  
**CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:**  
Must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license and a driving record satisfactory to the Company and its insurers.  
  
**OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**  
Computer skills to include experience working knowledge of Windows, Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, any Web Browser, ERP systems, and database systems.

Title: VP, Professional Services & Support
Description:
**Description**
VP of Professional Services & Support
  
  
Location: Latham, NY in-office presence required

This is an opportunity for a dynamic leader who wants to be at the heart of the public sector software industry. * Foster a culture of customer-centricity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

* Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal abilities.

Title: Director, IT Operations
Industry: IT Services and IT Consulting, Hospitals and Health Care, and Software Development
Description:
**Overview**
HealthEdge® offers AI-powered operational infrastructure for health insurance companies, guaranteeing an enduring financial edge in an increasingly competitive market. We're experiencing strong market momentum, with a growing number of health plans choosing HealthEdge to modernize their operations and compete more effectively. As we expand, we're investing in the people who power that growth, making this a pivotal moment to join us and shape the future of healthcare technology. Learn more at HealthEdge.com.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Director, IT Operations is accountable for establishing and operating the service-management governance model for Client IT Operations. This leader will create the standards, operating discipline, governance, and management mechanisms required to deliver consistent, predictable, and transparent technology operations across a complex 24x7 BPaaS/EPaaS environment.
  
  
The role is designed to be a force multiplier for operational teams: strengthening Incident, Problem/RCA, Change, Release, Knowledge, and Service Governance practices while ensuring that technical ownership remains with the teams responsible for resolution. The Director will drive cross-functional accountability, executive-quality communications, and measurable continuous improvement across onshore and offshore delivery organizations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and lead the Service Management Office, including the governance framework, operating cadence, standards, controls, templates, and performance mechanisms used across Client IT Operations.
* Own the service-management process framework for Incident Management, Problem Management/RCA, Change Management, Release Management, Knowledge Management, and related service-governance practices.
* Establish clear roles, decision rights, escalation paths, and accountability across Tech Ops, infrastructure/platform teams, product teams, implementation teams, Service Desk, customers, and third-party partners.
* Lead governance for major incidents and service disruptions, ensuring disciplined process execution, timely stakeholder engagement, effective bridge management, clear escalation, and high-quality internal and customer communications.
* Define and enforce RCA standards, including ownership, timelines, evidence quality, corrective/preventive actions, cross-functional follow-through, and closure governance.
* Lead Change and Release governance, including CAB effectiveness, production-readiness controls, risk assessment, rollback/testing expectations, release calendars, and post-change validation.
* Create consistent executive and customer communication standards for incidents, service health, operational risk, planned changes, and material service issues.
* Develop service governance scorecards and management reporting covering SLA performance, incident trends, change quality, RCA completion, recurring failure patterns, operational risk, and continuous-improvement commitments.
* Partner with technical leaders to identify systemic operational issues and convert recurring incidents, manual processes, and control gaps into prioritized improvement initiatives.
* Drive standardization across customer environments while allowing documented exceptions where contractual, technical, or customer-specific requirements demand variation.
* Partner with tooling and observability teams to improve ITSM workflows, Jira/JSM utilization, telemetry, alerting, automation, and the quality of operational data used for governance and decision-making.
* Establish and maintain service-management documentation, playbooks, templates, knowledge standards, and audit-ready evidence.
* Build an effective onshore/offshore operating model that uses follow-the-sun capabilities while maintaining appropriate leadership, customer engagement, and executive communication coverage.
* Develop SMO talent, establish measurable objectives, coach leaders and practitioners, and create a culture of ownership, transparency, urgency, and continuous improvement.

**ROLE BOUNDARIES AND OPERATING PRINCIPLES**

* The SMO owns the process, governance, communication standards, escalation discipline, and enforcement mechanisms; technical teams retain accountability for technical diagnosis, remediation, recovery, and permanent corrective action.
* Incident Management facilitates coordinated response and communication; the responsible Technical Operations Manager, Technical Lead, Technical Director, platform, product, or engineering owner remains accountable for technical resolution.
* The SMO is expected to challenge weak process execution, unclear ownership, inadequate evidence, missed commitments, and recurring operational failure regardless of organizational boundary.
* Governance must improve speed and quality of delivery; controls should be risk-based, measurable, and increasingly automated.

**Leadership & Stakeholder Responsibilities**

* Serve as a senior operational partner to the VP, Client IT Operations and other technology and business leaders.
* Influence across organizational boundaries without relying solely on direct reporting relationships.
* Provide concise, fact-based executive updates during high-severity events and periods of elevated operational risk.
* Build trusted working relationships with customer-facing leaders, Technical Operations Managers, Technical Directors, infrastructure/platform teams, product and implementation organizations, vendors, and offshore delivery leaders.
* Escalate systemic risks and accountability gaps early, with clear recommendations and decisions required.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in IT operations, service management, production support, technology delivery, or related disciplines, including significant leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated leadership of enterprise Incident, Problem, Change, Release, or broader IT Service Management functions in complex, high-availability environments.
* Strong working knowledge of ITIL practices and the ability to translate frameworks into pragmatic operating processes rather than compliance-only administration.
* Experience leading major-incident response, executive/customer communications, RCA governance, and cross-functional remediation.
* Proven ability to design or materially improve service-management operating models, governance structures, workflows, metrics, and tooling.
* Experience operating across global onshore/offshore teams and 24x7 service environments.
* Strong analytical capability with experience using operational data, trends, and service metrics to identify risk and drive improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex operational issues clearly to executives and customers.
* Demonstrated ability to drive accountability and change across teams where authority is distributed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in healthcare technology, healthcare payer operations, BPaaS, SaaS, EPaaS, or other highly regulated/transaction-intensive environments.
* Experience with Jira Service Management (JSM), enterprise ITSM platforms, observability/monitoring platforms, PagerDuty or comparable on-call tooling, and workflow automation.
* Experience supporting environments with significant customer-specific integrations, data operations, third-party dependencies, and complex production release requirements.

**MEASURES OF SUCCESS**

* Consistent adoption of defined service-management standards across Client IT Operations.
* Improved major-incident execution, communication quality, escalation speed, and stakeholder confidence.
* Reduced repeat incidents through stronger RCA quality, corrective-action governance, and problem management.
* Improved change success rate and reduced change-related incidents through stronger readiness and risk controls.
* Clear, timely, and reliable operational reporting with fewer manual reconciliations and conflicting sources of truth.
* Reduced ambiguity in ownership and faster resolution of cross-functional operational issues.
* Measurable reduction in operational risk, process variance, and avoidable manual effort.
* A scalable SMO organization viewed by delivery teams as an enabler of better operations and by leadership as a reliable source of operational truth.

**LEADERSHIP PROFILE**
The successful candidate will be a pragmatic operator who combines service-management discipline with strong judgment, executive presence, and the willingness to hold teams accountable. This role requires someone who can move comfortably between a Sev1 bridge, an executive review, a customer discussion, a process-design session, and a data-driven operating review—and who understands that the objective of governance is better service outcomes.
  
  
**Geographic Responsibility:**
Remote, US
  
  
**Type of Employment:**
Full-time, permanent

Exempt

* The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
* Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
* Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
