Title: Manager, Transit Operations
Description:
**Position Type:**

Regular Full Time (RFT)

**Closing Date:**

November 13, 2026

**Salary/Wage Range:**

$114,971.00 - $143,713.00

**Working for the City of Burlington**

A great career is closer than you think. Come work for the City of Burlington, where you'll be joining an innovative and progressive workplace focused on building a 21st century city that respects the diversity of our residents, visitors and employees; and prioritizes continuous opportunities for you to learn and grow.

We don't just spend time attracting the best talent. We spend time and resources to keep the best talent. This may include: flexible working hours, mobile and hybrid working arrangements, a great pension and benefits package, as well as programs to foster innovation and leadership.

**Type of Vacancy**

Existing Vacancy

**Hours of Work**

35 hours per week

**Department**

Transit

**Location**

This position is required to work in person at Burlington Transit Headquarters. Work location is subject to change at the discretion of the City due to operational demands.

**Position Overview**

The Manager, Transit Operations is responsible for overseeing day-to-day operations and administrative duties for the Operations department. The Manager will ensure transit services, operations and programs are run safely, efficiently and, in a financially responsible manner.

The Manager leads a team of supervisory and training staff as well as union workforce and is responsible to ensure a high level of motivation and productivity.

The Manager will provide strategic planning and input into development of business plans and performance metrics to ensure achievement of business objectives.

**Responsibilities**

The primary responsibilities of this role include:

* Ensure operational staff meet goals and standards for safe/defensive operating, customer service, and schedule adherence
* Oversee the response to incidents, detours, construction, severe weather and emergencies.

* Manage Burlington Transit’s Commercial Vehicle Operator’s Registration (CVOR) compliance including the oversight of collision and incident reviews and corrective actions.
* Oversee the Transit Operator training program and working with the Transit Training Coordinator to develop driver training focused on prevention and risk mitigation.
* Develop and maintain operating procedures and business continuity plans.
* Set, monitor and report operational KPIs: on-time performance, service delivered versus scheduled, safety performance and ridership.
* Lead improvement initiatives, technology rollouts and service changes.
* Lead workforce planning, including attendance and overtime management
* Prepare and administer the operations budget, tracking variances and controlling overtime.
* Coordinate with Transit Planning, Service Development and Business Services; Fleet Maintenance; Rider Experience and Education; and City departments.
* Prepare reports and briefings for the Director of Transit, City leadership, Council and its advisory committees
* Administer the collective agreement with CUPE Local 2723 including grievances, investigations and discipline.
* Ensure compliance with the Occupational Health and Safety Act, including joint health and safety committee participation and workplace violence and harassment obligations.
* Ensure operators complete and maintain required training, including AODA and Ontario Human Rights Code training, per the Burlington Transit Accessibility Plan.

**Requirements**

  

* Completion of a 3-year college diploma in a related field. A University degree is preferred.
* 4+ years of related and progressively responsible experience over a broad range of operational activities including proven project management skills.
* 3+ years of experience providing leadership and direction in the operation of a comprehensive transit network.
* Good knowledge of technical issues and an extensive body of rules, regulations, procedures and operational issues related to areas of responsibility.
* Comprehensive knowledge of the Ontario Human Rights Code and Related Orders including disability accommodation and accessibility requirements pertaining to passengers and employees.
* Interpersonal skills to promote a harmonious working environment for a large, unionized workforce and to effectively manage, motivate, counsel, coach, discipline, commend and assess performance of subordinate employees.
* Experience handling conflicting demands and frequent changes in a fast-paced environment.
* Superior analytical, investigative and problem-solving skills to deal with the complexities of managing a division.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, experience writing standard operating procedures, reports and recommendations.
* Working knowledge of technology and computer-based applications related to the work,
* Sound knowledge of policies, legislation, Collective Agreements and initiatives affecting employees and work practices

This position may require occasional travel between sites and/or City facilities and must provide own transportation.

In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, the City of Burlington accommodates the individual needs of applicants with disabilities within the recruitment process. Please call us at 905-335-7602 or email us at: hr@burlington.ca if you require accommodation to ensure your equal participation in the recruitment and selection process.

We thank all those who apply for positions, but only those applicants who are invited for an interview will be contacted.

Title: Security Manager
Description:
**We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most.**
====================================================================================================

For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

The Security Manager will lead the development, implementation and management of Generac’s security program across the enterprise. This role develops program countermeasures for the protection of personnel, resources, and material across the organization. The position champions access control, surveillance, physical security, active shooter prevention, and travel risk management policies, training, and program deployment. The security manager works closely with cross-functional teams throughout the organization and leads the pursuit of zero security incidents. This role is also responsible for ensuring that processes are conducted in conformance with all applicable federal, state and local laws while maximizing the use of industry best practices.

**Security Risk Assessment & Mitigation**

* Directs the initiation of proactive facility security assessments and physical security surveys at assigned sites.
* Implements the procedures to obtain, maintain, secure, analyze, account for, and provide information from assessment reports.
* Participates in exercises to test emergency plans and the response capabilities of the emergency response systems.
* Lead the coordination and planning of emergency procedures with neighboring EMS and law enforcement agencies
* Acts as regional champion for implementation of security risk reduction controls.
* Implement policies, procedures and programs related to emergency management planning, training, and exercise efforts.

**Security Management & Consultation**

* Develops, plans, organizes, and directs the activities of on-site uniformed guards and ensures their actions are in alignment with all contractual obligations and comply with legal and regulatory requirements.
* Provides regional security leadership to their assigned sites and establishes the regions security action plans.
* Implements and manages the adherence to applicable policies, procedures, standards, training, and methods for identifying and protecting Generac personnel, intellectual property, trade secrets, facilities, operations, brand, reputation and other materials from unauthorized disclosure, misuse, theft, assault, vandalism, product tampering, espionage, sabotage, or loss.
* Implements employee security training programs, coordinates, and develops security awareness communication plans, and ensures the availability of all program reference materials, work instructions, post-orders, and response procedures.
* Manages the regional strategic security planning efforts and coordination of the security function at assigned sites to insure alignment with the organization’s overall business objectives.
* Manages complex security improvement programs across the region.
* Develops the regional security plans and maintains close relationships with high-level law enforcement, intelligence, and private sector counterparts.
* Provides security leadership and direction to the professional, technical and support staff within their assigned region.
* Implements the standards for measuring and communicating the efficiency and effectiveness of the security programs in their assigned region.
* Serves on senior level intra and inter-corporate committees and working groups and acts as the regional champion for the Drive to Zero program

**Security Technologies**

* Recommends and coordinates the acquisition, installation or replacement of equipment designed to increase efficiency of security operations at facilities
* Reviews security project designs and conducts onsite progress assessments to insure design specifications meet the security needs.
* Proactively engages with IT resources during design and installation of all security technologies.
* Project manages all system installations, IT integrations, systems programing, testing, and commissioning to ensure completed systems are fit for purpose and functioning as designed.
* Manages the overall life cycle of all security technology systems within their region and coordinates preventative maintenance and service requests with approved vendors to minimize systems downtime.
* Routinely audits and tracks systems performance and data quality.
* Oversees personnel responsible for using electronic and physical security systems, evaluates their performance, audits their activity, and develops process and procedures to minimize risks created by improper use.

**Security Incident Reporting & Investigations**

* Serve as the principal investigator for security incidents, disturbances, or reported discrepancies in assigned region.
* Responsible for overall planning, organizing, and conducting of all security related investigations.
* Partners with regional HR to ensure all incidents of workplace violence are properly reported investigated, threat assessed and documented.
* Guide the collaborative development and implementation of all identified post termination security enhancements at assigned sites.
* Interprets all relevant data and applies appropriate laws, orders, rules, and regulations pertaining to investigations.
* Evaluates and applies in-depth knowledge to establish standards of investigative efforts required, scope and depth of fact finding needed, proper use of investigative techniques and conclusions of investigations
* Implements procedures to obtain, maintain, secure, analyze, file and account for investigative reports to appropriate officials

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:**

* Thorough working knowledge of corporate security concepts and best practice.
* Proven knowledge of security operations and industry standards;
* Demonstrated ability to influence management, teams and individuals across multiple functions within the organization;
* Excellent working knowledge of risk assessment and analysis tools;
* Proven track record of successfully managing shifting deadlines and priorities in a fast-paced environment;
* Effective verbal and written communication skills and ability to train/present to an executive level audience

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a leadership capacity;
* 5 years of progressive strategic Security experience.
* 3 years of implementation experience with security related programs
Willingness to travel locally up to 30% of the time  

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* CCTV, Badge Access, Building Management System
* Act as SAP Super User within functional area as assigned.
* Serve as the Document and Data Management Systems Administrator
* Experience working with private sector/universities or other organizations with global travel expertise.
* CHPP, CPP, PSP or equivalent certification
* Previous experience with meeting FTZ or CTPAT Security requirements
* Experience in de-escalation techniques
* Thorough working knowledge of security concepts, practices and procedures.
Proven knowledge of security operations and standards;  

  
  

**Physical Demands:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear; and use hands to manipulate objects or controls. The employee is regularly required to stand and walk. On occasion, the incumbent may be required to stoop, bend, or reach above the shoulders. The employee must occasionally lift up to 25 pounds. Specific conditions of this job are typical of frequent and continuous computer-based work requiring periods of sitting, close vision, and the ability to adjust focus. Occasional travel.

**Great Reasons to work for Generac:**

* Competitive Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, 401k and many more
* State-of-the-art facility with an onsite gym, walking trails, café, free parking and many employee activities
* Scheduled events throughout the year that allow our employees, both current and retirees, to gather together and enjoy their time with their families and co-workers
* Eligible for summer hours! (Memorial Day – Labor Day)
* Pride! When a storm strikes, Generac employees always rise to the occasion. Each time a storm hits many employees volunteer their time with the customer support team or on the production line while others go right into storm-affected areas to repair generators
* We believe in having fun. From minor celebrations to major events, our employees balance their work by building a strong culture of teamwork and collaboration through a variety of occasions, including our Fun Days.
* Every day is Jeans Day! Dress for your day.
* Product loan and discount programs
